 Near zero battery impact: you'll never notice any impact on battery at all
 Extremely fast: it can scan small files (1MB) in 20ms, and even large files (40MB) in 1000ms.
 Memory efficient: with the default databases enabled it uses under 120MB.
 Regular scan: allowing selection of /system, internal storage, external storage, and installed apps

 Completely offline: Internet is only used to download signature databases, files will never ever leave your device
 Persistence: will automatically restart on boot/update
 Tiny codebase: coming in at under 1000 sloc, it can be audited by even someone with basic programming experience
 Minimal dependencies: the app only uses libraries when necessary
 Signature databases can be enabled/disabled at the users demand

fdroid:barilyuk.texetescribe.name: TeXeTeScribe
fdroid:barilyuk.texetescribe.summary: Read and write in text-based files: TXT, JSON, HTML, CSV, XML, YAML, INI, MD
fdroid:barilyuk.texetescribe.description:
TeXeTeScribe provides what default Android lacks: read and edit text-based files. It also implements concept of a folder with a notebook functionality.
📖 You data is always readable. If a platform can display characters, it can handle a TXT file: Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, macOS, ChromeOS, Smart TVs, e-readers, gaming consoles, embedded and IoT devices, cloud storage and collaboration tools (Google Drive, iCloud, Dropbox, etc). TXT files are the most universal format because every operating system "understands" them. Text files avoid compatibility issues of proprietary formats, ensuring flawless transfer across devices and platforms.
🛡 Future proof your content. Text files are universal and future-proof, free from the compatibility problems that plague proprietary note formats. You don't need a specific app to access TXT file. It can be viewed and edited on basically everything with a processor.
🔓 Notes in TXT files never get trapped. Most note-taking apps store data inside private app databases or proprietary cloud formats. If the app stops working from a bad update or glitch, or disappears from the app store, your notes often go with it. Unreadable, unexportable, and locked behind a backup you cannot open. Plain .txt files avoid all of that.
💾 Notes survive phone failures. When data is stored in internal memory, Android encrypts it by default, starting 2015. If the system glitches after an update, or the phone can't run its OS, all data in phone's internal memory becomes unaccessible, and basically lost - often Android repair process implies wiping all data. Saving notes on a microSD card keeps them physically separate from the system. Just insert SD card into any other device: files stay fully accessible in any file manager.
🔠 Text always looks readable. Every text file has its own encoding. Android uses UTF-8 by default, Windows often saves text in ANSI (Windows-1251), old DOS programs use CP866, and classic macOS systems relied on MacRoman. There is also UTF-32, used in some technical files. Most Android apps simply assume everything is UTF-8, which is why older documents or foreign-language text often appear as unreadable gibberish. TeXeTeScribe app automatically detects the correct encoding, and shows the text readably.
 👁 See what’s inside before opening. 
 App shows list of files beyond simple filenames. You get short content previews of each file and its modification time. This lets you instantly recognize which note or document you need without wasting time opening files one by one.
 💡 Your latest thoughts stay on top. 
 Typical note apps mix your notes together alphabetically or by title, making yesterday’s idea vanish in the pile. TeXeTeScribe reflects how real note-taking works: what you just wrote is what you are most likely to continue developing. The notes you worked on most recently stay right at the top, so you can continue writing or reviewing without searching.
 🛠 Open almost any text-based file. 
 TeXeTeScribe recognizes and edits many everyday formats: .txt, .md, .json, .xml, .csv, .html, .log, .yaml, .cfg, and more. It saves time when you just need to read or fix a file, without searching for a different tool.
 🛰 Work offline forever. 
 Because everything is stored locally, the app works without a connection. Your notes, configuration files, and logs are always available, even on airplanes or in areas without service.
TeXeTeScribe lets you create, read, and edit plain text notes that remain fully accessible and compatible across all devices and platforms. Your data stays future-proof, portable, and never locked inside proprietary formats or apps.
Created by Eugen Barilyuk EB43 https://eb43.github.io

fdroid:com.forrestguice.suntimeswidget.name: Suntimes
fdroid:com.forrestguice.suntimeswidget.summary: Sunlight and moonlight information (clock, alarms, tiles, and widgets).
fdroid:com.forrestguice.suntimeswidget.description:
Tracks sunlight and moonlight times. Features a clock, alarm clock, widget collection, and more.
Suntimes displays rising/setting information for the sun and moon. It includes many features commonly associated with a world clock.
The times reported by this app are approximate. The app doesn't require network connectivity, GPS is optional.
Features:
* clock
* alarm clock
* widgets
* tiles
Clock
* current time (System, Apparent Solar, Local Mean, UTC, or Sidereal time).
* time of sunrise, sunset, twilights (civil, nautical, astronomical), and blue/golden hour.
* time of moonrise, moonset, apogee/perigee, moon phases and illumination.
* time of solstices, equinoxes, and cross-quarter days.
* day/night world map, yearly sunlight, and sun altitude graphs.
Alarm Clock:
* general purpose alarms; full screen alarms, notifications, and quick notifications.
* daily repeating alarms for sunrise, sunset, or other reoccurring events.
* bedtime alarms with support for sleep cycles and do-not-disturb settings.
* gentle alarms that gradually change screen brightness, colors, and volume.
* features for heavy sleepers; math problems, NFC tags (requires SuntimesNFC), and snooze limits.
* automated actions; user-defined intents when alarms are triggered or dismissed.
* other alarms; "roman time" alarms (Natural Hour), midpoint alarms (Interval Midpoints).
The app benefits from the following permissions:
* ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION is used to obtain the current position (latitude, longitude, altitude).
* ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS is used to configure GPS hardware.
* ACCESS_NOTIFICATION_POLICY is used to change do-not-disturb settings at Bedtime.
* BOOT_COMPLETED is used to restore active alarms after a reboot.
* FOREGROUND_SERVICE is used to deliver alarms. .
* POST_NOTIFICATIONS is used to deliver alarms. .
* REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS is used to ensure reliable delivery of alarms.
* SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM is used to schedule alarms. .
* SET_ALARM is used to interact with the system AlarmClock app.
* USE_FULL_SCREEN_INTENT is used to deliver alarms. .
* QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES is used to configure and launch user-defined actions. .
* VIBRATE is used by alarm notifications.
With older devices:
* READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is used to play alarm sounds located on the SD card (api≤=18 only) .
* WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE is used to backup data to file (places, themes, etc) (api≤=18 only) .
Note: The "Calendar Integration" and permissions added in v0.9.0 were removed in v0.10.0. This feature is now available as a separate add-on app; Suntimes Calendars .
Visit https://forrestguice.codeberg.page/Suntimes/ for more information.

must be enabled in the Accessibility settings. The Accessibility service will
give a warning that VN may be able to collect personal data. This is because
Accessibility doesn't know what or how data passing through it is used by
enabled apps. VN only uses Accessibility to read notification text which is
passed directly to TTS and temporary memory (for the notification log). The TTS
service (outside the control of VN) may also print spoken text in the logcat.

fdroid:com.searchlauncher.app.name: SearchLauncher
fdroid:com.searchlauncher.app.summary: Keyboard-first launcher. Search apps, contacts and the web, browse without ads
fdroid:com.searchlauncher.app.description:
SearchLauncher is a keyboard-first Android launcher. Your home screen opens with a keyboard. One bar finds everything on your phone and everything on the web, and opens what you find in a browser that blocks ads.
SEARCH ANYTHING
Apps, app shortcuts, contacts, device settings, downloads, calendar events for the coming week, text snippets and your own custom actions. Ranking learns from what you pick, so the next time is faster.
SEARCH INSIDE APPS, NOT JUST FOR THEM
Type y for YouTube, m for Maps, w for Wikipedia, then what you are looking for. Add a shortcut for any site with a search URL, and give it whatever letter you like.
ONE FIELD THAT KNOWS WHAT YOU TYPED
A sum gets an answer you can tap to copy. A web address opens. "5m pasta" sets a timer. A phone number offers to call it, message it, or save it as a contact. An email address offers to write to it.
A BROWSER WITH NO ADS
Web results open in the app, with ads and trackers blocked by default. Swipe the search bar sideways to move between tabs, or up to see them all as live previews. Both work from the home screen, so your tabs are one gesture away without opening a browser first. Save a page under a title you choose, and find visited pages back from the search bar. Private windows, file uploads, picture-in-picture video and hardware keyboard shortcuts are all included.
FEWER ICONS, MORE ROOM FOR WIDGETS
Add a widget by typing its name, resize it by dragging, and tap the wallpaper to show or hide them all. On a tablet they lay out in columns rather than one widget stretched across the display.
MAKE IT YOURS
Swipe through your own wallpapers. The theme colour can follow the wallpaper behind the search bar. Monochrome icons are optional. Dark mode, a true black OLED mode, a row of favourites, voice search, and export and import of everything you have set up.
Use it as your default launcher, or as a widget on the launcher you already have.
PRIVACY
Nothing is sent anywhere by default. Search suggestions are optional, and when you turn them on, what you type goes to whichever provider the shortcut names. Crash reporting is opt-in. Contacts and calendar entries are read on your device to answer what you typed and are never uploaded. The browser's blocklist is downloaded from the StevenBlack hosts project.
SearchLauncher is free and open source: https://github.com/ontola/searchlauncher

fdroid:io.github.barqallayl.burkan.name: Burkan
fdroid:io.github.barqallayl.burkan.summary: Keeps your Galaxy S23 on the Vulkan renderer, even after a restart
fdroid:io.github.barqallayl.burkan.description:
Burkan keeps your Galaxy S23 on Vulkan, the faster way for the phone to draw its screen. Set it up once, in a few minutes, and it looks after itself from then on, even after a restart. No computer needed.
Normally, switching a phone to Vulkan means plugging it into a computer and typing commands, and doing that again every time the phone restarts, because a restart puts everything back. Burkan does the same job from inside the phone, by itself.
 What it does 
* Turns Vulkan back on after every restart, as soon as the phone is on Wi-Fi. You do not need to open it.
* Shows you whether Vulkan is active, and for which parts of the phone. If it cannot check, it says why in plain words.
* Apply now switches to Vulkan on the spot. Restart all apps also reopens your apps so they pick it up. You can choose apps that should never be restarted.
* Shows each step while it works, and keeps a log of the last 50 runs.
* Comes in two looks: One UI, after Samsung's own apps, and Material. Both have a light and a dark theme.
 What you need 
* A Galaxy S23, S23+ or S23 Ultra. Burkan opens on other phones with a warning, but it is not tested there.
* Android 13 or newer.
* Wi-Fi. Burkan works through the phone's own wireless debugging, which Android only allows on a Wi-Fi network.
 Good to know 
* No root, no computer and no other apps are needed.
* Burkan only talks to your own phone. It does not go online and collects nothing.
* If anything looks odd, restart the phone and it is back to normal. Samsung and Google do not officially support forcing Vulkan.

Each location can be assigned to a customizable category (like Restaurant, Campground, or Mountain Biking), tagged with hashtags, annotated with rich-text notes, and optionally accompanied by a photo. Locations are displayed as color-coded pins on a map, and you can search, filter by category visibility, plan driving routes between saved places. Data syncs across all your devices. You can use the Mac version to import and export collections of locations to share with your friends. 
The app also features a weather station system — you can add named locations (cities/towns) and view weather overlay data on the map for different time periods, making it useful for planning trips around seasonal conditions. On macOS, locations open in dedicated editor windows with a full toolbar, while on iPad/iPhone the UI adapts with sheets and a slide-up location list. The app seeds sensible defaults on first launch (preset categories and a set of U.S. weather stations). The weather data shown in the app comes from weather records from the last 5 years only to give a better estimate of what the upcoming years weather.
I created this app, initially, for my own use for planning camping trips with my family with our trailer. I wanted to track the places we might want to go all over the US and the times of the year that we might want to go there. I wanted to know what times of the year are too hot, too cold, or too rainy. Not many people have used this app yet, so I am hoping to get feedback. Post reviews on the App Store with feedback and request new features.

fedora-packages:hpx/hpx-mpich-devel.name: hpx-mpich-devel

fedora-packages:hpx/hpx-mpich-devel.description: HPX is a general purpose C++ runtime system for parallel and distributed applications of any scale. The goal of HPX is to create a high quality, freely available, open source implementation of the ParalleX model for conventional systems, such as classic Linux based Beowulf clusters or multi-socket highly parallel SMP nodes. At the same time, we want to have a very modular and well designed runtime system architecture which would allow us to port our implementation onto new computer system architectures. We want to use real world applications to drive the development of the runtime system, coining out required functionality and converging onto a stable API which will provide a smooth migration path for developers. The API exposed by HPX is modeled after the interfaces defined by the C++11 ISO standard and adheres to the programming guidelines used by the Boost collection of C++ libraries.. This package contains development headers and libraries

fedora-packages:ilbc/ilbc.name: ilbc
fedora-packages:ilbc/ilbc.description: iLBC (internet Low Bitrate Codec) is a FREE speech codec suitable for robust voice communication over IP. The codec is designed for narrow band speech and results in a payload bit rate of 13.33 kbit/s with an encoding frame length of 30 ms and 15.20 kbps with an encoding length of 20 ms. The iLBC codec enables graceful speech quality degradation in the case of lost frames, which occurs in connection with lost or delayed IP packets.

fedora-packages:jetbrains-mono-fonts/jet.name: jetbrains-mono-fonts

fedora-packages:jetbrains-mono-fonts/jet.description: The JetBrains Mono project publishes developer-oriented font families. Their forms are simple and free from unnecessary details. Rendered in small sizes, the text looks crisper. The easier the forms, the faster the eye perceives them and the less effort the brain needs to process them. The shape of ovals approaches that of rectangular symbols. This makes the whole pattern of the text more clear-сut. The outer sides of ovals ensure there are no additional obstacles for your eyes as they scan the text vertically. Characters remain standard in width, but the height of the lowercase is maximized. This approach keeps code lines to the length that developers expect, and it helps improve rendering since each letter occupies more pixels. They use a 9° italic angle; this maintains the optimal contrast to minimize distraction and eye strain. The usual angle is about 11°–12°. The first font family published by the project, JetBrains Mono, includes coding ligatures. They will enhance the rendering of source code but may be problematic for other use cases.

The jMock library: * makes it quick and easy to define mock objects, so you don't break the rhythm of programming. * lets you precisely specify the interactions between your objects, reducing the brittleness of your tests. * works well with the auto-completion and re-factoring features of your IDE * plugs into your favorite test framework * is easy to extend.

fedora-packages:julius/julius.name: julius
fedora-packages:julius/julius.summary: Large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (LVCSR) decoder software
fedora-packages:julius/julius.description: "Julius" is a high-performance, two-pass large vocabulary continuous speech recognition (LVCSR) decoder software for speech-related researchers and developers. Based on word N-gram and context-dependent HMM, it can perform almost real-time decoding on most current PCs in 60k word dictation task. Major search techniques are fully incorporated such as tree lexicon, N-gram factoring, cross-word context dependency handling, enveloped beam search, Gaussian pruning, Gaussian selection, etc. Besides search efficiency, it is also modularized carefully to be independent from model structures, and various HMM types are supported such as shared-state triphones and tied-mixture models, with any number of mixtures, states, or phones. Standard formats are adopted to cope with other free modeling toolkit such as HTK, CMU-Cam SLM toolkit, etc.

fedora-packages:lavalauncher/lavalaunche.description: LavaLauncher is a simple launcher for Wayland. It displays a dynamically sized bar with user defined buttons. Buttons consist of an image, which is displayed as the button icon on the bar, and at least one shell command, which is executed when the user activates the button. Buttons can be activated with pointer and touch events. A single LavaLauncher instance can provide multiple such bars, across multiple outputs. The Wayland compositor must implement the Layer-Shell and XDG-Output for LavaLauncher to work. Beware: Unlike applications launchers which are similar in visual design to LavaLauncher, which are often called "docks", LavaLauncher does not care about .desktop files or icon themes nor does it keep track running applications. Instead, LavaLaunchers approach of manually defined buttons is considerably more flexible: You could have buttons not just for launching applications, but for practically anything you could do in your shell, like for ejecting your optical drive, rotating your screen, sending your cat an email, playing a funny sound, muting all audio, toggling your lamps and a lot more. Be creative! LavaLauncher is opinionated, yet remains configurable. The configuration syntax is documented in the man page. LavaLauncher has been successfully tested on sway, wayfire (Wayfire currently does not respect subsurfaces ordering used by LavaLauncher), river and hikari.

fedora-packages:liborc/liborc-devel.description: ORC is a self-describing type-aware columnar file format designed for Hadoop workloads. It is optimized for large streaming reads, but with integrated support for finding required rows quickly. Storing data in a columnar format lets the reader read, decompress, and process only the values that are required for the current query. Because ORC files are type-aware, the writer chooses the most appropriate encoding for the type and builds an internal index as the file is written. Predicate pushdown uses those indexes to determine which stripes in a file need to be read for a particular query and the row indexes can narrow the search to a particular set of 10,000 rows. ORC supports the complete set of types in Hive, including the complex types: structs, lists, maps, and unions. Contains header files for developing applications that use the liborc library.

firefox-addons:2618477.name: security.txt
firefox-addons:2618477.summary: Displays the security.txt and humans.txt files for a website if available.
firefox-addons:2618477.description:
How does it work?
As you browse the web and navigate to different websites, the browser extension checks the website to see if it supports either type of file. If it does, an icon is shown in the URL bar. You can click this icon to view more details about the text files that were located. 
What is security.txt?
security.txt is a proposed standard that provides a means for websites and software authors to define their security policies. This is useful to security researchers or anyone who would like to responsibly disclose a vulnerability to the owners of the website or software.
What is humans.txt?
humans.txt is a less formal initiative for providing human-readable information about the authors of the website.

firefox-addons:3005149.name: Palert — Price Tracker & Price History
firefox-addons:3005149.summary: Price charts and history, as well as comparable products on the Ozon, Wildberries, Yandex.Market, Lamoda, and M.Video marketplaces, and at the online stores VseInstrumenty, Citylink, Regard, and Sima-Land. Price drop notifications.
firefox-addons:3005149.description:
Buy now or wait? Palert is a price tracker that shows price history right on the product page: what the item cost before, how low it went, and whether the price is rising or falling.
Not ready to pay today's price? Name your price, and we'll let you know when it drops that low.
One extension for nine Russian shopping sites: the marketplaces Ozon, Wildberries, Yandex Market, Lamoda and M.Video, and the online stores VseInstrumenti, Citilink, Regard and Sima-land.
 The free plan never expires. You just need an account: signing up with email takes less than a minute, no card required. There are no ads, and the extension runs only on supported sites and never reads your cart, orders or payment details. Please note: the extension's interface is in Russian only.
 Price history on the product page 
 A price chart covering 1, 3, 6 or 12 months, depending on your plan. You can see the low, the high and the trend at a glance: if the price is near the bottom of its range, it's a good time to buy; if it's near the top, you're better off waiting.
 Price tracking with a target price. When the price falls to your target, you get a price-drop alert by email, via Telegram or as a push notification.
 Stock levels on the chart, where the site makes this data available, so you can see how quickly the product is selling. If you don't need them, turn them off in the settings.
 Your own discount. Do you always get money off, for example by paying with a marketplace wallet or through cashback on your bank card? Enter the percentage and all prices are recalculated to include it. Available on every plan, including the free one.
 Mini charts in catalog and search 
A small price curve appears under each product in catalog and search listings. As you scroll, you can tell before clicking which items are cheaper than usual right now and which have gone up. Works on almost all supported sites. Mini charts are free for the first 7 days after you start using the extension, with a days-left counter shown right on them. After that, they are included in the Basic plan and above.
 Settings from the toolbar icon 
Click the Palert icon in the Firefox toolbar to sign in, set your discount and turn mini charts and stock levels on or off. Your full list of tracked items is in the web app at app.palert.ru .
 Why past prices are available right away 
Price history doesn't come ready-made: a product page shows only today's price. Palert records and stores prices for millions of products around the clock. The data is tied to the product itself, not to the day you added it, so for popular products you can see past months straight away. For new and niche products, the history starts building from the first lookup.
 How people use it 
 Buying electronics. The price of a phone, TV or graphics card can swing by thousands of rubles over a few months. You see how low it has gone, set a target price and wait for the email.
 Choosing clothes and shoes. Scroll the catalog and open only what's cheaper than usual right now.
 Waiting for a sale. Start tracking items in advance and stop checking prices by hand. On the day of the sale, you can see at once whether the price really dropped below its usual level or was pushed up before the "discount".
 Buying tools, PC parts or home goods. It works the same way in online stores as on marketplaces.
 Selling on marketplaces. Monitor competitor prices right on any product page. In the web app, the Pro plan adds search by product name and price-range monitoring against a recommended retail price (RRP), and Premium adds Excel and CSV reports.
 Questions before you install 
 Why do I need an account? 
Recorded prices are stored on our servers and reach the product page through your account. Alerts are tied to it too: without an account, there's nowhere to send them. Your tracked items are available wherever you sign in: in the browser and in the web app at app.palert.ru .
 How much does it cost? 
The free plan has no time limit: prices for the last month, one tracked item with an alert, your own discount and 7 days of catalog mini charts. The paid plans (Basic, Pro and Premium) give you 25 to 250 tracked items, up to 12 months of history, price checks every 2–6 hours instead of 12, mini charts with no time limit, and back-in-stock alerts. You pay for a month or a year at a time, with no auto-renewal.
 Why are some features paid? 
Recording prices for millions of products around the clock and storing them for months is expensive: it takes servers running non-stop. We show no ads and don't sell user data. Paid plans are our only source of income.
 Is it safe? 
The extension runs only on the supported sites and our own website; the list is shown in the permissions request when you install it. It doesn't read your cart, orders, addresses or payment details. Our server receives the product IDs of items you open or see in listings, plus the site name. For tracking, it also receives the product name and sometimes the page URL. It also gets your settings, such as your target price and discount percentage, and your account sign-in token. Palert is an independent service and is not affiliated with any marketplace or store.
 Why might the price differ from what I pay? 
Palert shows the public price, the one every shopper sees. Personal coupons, loyalty points and special offers only show up in your own cart, while a regular discount can be factored in with the discount setting. Mini charts and the tooltip on the product page chart show which city the price is for: Moscow by default, or your city wherever we have collected prices for it. Stores with one nationwide price don't show a city.
 Why is there not much data yet? 
The free plan shows the last month only. New products don't have many records yet. Citilink and Regard were added recently, and their records grow every day.
 Where else does it work? 
Requires Firefox 142 or later. For Chrome, Yandex Browser and Edge, there's a Chrome Web Store version that also shows similar products on other marketplaces and has a side panel with your tracked items. You can view prices in rubles or another currency, which you choose in your account.
Only have your phone with you? Send a product link to our Telegram bot @PalertRuBot , and it will show you how the price has changed (the bot replies in Russian).
 Getting started 
 Click "Add to Firefox".
 After installation, the extension's settings page opens: click "Войти" (Sign in), then create an account with your email if you don't have one yet, or sign in with Yandex.
 Open a product you've had your eye on. Its price history will appear next to the price and help you decide whether to buy now or wait.
Questions or suggestions? Message @palert_support on Telegram or email support@palert.ru .

 It automatically detects image galleries, and will let you browse through them with the pop-up
 Images on a page can optionally be replaced to their larger versions (e.g. to use with extensions that download all images on a page)
 You can select galleries and/or individual media on a page to batch download in full resolution
Some of the websites it supports includes ( full list ):
 Social media websites (incl. Instagram, Patreon, Pinterest, Reddit, Snapchat, TikTok, Twitter, Tumblr, VK, VSCO, Weibo)
 News websites (incl. BBC, Daily Mirror, Huffington Post, The Guardian, The Independent, Vogue)
 Generic image hosting engines (incl. Cloudinary, Drupal, Imgix, MediaWiki, Wordpress)
 Image hosting services (incl. 500px, Imgur, Flickr, DeviantArt, Pixiv, SmugMug)
Image Max URL works by replacing URLs, and in some cases, querying website-specific APIs. For example, if you have this image:
 https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DlOC3mOWsAEi1ld.jpg (1200x800)
By adding ?name=orig to the end, you will get a much larger image:
 https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DlOC3mOWsAEi1ld.jpg?name=orig (4096x2730)
This does not replace using a reverse image search to find a larger image, but rather complements using one, as reverse image search engines often don't link to the largest (or original) image.
Permissions:
 Access your data on all websites : This permission is required in order for the extension to function in any way (redirect images, find images on a page, create the popup, etc.)
 (Optional) Input data to the clipboard : This permission is required if the "Enable writing to clipboard" option is enabled (disabled by default), which allows copying the link to the larger image/video to the clipboard.
 (Optional) Download files and read+modify the download history : This permission is required if the "Force save dialog when downloading" option is enabled. However, the option is not required to be enabled in order to save media from the popup (and is disabled by default).
 (Optional) Access browsing history : This permission is required if the "Add popup link to history" option is enabled (disabled by default). It only needs this permission in order to write to the browser history (to add the link), it doesn't read anything.
 (Optional) Display notifications to you : This permission is required if the "Notify when update is available" option is enabled (disabled by default).
 This extension does not, and will never contain any kind of tracking code. Feel free to look at the source code or contact me if you have any concerns.
If you have any problems, or requests for new features/websites to support, you can use one of the resources below (whichever is easiest for you):
 Github: https://github.com/qsniyg/maxurl 
 Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/MaxImage/ 
 Discord: https://discord.gg/fH9Pf54 
 Matrix: https://matrix.to/#/#image-max-url:tedomum.net 
 Contact me directly: https://qsniyg.github.io/ 
This is the Firefox addon port for the Image Max URL userscript.

firefox-addons:1014211.name: ShopSuey: Get rid of ads on Amazon, Ebay and more
firefox-addons:1014211.summary: Browser extension to get rid of sponsored search results from Amazon, Ebay, and other online shops.
firefox-addons:1014211.description:
ShopSuey is a browser extension that hides sponsored products, reformats the page, and makes the overall online shopping experience way better.
Currently, the extension only supports Amazon.com and Ebay.com but we’re working on cleaning up several other online retailers, including BestBuy, Target, and Walmart.
Frequently Asked Questions:
Does this extension record any of my data? 
Absolutely not. Check the permissions when you install the extension, you never grant any permissions like that. In fact, there are no external calls at all.
Does this cost any money to use? 
Nope, ShopSuey is completely free to download and use.
How do you make money then? 
When you install this extension, we append our affiliate code to the products displayed on the page. This does not impact your shopping experience. If you complete a purchase, we get a small fraction of the total sale on some products. There is no cost to you and all of this happens behind-the-scenes. You can also disable this feature from the menu if you’d like.
Isn’t this just a glorified userscript? 
Yes, it is.
Is the code open source? 
Not really. When you download the extension, you get minified version of the full codebase. But it’s not a public repo on Github or elsewhere and lacks documentation. I may get to this in the near future if people are interested.

Welcome to Farm Bliss Tycoon, the ultimate mobile game where you can fulfill your dreams of managing and expanding your very own farm empire!

- Valuable offline rewards.
- Wide range of costumes with powerful supportive features.
What are you waiting for? Become a tycoon in the agricultural industry with Farm Bliss Tycoon!
Enjoy the game!

bluejetty:00161821:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00161821:ios.description:
The Miracle Morning Routine App
Transform your mornings. Transform your life.
Based on a Global Bestseller
The Miracle Morning App is based on The Miracle Morning by Hal Elrod, a global bestseller with over 3 million copies sold worldwide.
This Miracle Morning App helps you start each day with intention, focus, and clarity so you can become the person capable of creating the life you want.
The Problem Most People Wake Up To
As you know, most people begin their day rushed, reactive, and scattered. Days feel chaotic, progress feels slow, and personal growth keeps getting pushed aside. Over time, this creates frustration, self-doubt, and regret.
When your morning lacks structure and purpose, everything else feels harder.
The Miracle Morning is about reclaiming uninterrupted time each day to grow emotionally, mentally, physically, and spiritually so you can stop reacting to life and start intentionally creating it.
The SAVERS Method (Simple. Proven. Transformational.)
At the heart of the Miracle Morning is the SAVERS, a set of personal development practices designed to help you grow from the inside out:
Silence – Meditation, mindfulness, breathwork, or prayer to start your day calm and focused
Affirmations – Intentional words to strengthen mindset, confidence, and self belief
Visualization – Visualizing your goals, your future self, and the actions needed to succeed
Exercise – Energizing movement to boost focus, health, and vitality
Reading – Personal growth to expand awareness and improve daily performance
Scribing – Journaling and reflection to gain clarity, insight, and direction
Together, these practices build clarity, confidence, energy, and consistency one morning at a time.
An All-In-One Personal Growth App
The Miracle Morning App brings these timeless practices together in one place through guided routines and personalized journeys curated to your goals, lifestyle, and needs. Instead of piecing together multiple apps, you get a single, simple system that evolves with you.
What You’ll Experience
With the Miracle Morning App, you can:
Wake up with more focus, energy, and direction
Build consistency without pressure or guilt
Follow guided routines and personalized journeys
Track your SAVERS daily to stay accountable
Monitor streaks, earn badges, and see your progress over time
Join live events and connect with a supportive community of like-minded people
The app brings the method to life through guided routines, curated journeys, progress tracking, and community-driven accountability, helping you turn intention into lasting action.
Terms of Use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/15143112

Hey kids, are you ready to explore a land that time forgot? Dinosaur Island is here with an exhilarating adventure for every dinosaur enthusiast! Join Little Dinosaur as he wanders off into a vibrant Jurassic world. But wait, Daddy Dinosaur needs your help to find him!

Dinosaur Island is bursting with charming music, engaging challenges, awesome prizes, and thrilling surprises. Immerse yourself in the island life teeming with friends, family, and an array of colorful dinosaurs. Choose from six different lovable dinosaurs and take on exciting quests as you venture off for unending fun and exploration on Dinosaur Island. Jump, climb, and soar through ancient lands in this ultimate dinosaur game!

Designed to captivate, Dinosaur Island is an enchanting introduction to gaming apps for young kids. Spark your child’s imagination as they enter a Jurassic world like no other!

Features:
• Dive into six breathtaking destinations, from scorching deserts to snow-capped mountains!
• Encounter seven incredible Jurassic dinosaurs!
• Play with freedom - no rules or time pressures. Explore at your own pace.
• Be thrilled by exciting animations and unexpected surprises!
• Perfect adventure companion for your young explorers!
• Designed for children ages 2-5.
• Play safely - Absolutely no third-party ads.

Discover with Yateland:
Yateland creates apps with real educational value, inspiring preschoolers worldwide to learn through play! With each app we make, we are committed to creating experiences that kids love and parents trust. Get to know more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.

Privacy is paramount:
At Yateland, we take your privacy seriously. For an in-depth understanding of our practices, please read our comprehensive privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

Get ready for a ROAR-some adventure! Download Dinosaur Island: T-REX now and step into the Jurassic World of Dinosaur Games for Kids!

bluejetty:00127910:ios.description:
Are you ready to control an entire hospital and save many lives in your city? 
Take on the responsibility and manage all the departments to keep your patients alive and healthy while making your business profitable!
Learn from your own experience and become one of the most renowned hospital managers in the world! Upgrade the hospital areas, deal with the needs of your patients, and offer them the best possible medical assistance!
UNLOCK NEW AREAS: 
A worthy hospital needs to implement different departments such as radiology, traumatology, infirmary, emergency room, or even an equipped waiting room. And the best operating rooms, of course! Reinvest your earnings wisely to improve all the zones on your premises and make quick decisions to serve more and more patients. 
ADAPT YOUR STRATEGY ANYTIME: 
Discover the new upgrade system where you decide what to do with your boosters. Modify and adapt your preferences according to your specific needs. Increase your range of patients, reduce waiting times, or even make your surgery more profitable! Study all the possibilities and be the boss!
DEAL WITH EMERGENCIES:
Get juicy rewards after taking care of your emergency patients! Be ready to handle stressful scenarios when the ambulance comes with more and more sick people. Keep your hospital and your ER alert to succeed! Heal and serve as many patients as you can. The more, the better!
MANAGE YOUR STAFF: 
Be a worthy boss and create the best work environment in all your departments. You need the best working teams in all the areas to have a competent medical center. Not only the best doctors, specialists, nurses, assistants, ambulance drivers, or stretcher handlers… But also receptionists, cleaners, janitors, or security guards! Take the great challenge and make it work!
If you like management and idle games, you will enjoy Hospital Empire Tycoon! A casual easy-to-play game where strategic decisions have to be taken to manage a hospital with profitable results. Improve your empire starting from a modest medical clinic and unlock visible progress in your premises. Transform your small business into the best hospital and become the best health manager in the world!
Main Features: 
Casual and strategic gameplay for every player
Innovative Emergency Room rewards system
More detailed management system 
Dozens of objects to be unlocked and upgraded
Lots of characters and interactions
Funny 3d graphics and great animations 
Management of a successful business
A small living world in miniature

bluejetty:00041430:ios.name: My Perfect Hotel-Empire
bluejetty:00041430:ios.summary:
A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED  Ever dreamed of running your own PERFECT hotel? 
Start from the ground up in this fun and fast-paced time-management game where the aim is to build an accommodation empire and demonstrate your dedication
bluejetty:00041430:ios.description:
A GAME TO KEEP YOU FULLY OCCUPIED  Ever dreamed of running your own PERFECT hotel? 
Start from the ground up in this fun and fast-paced time-management game where the aim is to build an accommodation empire and demonstrate your dedication to hospitality. Show your skills as a hotel manager, invest wisely in staff and property improvements, and work your socks off to become a hospitality tycoon in this addictive and entertaining casual hotel collection simulator. Perfect hotel room  
FIRST-CLASS SERVICE 
Build a hotel empire hotel collection: 
There are several hotel rooms to explore and expand, especially the master bedroom, each with dozens of different unique upgrades to make before you reach five-star perfection. Open hotels master bedroom, in beautiful master bedroom, demonstrate your competence as a manager in each room, then get promoted to get a new and bigger property, and continue your path to becoming a true hotel tycoon. Each hotel rooms have its own style and atmosphere too 
Amenities are the answer to your hotel: 
Maximize your profits and get more funds to invest in this fun simulator by ensuring your hotels rooms have all available amenities. Bathrooms are the first step, but work hard and you’ll soon have the opportunity to add vending machines, restaurants, parking lots, and swimming pools to your properties. Guests will pay extra for each facility, boosting your revenue. Though remember each facility also needs staffing, so get hiring or you’ll soon run off your feet with angry guests left standing in line for each amenity.
Human resources HR: 
It also takes work to run each facility: the bathrooms must be stocked with toilet paper, guests must be granted access to the parking lot, in the restaurant customers need to be served and the tables need clearing after they’ve eaten, and at the pool you need to ensure a constant supply of clean towels and tidy sun loungers. You won’t have time to do it all yourself, so hire new staff, or you’ll soon have angry guests left standing in line.  
 Climb to the top of hotels:
Your guests may be sleeping comfortably, but there’s no time to rest for a determined hotel tycoon Start the game as a simple bellhop single-handedly cleaning rooms, greeting guests at reception, collecting payments and tips, and keeping the bathroom stocked with toilet paper. As your bank balance expands, upgrade rooms and facilities, and employ new staff to help keep up with the growing demand at your hotel.  
Keep going: 
If you want success in this high-stakes industry, you can’t just stroll around your property at a leisurely pace. Upgrade your and your employees’ movement speed to work faster and provide your guests with all the services they need ASAP — it’ll boost your revenue too.   
 Grand designs: Upgrade accommodation to improve guests’ experience of your property and choose from a range of different room designs in each location. In this engaging simulator, you’re not just a manager, you’re an interior designer too! 
 FIVE-STAR FUN   Looking for a time-management game that’s original and simple to play and provides endless hours of entertainment? Dive straight into the fast-paced world of hospitality provision and develop your skills as a manager, investor, and designer.

bluejetty:00161678:ios.description:
You are trapped in a retro house with a Showa-era atmosphere.
Think of a way to escape from this house by making full use of hidden riddles and items.
The game can be operated with just a tap, and it is ideal for brain training as it uses memory and thinking skills.
Also, the difficulty level is low and the game progresses quickly, so people of all ages can play.
How to play
Tap a suspicious place in the room.
Tap an item to select it.
Tap the item box again to enlarge the item.
Tap the enlarged item and select another item to combine them.
If you get stuck, you can see hints from the menu.
BGM by Float 11

Will you strive to make all the right decisions in order to become a model citizen shortly before you pass away? You could marry the love of your life
bluejetty:00038049:android.description:
BitLife FR: the official French version of BitLife!
What life will you lead in BitLife?
Will you strive to make all the right decisions in order to become a model citizen shortly before you pass away? You could marry the love of your life, have children, and get a good education along the way.
Or, on the contrary, will your choices terrify your parents? Why not fall into a life of crime, fall in love, go on adventures, foment riots in prison, engage in smuggling, or even cheat on your spouse? It's up to you to choose your story...
Find out how an accumulation of small choices can lead to your success in the life of the game.
Interactive narrative games have been around for years. However, this is the first text-based life simulator that condenses and reproduces adult life!

bluejetty:00171640:ios.name: Hey! on Fark.com
bluejetty:00171640:ios.summary: "Hey! on Fark.com" is the official Fark App directly from Fark.com that's designed for your mobile device. In addition to reading all of the news and funny headlines from Fark on your phone, now you can completely customize how you get news
bluejetty:00171640:ios.description:
"Hey! on Fark.com" is the official Fark App directly from Fark.com that's designed for your mobile device. In addition to reading all of the news and funny headlines from Fark on your phone, now you can completely customize how you get news that's important to you, including unlimited keyword triggers for stories you're interested in, and customizable notifications for real-time updates of the topics and tags of your choice.
Features:
NOTIFICATIONS – Set custom triggers by topic or tag so you never miss what's important to you. Get alerts for when someone responds to your comment or mentions your username in a thread. Get notifications for Fark parties near you if you want. Also get all linked stories from sources you like, such as CNN, Scientific American, ESPN, etc. 
COMPLETELY CUSTOMIZABLE – Set your own custom keyword triggers and be informed immediately whenever a headline with that keyword is posted
WANDER – Seamless integration with Fark mobile lets you read through all the news on Fark in a format optimized for your mobile device
DISCUSS – Read the story or jump directly to the live discussion thread
SHARE – One-touch sharing of any story to Twitter or Facebook
PAUSE – Choose when you don't want to receive notifications on the triggers you selected
SUBMIT - Send stories from Safari directly to the Fark submission page
STICKER - Sticker your messages! Tag your friends' messages as 'AMUSING', 'FAIL', 'OBVIOUS', or whatever else strikes your fancy

Step into a new dimension of creativity with our app, the revolutionary app that brings augmented reality to your fingertips. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced artist, our app helps you create stunning sketches with ease.
How It Works:
Use your smartphone to project an image or outline directly onto paper and trace along the lines. No experience required – just follow the guide and draw.
What You Can Do with Our app:
Upload and Trace Your Own Art
Import personal designs or photos and turn them into traceable templates.
Explore Art Categories
Browse curated collections such as Anime, Tattoos, Animals, Cars, Landscapes, and more.
Learn to Draw, Teach Others
Perfect for self-learning or guiding children – Our app is an educational tool and a creative outlet in one.
Designed for Everyone:
From kids to adults, from hobbyists to professional artists – Our app makes artistic expression accessible to all. It’s ideal for family bonding, art education, or simply relaxing through drawing.
Drawing in 3 Simple Steps:
Choose a template from the gallery or upload your own
Stabilize your phone using a mug, stand, or tripod
Trace the projected lines onto paper
And just like that, your artwork is brought to life.
Why Choose Our app?
Simple and intuitive interface.
Enhances real-world drawing using augmented reality.
Supports creativity, learning, and mindfulness.
Works with any paper, any tools, anywhere.

Each user after making in-app purchase will get access to all paid features without any limitations. Each user can restore his previously purchased subscription by pressing "Restore” button on app paywall screen. All features that user will get access to is listed below:
- An unlimited number of photos can be uploaded to the app for subsequent drawing.
- Access to all pre-upload drawings in app
- The ability to save and share drawn photos with friends
- Premium support & much more

bluejetty:00183272:ios.description:
Olio is your local go-to for free food and other useful stuff people nearby no longer need.
From surplus supermarket food to everyday household items, Olio helps good things find a new home locally. It’s simple, free, and right on your doorstep.
⁕ Find free food near you
Discover free food shared by local volunteers who rescue unsold surplus from supermarkets, local shops, cafes and more – from fresh bread and veg to cupboard staples and ready-to-eat meals.
New food is added every single day.
⁕ Get (and give) free stuff locally
Browse free clothes, books, toys, toiletries and more from people nearby.
Got food, clothes, books or household items you’re not using? Share them in just a few taps and clear space fast. 
Free items are requested quickly, so things don’t hang around.
⁕ Everything happens locally
See what’s available near you on the map and arrange a collection at a time that works for you. No postage. No hassle. Just neighbours helping neighbours.
Small actions. Big difference.
Olio makes it easy to reduce waste, save money and support your community – all at the same time.
⁕ Join a movement of millions of people already sharing locally.
Download Olio and see what’s being shared near you today!
Terms and conditions: https://olioapp.com/en/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy policy: https://olioapp.com/en/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00074367:ios.summary:
Enjoy Talk & Play, and Discover, Create & Learn with Applaydu Season 7: A New Entertainment Platform for Kids!
Applaydu by Kinder is an award-winning kids game and entertainment platform for kids and parents, offering a safe and creative K
bluejetty:00074367:ios.description:
Enjoy Talk & Play, and Discover, Create & Learn with Applaydu Season 7: A New Entertainment Platform for Kids!
Applaydu by Kinder is an award-winning kids game and entertainment platform for kids and parents, offering a safe and creative Kinder world where children can talk, imagine, learn through play and discover magical worlds and lovable characters. This season introduces Talk & Play, a new interactive experience that lets kids engage in playful conversations with their favorite Applaydu characters, encouraging imagination, communication and creativity in a safe environment.
TALK & PLAY WITH YOUR FAVORITE CHARACTERS
Bring your Kinder toys to life through fun and engaging conversations! With Talk & Play, children can chat, interact and go on imaginative adventures with their favorite Applaydu friends. Every interaction inspires communication, creativity and self-expression while helping kids develop important life skills through playful exploration.
IMAGINE & UNLOCK DIFFERENT WORLDS
Explore exciting worlds together with your family, including Natoons, an underwater fantasy, an art city, Emotiverse, Let's Story and many more adventures designed to spark imagination and discovery.
PERSONALIZE YOUR OWN WORLD
Create unique avatars by choosing hairstyles, outfits, accessories and more. Kids can personalize their digital house with furniture, decorations, paintings and collectibles, creating spaces that reflect their creativity and personality.
DISCOVER A GROWING WORLD OF STORIES
With Let's Story, kids can enjoy an ever-expanding library of children's stories, bedtime stories and reading games for kids. Explore stories inspired by different regions, cultures, seasons and themes throughout the year. From festive Christmas and Easter adventures to exciting journeys across unique worlds, there's always something new to discover. Each story is designed to spark imagination, curiosity and a love for reading through engaging age-appropriate experiences.
LEARN THROUGH PLAY
Applaydu helps children develop essential skills through educational games for kids, learning games for kids and playful activities designed to inspire curiosity and creativity. From kids' learning games and preschool games to engaging activities and adventures, children learn good habits, problem-solving, creativity and everyday life skills through experiences designed for growing minds. In Emotiverse, children can explore emotions, understand feelings and learn healthy ways to recognize and express themselves through fun children's games and interactive activities.
AWESOME MINI-GAMES & INNOVATIVE AR ACTIVITIES
Enjoy educational games for kids that combine fun and learning through puzzle games for kids, musical challenges, racing games, coloring activities, creativity tools and more. Children can draw, color, create artwork and display their creations inside their avatar home. Families can also enjoy AR experiences through Joy of moving activities. Backed by science, these movement-based games encourage physical activity, learning and healthy development through active play.
A SAFE & TRUSTED PLATFORM FOR FAMILIES
Developed by Kinder, a brand trusted by families worldwide, Applaydu offers free kids' games and learning experiences in a 100% kid-safe environment with:
• Mom's Choice Awards and Parents' Picks Awards 2026
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• Child-friendly experiences
• Support for 19 languages
Parents can monitor progress, access personalized recommendations and manage screen time through dedicated parental controls.
Contact us at contact@applaydu.com
For privacy-related questions, please write to privacy@ferrero.com or visit applaydu.kinder.com/legal
To find instructions to delete your account, please visit: https://applaydu.kinder.com/static/public/docs/web/en/pp/pp-0.0.1.html

Hey, we know your phone’s got a couple of gay apps already. But hear us out! Add just one more to the mix: BUDDY.

Because you might just find yourself opening BUDDY as much as (if not more than) your current fave.

Craving a night out? BUDDY's got your back with a unique calendar showing all the hottest events in clubs and saunas near you. From wild weekends to laid-back after-hours, you’ll always know where the vibe’s at.
What can you do on BUDDY?
- Watch videos and pics.
- Create your own private classifieds (and make some fun plans).

DOWNLOAD BUDDY NOW
We’re not just another app. We’re the scrappy, fiery, fun-loving buddy who always goes the extra mile.

bluejetty:00023045:ios.summary: Racing excitement and competition are at the top. Developing cars and showing off on racetracks are on the top. Teasing opponents and breathtaking races are on the top. All of it and so much more in Top Race! Download Top Race now and exper
bluejetty:00023045:ios.description:
Racing excitement and competition are at the top. Developing cars and showing off on racetracks are on the top. Teasing opponents and breathtaking races are on the top. All of it and so much more in Top Race! Download Top Race now and experience the unique pleasure of the race, the fun, the competitive feeling and the happiness of winning at the top.
- Robotic super cars.
- Challenging bosses. 
- Tons of different cars. 
- Tons of boosters.
- Different racing areas. 
- Unique racing modes.
- Daily rewards and different chests.
- Huge tournaments and ranking system.
- Create your own team.
- League races and boss races. 
- Excitement of racing!
Unique Cars! 
Relic, Geisha, Duchess, Poison, Gull and so much more. Driving these cars is crazy. Which do you like, big off-road vehicles, monster trucks, fast racing cars or modified classic cars? Everyone likes cars of different styles, choose the one that suits you best among dozens of cars and experience the excitement of racing in the Top race. Moreover, you can upgrade the car you choose, gain extra features and you can become the master of tracks! 
Hey Boss! 
From New York to Moscow, from Tokyo to London, dozens of different bosses are waiting for you in their regions. Yua is a tech genius while Baby Bill is the streamer. Can you beat these tough opponents? Defeat your opponents one by one, take their cars, expand your collection and challenge even more bosses. All cars are waiting for you, capture them. 
Boost Please! 
Strategy is very important when competing with your opponents. Each boss has a different strategy to win the game. Which one is yours? Will you fill the road with mines and oil and embarrass your opponents or try to eliminate them with missiles and shockwaves? Maybe you go straight to the finish line using turbo and a perfect start. Choose your strategy and get to the top of the Top Race list. 
Racing at the Top!
You have dozens of different opponents on the track, drive fearlessly and beat them all. Take the corners, step up, use the right boosts and always make the right decision and be the first one to cross the finish line. Become invincible, defeat bosses and become #1 in the racing world. 
Ran-KİNG! 
There is a long ranking list full of opponents you have to beat. Do daily missions, collect rewards and chests, buy and upgrade new cars, use boosters and beat your rivals on the rankings. Rise to the top of the rankings by winning tournaments and beating bosses, become the best racer in the world! 
Dominate the streets as you push the limits of your fast and furious machines, leaving your opponents in the dust.
Enter furious races now and become the ultimate fast racing legend. It's time to show the world what you're made of!
Forge ahead your opponents in these fast and furious races!

Privacy Policy: https://joygamemobile.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00016159:ios.description:
* First Ever Celebrity Voice Changer® * 
* Join 25 Million People *
Celebrity Voice Changer lets you change your voice to any celebrity voice instantly, just by talking into a mic. This is not a cheap voice effect, like other voice changers on the market.
If you've tried voice changers in the past, you've probably encountered voice changers that simply change the pitch or speed of your voice, or put a horrible echo effect or "dry" your voice using a frequency gate or other very simple effect... That is not us, we are the real deal. Try our celebrity voice changer for yourself.
For the first time, you can say anything you want in English, and have it spoken back to you by a huge group of celebrity A-listers.
To use the app, make sure you have an Internet connection, then Tap and Speak into the microphone. It will automatically detect silence. It should only take a few seconds at most to generate a video of your changed voice back to you. You can then share the video (which contains your changed voice).
Legal Notice: ALL ORIGINAL CONTENT and ARTWORK - NO IMPLIED AFFILIATION or ENDORSEMENT - NO CELEBRITY NAMES or LIKENESS - IMPRESSIONS FOR THE PURPOSE OF PARODY - VOICES ARE ONLY IMPRESSIONS - NOT A SOUNDBOARD - Celebrity Voice Changer is meant to be used as a parody and to create parody. Celebrity Voice Changer is not claiming an affiliation with any celebrity who is being parodied. All content within Celebrity Voice Changer is original, and there are no Celebrity or Brand names; only our poor impressions.
Celebrity Voice Changer uses user-generated content to create the technology and to create user-generated voice changers.
FAQ:
*Can I request a new voice?
Yes! Tweet it and ask us in your comments (we read them), we will focus on the most requested voices, so get your friends to request Voice Changer Voices too!
*Sometimes it is perfect, but sometimes I don't understand what it is saying, can you make it better?
Yes, and we are working on it. Our Deep Learning Technology automatically learns and does impressions of celebrity voices without any human training. The technology is not perfect yet, but we're getting there. With your support we will continue working until the voices are indistinguishable from human voice. We are also working on real-time voice changer technology in conjunction with our partner. Our technology makes it possible to change the voice, not just disguise the voice or change your voice to an FX chain that makes it sound like a monster or a chipmunk.
*Can you do a particular celebrity voice?
Yes. We can do any voice. Our partner's technology is learning to do impressions of humans by listening to tens of thousands of hours of human speech. We use a proprietary neural network that turns a human voice into a voice font, or text to speech voice. In order for us to do impressions, we need audio to create celebrity voice impressions. Soon, we will make available our partner's community on our website and upload any voice impressions for us to use to make voices.
For licensing inquiries and API key requests, please reach out.

• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Visit our Privacy Policy at: http://www.celebrityvoicechanger.com/privacy
• View our Terms of Service at: http://celebrityvoicechanger.com/tos/

bluejetty:00159522:ios.summary: You reach for your iPhone, and before you even check the time, something is moving. Moon jellies drift through the dark water of your Lock Screen. A cute lucky cat waves you good morning. This is what live Wallpapers feel like: your phone,
bluejetty:00159522:ios.description:
You reach for your iPhone, and before you even check the time, something is moving. Moon jellies drift through the dark water of your Lock Screen. A cute lucky cat waves you good morning. This is what live Wallpapers feel like: your phone, awake before you are.
◈ A WORLD FOR EVERY MOOD
By noon you are somewhere else entirely. Aloha island light spills across your Home Screen. The blue of a Bodrum summer. Valley horizons that go on forever, Flora and May in full bloom, Autumn gold drifting slowly past your apps.
Some days you want soft. Dreamy gradients, watercolor that flows, aesthetic backgrounds that feel like a deep breath.
Some days you want loud. Neon Wallpapers that glow after dark, liquid metal that pours like mercury in 3D, abstract chaos in colors that collide. Cool dogs, cute fruit salad, anime style, fast cars.
Every Wallpaper in Art Blast comes from one artist's vision, finished in HD, so each Wallpaper you find fits with the next, and nothing looks like it came off Google.
◈ YOUR OWN WALLPAPER MAKER
Your best friend's laugh on the beach. Your dog mid-zoom. The sunset you almost forgot you took.
Open the free Wallpaper maker and editor, scrapbook them together, frame them in candy, sign them in your own words, and carry them with you all day. Your photos never leave your iPhone.
◈ SPATIAL WALLPAPERS
Tilt your phone and the art tilts back. Spatial Wallpapers open a window into real 3D depth, a living scene made for Spatial Scene on iOS 26 and ready for iOS 27.
Try any Wallpaper on your own Lock Screen and Home Screen before you save it, and watch it shine on Retina in crisp HD and 4K.
◈ AFTER DARK
Eclipse. Red in the dark. Deep black Wallpapers that melt into your OLED screen, cool and quiet. Glass and crystal catching the last of the light. Halloween after midnight, festive lights when the season turns.
Build whole themes around how you feel tonight, a matching duo for your Lock Screen and Home Screen.
◈ ART BLAST PRO
All of it is free to explore. No subscription, no trial waiting to charge you.
When you fall for the moving ones, Pro is one purchase, once: the ads disappear and every live Wallpaper is yours, including every one still to come.
◈ MADE FOR
• Live and animated Wallpapers that keep moving
• Cool and cute Wallpapers, dope and rapper style art
• Dark and neon aesthetic themes
• 3D and spatial depth in HD and 4K
• Every iPhone on iOS 26 and iOS 27
• A free Wallpaper maker, editor and scrapbook
• Lock Screen and Home Screen themes that feel like you
Your iPhone is the thing you look at most. Make it a masterpiece.

Download Now and Report for Duty!

bluejetty:00119453:ios.summary: Stay on top of the market by quickly finding and tracking trending penny stocks and top-performing shares. Discover over 2,000 promising stocks under $10. Access charts, real-time quotes, and personalized watchlists. Get key fundamentals, c
bluejetty:00119453:ios.description:
Stay on top of the market by quickly finding and tracking trending penny stocks and top-performing shares. Discover over 2,000 promising stocks under $10. Access charts, real-time quotes, and personalized watchlists. Get key fundamentals, company profiles, and news from top publications. PennyGems provides accurate Buy/Sell recommendations, updated 3x daily, identifying hot penny stocks, and top penny movers. Perfect for day traders and long-term investors.
Features
Stock Ratings
• Each stock receives a Grab (Super Buy), Buy, Hold, Sell, and Dump (Super Sell) rating updated daily.
• View the history of ratings for days, weeks, and months in the past to validate the accuracy of app predictions on promising penny stocks.
• Filter watchlists to see only stocks with Grab or Buy ratings to save time and maximize your trading profits.
Watchlist
• Add stocks with Buy ratings to your watchlist and sort them by daily gains, trading volume, volatility, etc.
• View price quotes, daily trading range, price change in dollars and percentage, market capitalization.
• Color-coded sparklines allow you to effortlessly track hot penny stocks and performance throughout the day. 
Stock Screener
• Filter booming penny stocks by key metrics: market cap, P/E ratio, EPS, dividend yield, and more
• Search by sector, volatility, and financial indicators
• Discover undervalued or outperforming stocks including quality penny stocks
• Identify opportunities across all US stock exchanges
• Customize stock scanner settings to fit your investing strategy and discover top penny movers
Charts and details
• Tap any ticker in any portfolio to see price charts for weeks, months, and multi-year periods.
• Touch the profile, metrics, and history tabs to see the company’s business description, fundamentals, etc.
• View key details including dividends, debt, income, volatility, revenue, earnings dates, EPS, and Moving Averages.
Business News
• Read Top Stories automatically selected by app algorithms for the latest news for each stock.
• Read and watch stories about the stocks you follow from dozens of business publications, selected using Artificial Intelligence.
• See all beautifully formatted news stories ideal for following trending penny stocks.
Subscription plans include Free and Premium for $10/month or $100/year. A FREE 1-week trial subscription is available for new users.

bluejetty:00086511:ios.description: تطبيق صيدلية اوتلت وجهتك للتسوق من منتجات العناية والجمال والصحة بسهولة وفي مكان واحد.اكتشف تشكيلة واسعة من منتجات العناية بالبشرة، العناية بالشعر، العناية الشخصية، المكياج، العطور، مستلزمات الأم والطفل، الفيتامينات والمكملات الغذائية، بالإضافة إلى العديد من المنتجات اليومية التي تحتاجها.يوفر لك تطبيق صيدلية اوتلت تجربة تسوق سهلة وسريعة، مع مجموعة متنوعة من العلامات التجارية والمنتجات التي تناسب احتياجاتك وميزانيتك، بالإضافة إلى عروض مستمرة وكاش باك على الطلبات المؤهلة يساعدك على التوفير أكثر في مشترياتك القادمة.تسوق حسب احتياجك واكتشف منتجات العناية المناسبة لك، سواء كنت تبحث عن مرطبات البشرة، السيرومات، واقيات الشمس، منتجات تنظيف البشرة، العناية بالشعر، الشامبو، البلسم، منتجات التصفيف، المكياج، العطور أو مستلزمات العناية الشخصية.مع تطبيق صيدلية اوتلت يمكنك:اكتشاف عروض وخصومات على مجموعة واسعة من المنتجاتالاستفادة من الكاش باك على الطلبات المؤهلةاستخدام رصيد محفظتك في مشترياتك القادمةالتسوق من منتجات العناية بالبشرة والشعر والجسماختيار منتجات المكياج والعطور والعناية الشخصيةالتسوق من مستلزمات الأم والطفلاكتشاف الفيتامينات والمكملات الغذائيةالبحث بسهولة عن المنتجات والعلامات التجاريةإضافة المنتجات إلى السلة وإتمام الطلب بسهولةمتابعة طلباتك من التطبيقالاستفادة من العروض والحملات المتوفرة عبر التطبيقالوصول إلى منتجاتك المفضلة بسرعة وسهولةفي صيدلية اوتلت نهتم بأن تكون تجربة التسوق أبسط وأكثر توفيرًا، لذلك نوفر لك خيارات متعددة من منتجات العناية والجمال والصحة مع عروض تساعدك على التوفير، بالإضافة إلى ميزة الكاش باك التي تمنحك رصيدًا تستفيد منه في طلباتك القادمة.سواء كنت تبحث عن منتجات لروتين العناية اليومي، منتجات للبشرة الجافة أو الدهنية، مستحضرات العناية بالشعر، المكياج، العطور أو منتجات الأسرة، ستجد خيارات متنوعة تساعدك على التسوق بسهولة من مكان واحد.حمل تطبيق صيدلية اوتلت الآن واكتشف تجربة تسوق تجمع بين التنوع، العروض، الكاش باك وسهولة الطلب.

- Intuitive and u
bluejetty:00024413:ios.description:
Bali Motorization App
CONVENIENT SHADE CONTROL FROM YOUR MOBILE DEVICE
Easy to set up and use, the Bali Motorization App makes life easier by giving you full control of your Bali Motorized Shades from your mobile device 
- Intuitive and user-friendly
- Powered by Bluetooth/Z-Wave technology.
- Monitors the battery life of your paired shades and remotes.
- Optional Bali Motorization Gateway (USB/plug) allows for shade control from anywhere in the world.
- Grant permission to family members to control shades through multi-user functionality.
For the optimal experience, the app has the ability to combine Bluetooth and Z-Wave for total control of your shades.
Bluetooth-Only Functionality
- Bluetooth-enabled shades pair easily to a mobile device without a gateway for in-home use.
- Enjoy full shade control with instant response time.
- Set up Routines to open and close multiple shades at specific times.
- Ability to update firmware for continued enhancements.
Bali Gateway (Z-Wave) Functionality
- Control your shades with the Bali App from anywhere in the world.
- Shades can be integrated with voice-controlled smart home devices, like Alexa and Google Home.
- Set up Routines to open and close multiple shades at specific times, such as sunrise and sunset.
- Ability to use new gateway plug as a smart plug, increasing your smart home experience.
- Easily control single or multiple motorized shades (recommended up to 7 shades per gateway device*) directly from your mobile device.
Safety: Look like you're at home—even when you're not—by raising and lowering shades automatically.
Energy Efficiency: About 30% of a home's heating energy is lost through windows. Automating allows you to strategically open shades to let sunlight help heat your home or close them to maximize insulation at the window. You can also reduce heat gain from sunlight in the summer.**
For the Sophisticated Home: From the beauty of Bali Shades to the beauty of cutting-edge control, Bali ensures each room makes a powerful, sophisticated statement.
*Number of shades per gateway depends on many factors, including the number of remotes added. Each shade associates exclusively with one gateway; you cannot control the same shade with multiple gateway devices. If a home requires more shades to be lifted, simply add another gateway device.
**Information provided by the consumer resource of the U.S. Department of Energy: energy.gov.

bluejetty:00114921:ios.summary:
Duck JAM 3D – A Cute & Clever Duck-Matching Puzzle
Step into a bright and relaxing puzzle world: A Duck-Matching Adventure!
Meet Duck JAM 3D — the charming match-3 puzzle where strategy meets adorable ducks. Collect and match three ducks
bluejetty:00114921:ios.description:
Duck JAM 3D – A Cute & Clever Duck-Matching Puzzle
Step into a bright and relaxing puzzle world: A Duck-Matching Adventure!
Meet Duck JAM 3D — the charming match-3 puzzle where strategy meets adorable ducks. Collect and match three ducks of the same color in your tray to clear them. But beware — you only have 7 slots to work with. Fill them all, and it’s game over!
As you progress, quirky mechanics appear to surprise you and keep every level fresh, fun, and challenging.
Quick Play Guide
• Start Simple: Tap a duck to collect it. Match three ducks of the same color to clear them from your tray.
• Plan Ahead: Pick ducks only if they have an open path. Keep your tray from overflowing.
• Master the Gimmicks: Learn how each unique mechanic changes the board.
• Use Magic Items: Undo mistakes, shuffle the board, instantly match ducks, or add bonus slots for extra breathing room.
Fun Mechanics
• Bucket – Ducks hiding in buckets appear when nearby ducks move.
• Pipes – Ducks emerge from pipes when the path is clear.
• Key & Underwater Tunnel – Unlock tunnels by activating the duck with the key.
• Bubble Bath – Clear ducks on the foam to reveal hidden ones below.
• Slides – Ducks slide in from the sides to keep you on your toes.
Cool Features
• Challenging Levels – Every stage offers a new twist on duck matching.
• Powerful Boosters – Undo, Shuffle, Instant Match, and Extra Slots to help in tight spots.
• Cute 3D Ducks – Bright, colorful designs that make every match satisfying.
• Rewarding Events:
· Flying Duck – Win streaks to collect big lighthouse rewards.
· Daily Tasks – Complete missions for gold and special items.
· Fish Blaze – Gather fish snacks for your ducks and trade them for prizes.
Why Play Okey Ducky 3D?
• Sharpen Your Mind: Match-3 strategy with a tray limit — every move matters.
• Relax & Enjoy: A soothing, colorful escape with adorable animations.
• Fresh Every Time: New gimmicks, daily missions, and event rewards keep it exciting.
Get ready to match, plan, and quack your way to victory.
Download Duck JAM 3D now and join the cutest puzzle adventure ever.

bluejetty:00014083:ios.name: Fax.Plus - Receive & Send Fax
bluejetty:00014083:ios.summary: Recognized as the best online fax service, Fax.Plus allows you to receive and send fax from iPhone or iPad. Using this secure and reliable online efax service, you can turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful fax machine and send free fax f
bluejetty:00014083:ios.description:
Recognized as the best online fax service, Fax.Plus allows you to receive and send fax from iPhone or iPad. Using this secure and reliable online efax service, you can turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful fax machine and send free fax from your device. You can get an online fax number and receive faxes on your phone as well.
Send fax from iPhone or iPad: On your iPhone or iPad device, you just need to use the built-in scanner to scan the document you wish to fax, add the recipient's fax number and send your fax right away. There is also the option to attach documents from your local storage or iCloud Drive.
Receive fax on your iPhone or iPad: You can get an online fax number from supported countries worldwide, and be notified via push notification as soon as there is a new fax in your inbox.
Encrypted archive: All sent and received faxes are stored in a fully encrypted archive for your future reference.
Scan documents: If you only have access to the physical document you wish to fax, you can use the built-in scanner and create a digital copy of your documents. The fax-ready documents can be adjusted and customized to increase the quality of your sent faxes.
Sign documents on the go: The electronic signature feature makes it easier than ever to sign documents and fax them back without even printing a single page.
HIPAA compliance: Activate advanced security controls and start faxing online with ease while staying fully compliant with HIPAA. 
Features and advantages:
• Send and receive faxes anytime and anywhere
• Send fax from email (email to fax)
• Programmable fax API
• Scan documents with your mobile camera (automatic document detection, border cropping, perspective correctness)
• Upload and attach your documents (Supported formats: Microsoft Office Documents, PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF) from your device or your cloud storage (Google Drive and Dropbox)
• Add a cover page to your fax with our ‘Add Text’ feature
• Sign your documents or faxes and send them back without printing them!
• Forward, reply or resend your faxes to any fax machine
• Send fax to your contacts stored in your mobile phonebook
• Organize your fax archive by adding notes to your sent and received faxes
• Schedule your fax to be sent at a defined date and time
• To ensure maximum delivery rate, enable the Retry for failed faxes feature available in the options of the Send Fax page. All failed to send faxes will be re-sent at an interval you define.
• Receive notification of your sent and received faxes to your email address. Need to notify more people? Configure up to 5 email addresses!
• Send fax to a Human Operated Fax Machine: By enabling this feature, your destination contact will hear a prerecorded message stating: "This is fax call, to receive please press start."
• HIPAA Compliant faxing*
A Wide range of plans for different needs
Entrepreneur, Professional or Company? Take a look at our range of plans to find the one that fits you best! Our range of plans start at $6.99 per month and allows you to get a local fax number from over 40 countries from which you can receive and send faxes to over 180 countries.
If you need to send a couple of faxes per month or per year, the free plan (also known as the pay as you go plan) enables you to buy credit to be used for sending faxes.
* Fax.Plus is HIPAA compliant, provided the user has advanced security controls activated and enters into a business associate agreement (BAA) with Fax.Plus. Advanced security controls are available on the Enterprise plan tier.
Any questions while using this secure and reliable online fax service? Do not hesitate to reach us on our website, app or by email at support@fax.plus. Our customer support team will be pleased to help you!
• Subscriptions
- Renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends.
- Privacy Policy: https://www.alohi.com/privacy-policy
- Apple Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
