bluejetty:00066344:ios.description:
Super Hit Baseball is a fast-paced arcade baseball game built for players who love competitive baseball games and high-energy sports games. This online multiplayer baseball game lets you swing for the fences, hit massive home runs, and compete in one of the most addictive baseball games on iOS.
If you’re searching for a quick and exciting baseball game instead of long simulation matches, Super Hit Baseball delivers short, action-packed innings designed for modern sports games fans. Every baseball game is built around simple tap controls and fast reactions, making this arcade batting game easy to play but difficult to master.
FEATURES:
• Play a fast 2-inning baseball game instead of traditional 9-inning formats
• Challenge friends in real-time multiplayer baseball games
• Experience smooth arcade action in a competitive sports game environment
• Unlock stadiums and build your ultimate team in this online baseball game
• Collect and upgrade 80+ superstar players in every baseball game
• Compete globally in ranked sports games leagues
Super Hit Baseball combines the thrill of classic baseball games with the accessibility of casual sports games. Whether you’re stepping into a quick batting game session or grinding through competitive multiplayer baseball games, every match keeps the intensity high.
EVENT MODES:
• HOME RUN DERBY – A powerful arcade batting game mode focused on pure hitting
• ELIMINATOR – Battle through opponents in tournament-style baseball games
• 1v1 ONLINE – Real-time multiplayer baseball game action
• BATTING PRACTICE – Sharpen your swing in a focused training batting game
Unlike many slow simulation sports games, Super Hit Baseball focuses on pure arcade action. Every baseball game emphasizes quick decisions, clean mechanics, and competitive energy. If you enjoy mobile baseball games that are easy to start but hard to dominate, this is the baseball game built for you.
This free online baseball game blends arcade gameplay with competitive multiplayer systems found in top sports games, while keeping every batting game session fast and rewarding. Climb the leaderboards, unlock new content, and prove you have what it takes to win every baseball game you enter.
Download Super Hit Baseball today and experience one of the most exciting baseball games and arcade sports games available on mobile.

bluejetty:00065836:ios.description:
Relax, pop with precision, and see how high you can climb.
Bubbles IQ is a feel-good bubble shooting puzzle for players who enjoy calm focus, satisfying progress, and a little friendly competition.
POP YOUR WAY
Take aim, find the right angle, and clear the bubbles. Easy to pick up and satisfying to master, Bubbles iQ is made for those quiet moments when you want to switch off, focus, and enjoy the game.
BUILD YOUR BRILLIANT SCORE
Every game contributes to your personal Brilliant Score. Follow your progress on your Scorecard and discover titles such as Genius, Strategist and more as you play.
CLIMB THE RANK IQ LEADERBOARDS
See how you rank each week in your city, your country, and around the world. Aim for the Top 50, Top 100 or Top 200 — or climb all the way to the top.
PLAY TOGETHER
Compare scores with friends, build your Team iQ, and climb together. Team up to earn free boosters, take on the weekly Men vs Women challenge, and see which side comes out on top.
BECOME iQ KING OR iQ QUEEN
Reach the top and claim your place as the reigning iQ King or iQ Queen. New weekly rankings mean there is always another chance to rise.
FEEL GOOD AS YOU GO
From Smart Move and Brilliant Mind to Braintastic and Genius Move, Bubbles iQ celebrates the satisfying little moments along the way.
Whether it is a coffee break, an evening wind-down, or a quiet moment before bed, Bubbles iQ is an easy game to return to again and again.
Relax your mind.
Sharpen your aim.
Rise through the ranks.
Download Bubbles iQ and start building your Brilliant Score.

bluejetty:00144015:ios.description:
With the EZsheet app, you can get ready for your exams anytime, anywhere! Just download it to your iPhone and Apple Watch, add the subjects you need and write the answers to your exam questions. EZsheet allows to not only to enter the text manually, but also to instantly import entire documents in popular formats like DOC, DOCX, PDF, and others.
EZsheet supports both text and various graphic content: photos, pictures, diagrams, formulas, etc. You will be able to download the maximum information into the application for full-fledged and quality preparation for your exam. 
The main thing, do not forget to sync you iPhone app with your Apple Watch; it can be done by a single button press. EZsheet settings allow adjusting the font transparency and size for learning the answers comfortably anywhere: in a cafe, in a bus, or even in your bed at home!
The EZsheet app will make your exam preparation as convenient, enjoyable, and of course effective as possible! The standard version of the app is available for free, while the Premium subscription is $0.99 for 1 month. It allows downloading entire documents so as not to rewrite the text manually.
Once you have a Premium subscription, you can cancel it for free within 7 days. The subscription will automatically renew in 24 hours after the end of your 1-month subscription period. You can disable the auto-renewal option in the app settings at least one day before the Premium subscription expires. The payment will be charged to your iTunes account.

Privacy Policy: https://ezsheet.app/api/policy

Pregnant or breastfeeding women are often to
bluejetty:00021887:ios.description:
Don’t compromise your or your baby’s health. Get peace of mind by knowing which medications, vaccines, and supplements are safe for you to take without harming your baby...and which ones aren't!
Pregnant or breastfeeding women are often told to choose between their baby’s health and their own treatment. Many times, there are safe medication options that shouldn’t be overlooked! 
With this app, Drs. Thomas Hale and Kaytlin Krutsch bring you the information healthcare providers use in their textbook ‘Medication and Mothers’ Milk’--straight into the hands of moms. They believe moms deserve to know this information; written at a level they can understand. Their InfantRisk Center team at Texas Tech University Health Science Center is known worldwide for 25+ years of research on maternal transfer of drugs to babies.
Features:
-Easy rating system from safest (1) to most hazardous (5)
-Scan medication boxes for safety ratings
-Search over 70,000 drugs and medications
-Easy to use interface
Are you a healthcare provider? Try our more in-depth app, InfantRisk HCP.
Subscription:
Price: $4.99 USD
Duration: 1 Year
Account will be charged for renewal unless canceled within 24 hours of the end date.
Terms of Use: https://www.infantrisk.com/mommymeds-terms-use

bluejetty:00076546:ios.description:
Facecam Record-Screen Recorder records everything in High-Definition without limits. Start recording with one tap.
Use Teleprompter feature to quickly make your videos using auto running scripts and never forget what you have to say while recording a video. You can write your own script or generate one by using the advanced Chatgpt service.
Features Highlights - Screen Recorder, Teleprompter, Voice Changer, Face Cam & Add Commentary.
Key Features in Facecam- Screen Recorder & Teleprompter
- Record videos in 1080p. You can also change your resolution manually.
- Let's set your bitrate.
- Record awesome videos in 60FPS
- Add audio & music to recordings & videos.
- Add filters, effects & transitions to your recordings.
- Use Screen Recorder in 11 Languages from around the world.

- Set recording duration or record without limits.
- Ability to change the resolution of Facecam.
- Share your recordings on social media and become a star.

- React on Videos using the Facecam feature
- Record Videos & Change Voice using Voice Changer
- Add your Commentary to videos
- Use Chatgpt AI Assistant to generate scripts
Screen Recorder - This feature gives you direct access to record anything quickly and you can use different resolution, bitrate & framerate.
It gives you an option to record screen in HD using resolution of upto 1080 HD, 12 MBPS bitrate & 60 FPS framerate. 
Teleprompter - This feature lets you create videos while reading your script that will appear while recording, you can write your own script or generate one using the Chatgpt service.
Face Cam - Easily react to videos to add your views on them and share them on multiple social media platforms like - Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp or Snapchat etc.
Voice Changer - With this amazing feature, you can easily change voice for your audio or video recordings. You get multiple voice changing option to add to your audio or video. 
Commentary - Add your comments to recorded videos or record a new one with your views on it and share them on other platforms.
Some of the data we collect
- Device-specific information such as device model, OS version being used. This provides knowledge of how our application is being used so we can improve the user experience and the app itself.
- We collect anonymized data such as statistics, analytics, insights about your activity in order to provide you a reliable and high-quality experience.
- Payment data & an optional Email (if using paid Services).

- No Ads Interruption

bluejetty:00168100:ios.summary: Hey there! Welcome to Devil Run Troll Level Again, a super fun game with a cheeky little twist. Your mission? Just get to the door at the end of each level to win. Easy-peasy, you might say, but hold on! You're in for some surprises – like
bluejetty:00168100:ios.description:
Hey there! Welcome to Devil Run Troll Level Again, a super fun game with a cheeky little twist. Your mission? Just get to the door at the end of each level to win. Easy-peasy, you might say, but hold on! You're in for some surprises – like sneaky holes that pop up when you least expect them, spikes that suddenly start moving, and even ceilings that seem to have a mind of their own and come tumbling down. You'll find every level has its own unique flavor of fun. Just remember, if you slip up, you'll have to start again. So, think on your feet, roll with the punches, and most importantly, keep that smile on your face. 
Why play Devil Run Troll Level Again:
- Over 100 levels packed with fun that'll keep you hooked!
- It's a breeze to start playing, but oh boy, mastering it is another story.
- Gorgeous, simple graphics that'll make your heart do a little dance.
- Buzzsaws are part of the mix, but they're the friendly kind!
How to play Devil Run Troll Level Again:
- Move your character using the arrow keys or the touchscreen.
- Jump over gaps and dodge the dangers that come your way.
- Keep your eyes peeled for spikes, pits, and sneaky obstacles that can trip you up.
- Make it to the end of each devilishly fun level to win.
Patience is key, and you might need a few tries to get it right. Watch the bad guys and traps closely, and plan your moves and jumps. The game's super enjoyable because it's tough – it'll keep you on your toes with surprises and timings that need to be just right.
Remember, it's a tough game, but oh so satisfying when you beat it! If you're looking for a fun devil troll game, Devil Run Troll Level Again is developed for you.
Do you have the courage to conquer these hellish levels and vanquish the devil himself? Step into Devil Run Troll Level Again and don't die again!

Transform your mind and body with Somatic Yoga by SomYoga. Our app offers easy and beginner-friendly somatic yoga exercises suitable for all ages. Join our 30 day somatic yoga challenge with 7-8 exercises daily to enhance your wellness journey.
Key Features:
- Beginner-Friendly: Simple and accessible somatic yoga exercises for all ages
- 30-Day Challenge: Participate in a 30 day somatic yoga challenge with daily somatic exercises
- Customizable Plans: Select and customize your yoga routine with a list of somatic exercises
- Progress Tracking: Monitor your progress with BMI tracking, weight tracking, and water tracking
- Expert Guidance: Step by step instructions from yoga instructors.
Embark on your wellness journey with Somatic Yoga by SomYoga. Our app is designed to provide beginner friendly yoga routines that anyone can follow. Whether you're new to yoga or looking to deepen your practice, our somatic yoga app offers the perfect blend of somatic exercises and customizable plans.
Join our 30 day somatic yoga challenge and experience the benefits of a dedicated practice. Each day, you'll be guided through 7-8 somatic exercises designed to improve your flexibility, strength, and overall well-being. Plus, with our progress tracking features, you can easily monitor your BMI, weight, and water intake to stay on track with your goals.
Customize your yoga routine by selecting from a wide range of somatic exercises that cater to your needs. Whether you want to focus on relaxation, strength-building, or flexibility, our somatic workout app allows you to create a plan that works best for you.
In addition to somatic yoga, our somatic exercise app also includes somatic workout options for those looking to intensify their practice. The combination of somatic yoga and somatic workouts ensures a holistic approach to wellness.
Download Somatic Yoga by SomYoga now and start your journey towards a healthier, more balanced life. Our somatic yoga app is perfect for anyone looking to incorporate beginner friendly yoga into their daily routine.

bluejetty:00133201:ios.description:
Whoa! Seems like you have a weird taste if you've landed on this page, huh?
But since you are here, get ready to flip your stress away while I flip out!
Flop
Oh, hi there. I’m Flop— the unfortunate character you’re about to torment. My job? To suffer through your relentless poking, kissing, flipping, and even feeding me. Sounds delightful, doesn’t it? For you, sure. For me? Not so much. Each interaction you gleefully enjoy fills up my anger bar. Watch it fill up as I slowly lose my cool—because apparently, that’s the highlight of your day.
Widgets
And just when I thought it couldn’t get worse, there are widgets—interactive little nightmares pinned right to your home screen. You can fidget and flip anytime you want, without even opening the app. Because why limit my suffering to when you’re actually using the app? Now you can annoy me anytime, anywhere. Lucky me.
Fidgets
The app is packed with stress-relieving fidgets and mini-games designed to help you unwind. The catch? Every time you de-stress, I get more stressed out. So while you’re getting all calm and zen, I’m over here having a virtual meltdown. Thanks a lot.
Oh, and one more thing…Don’t forget to visit me every day. Seriously, don’t.
Download Flop today and start your journey to relaxation at my expense. Let’s get this over with, shall we?
LIFETIME LICENSE
A one-time purchase of a lifetime license grants access to all widgets and features without any further fees.

bluejetty:00140486:ios.name: Stoic Quotes & Journal – Stojo
bluejetty:00140486:ios.summary: Start your day a little slower, taking a breath before everything begins to move. Stojo brings Stoic reflection into real life through small, simple habits you can actually keep. Each morning, a short quote and a few gentle lines invite you
bluejetty:00140486:ios.description:
Start your day a little slower, taking a breath before everything begins to move. Stojo brings Stoic reflection into real life through small, simple habits you can actually keep. Each morning, a short quote and a few gentle lines invite you to pause, write a bit, and notice what matters most. Open Stojo, jot down a few thoughts, and begin your day feeling grounded and clear!
Reflect with Intention
Stojo is built around the idea that philosophy only matters when you live it. Each quote or journaling prompt is a chance to pause and ask yourself how those words fit your day. Some days you’ll write a lot, others just a few sentences. What matters is the habit of reflection. These small pauses often bring more understanding than hours of overthinking.
Your Thoughts Stay Yours
It’s your quiet corner to write, just between you and the page. With time, it begins to feel familiar, almost like a space that listens while you untangle your thoughts. Many people describe Stojo as the first place they’ve felt safe enough to write freely again.
Notice Your Progress
The change you’ll feel is quiet but steady. Stojo shows gentle reminders of how your writing grows, how many days you’ve written, how many words you’ve added. You might start to see patterns in what worries you or notice that old frustrations fade faster. It’s not about tracking for perfection but seeing proof of how steady reflection adds up.
Ancient Ideas, Modern Clarity
At its heart, Stoicism teaches calm in motion. You pause, breathe, and focus on what’s within reach. That small moment can change how the whole day feels.
A Habit That Shapes Character
At first, Stojo feels like a journaling app. Then it becomes a quiet routine that steadies your mind. You begin to expect that pause, that few minutes of writing that help you reset. Over time, the changes appear quietly, with less noise in your thoughts, more patience in your actions, and a clearer view when things get difficult. That’s the Stoic idea of discipline, balance built over time.
Why People Enjoy Using Stojo
Most start to ease stress, then keep going because it helps them stay centered.
- It helps ease stress and bring a sense of calm.
- It keeps thoughts grounded through short daily reflections.
- It encourages awareness instead of quick reactions.

bluejetty:00065257:ios.name: Rapunzl: Simulate. Invest. Win
bluejetty:00065257:ios.summary: Rapunzl makes financial literacy engaging, fun, and accessible for every student. With Rapunzl, learners experience the stock market in real-time, practice real-world financial scenarios in our budgeting game, and explore relatable personal
bluejetty:00065257:ios.description:
Rapunzl makes financial literacy engaging, fun, and accessible for every student. With Rapunzl, learners experience the stock market in real-time, practice real-world financial scenarios in our budgeting game, and explore relatable personal finance concepts through an interactive, gamified learning platform with scholarship competitions.
The rules are simple: We give each student $10,000 to build real-time stock and crypto portfolios. Students then create simulated long and short stock positions, enter their portfolio into scholarship competitions, and unlock their investor potential - all while never risking a dollar.
Conquer the stock market with simulated investing. Follow friends’ & family’s simulated stock portfolios; add companies’ stocks to your investing watchlist; and explore the worlds of investing & finance.
LEARN BY DOING
Rapunzl helps make every student feel as confident as a Wall Street investor able to take charge of their personal finances, without any of the risk. Rapunzl allows students to learn the trade of investing, master the highs & lows of the stock market, and win scholarship prizes just for building a portfolio and joining the competition!
Learn to Invest with a risk-free $10,000 simulated portfolio tracking over 8,000 stocks in real-time by using our simulated stock market game.
Make budgeting decisions in our interactive life skills game that teaches saving, spending, and credit management in order to practice everyday financial choices and understand trade-offs.
Develop personal finance skills aligned with national standards across topics like banking, credit, loans, and investing.
Compete in scholarship competitions that reward learning and engagement with funds to support post-secondary education.
Track Your Progress – Access curriculum resources, monitor learning progress, and track your portfolio’s growth throughout your investor journey.
BUILT FOR CLASSROOMS, OR ANYWHERE
Rapunzl is designed for middle school and high school students but loved by learners of all ages. Whether used as part of a classroom curriculum or as a standalone budgeting and investing app, Rapunzl connects academic standards to real-world skills that prepare students for college, careers, and lifelong money management.
Our entire program aligns with state and national financial literacy and personal finance standards, making it an ideal companion for teachers delivering consumer education or economics courses.
Teachers can integrate Rapunzl into lessons, while students use the app independently to reinforce concepts. Parents can also use Rapunzl at home to spark meaningful conversations about saving, investing, and responsible money management - while giving their kids a safe space to practice money skills critical for adulthood.
WHY PEOPLE LOVE RAPUNZL
Students love Rapunzl because it connects what they learn in school to real-world money decisions. Rapunzl shows them how investing works, budgeting choices add up, and financial literacy opens doors. The competitive element keeps students motivated, while scholarships create a direct link between effort and reward.
Ultimately, Rapunzl provides classrooms with a financial lens to view the world and helps students see themselves as investors.
That's why teachers have trusted Rapunzl since 2018 and why we already work with more than 50,000 students each school year. Join today and get started with your investor journey.
DISCLAIMERS
Rapunzl is a simulated investing and personal finance education app. No real money is traded, and competitions are for educational purposes only. Scholarships, not cash prizes, are awarded in select competitions. Rapunzl is not a broker-dealer or investment advisor. Users under 13 cannot create accounts; students aged 13–17 may participate with teacher or parent supervision. Competitions are not affiliated with Apple.

bluejetty:00120497:ios.summary:
Learn prepositions in English and grammar free by putting the prepositions in place to form correct sentences and sayings.
Preposition Master is a fun and educational game for kids and English language students of all ages who want to lear
bluejetty:00120497:ios.description:
Learn prepositions in English and grammar free by putting the prepositions in place to form correct sentences and sayings.
Preposition Master is a fun and educational game for kids and English language students of all ages who want to learn and improve their language skills in a more entertaining way.
How do you play?
It’s easy. The game consists of putting the prepositions from each level in the correct place to form a correct sentence. (Beginner, competent, professional, expert, sayings.)
If you make a mistake and click the incorrect preposition, there is a time penalty.
Once you have completed the sentence you will receive a score based on how fast you were and your total number of errors.
You can share your knowledge with other players worldwide thanks to online multiplayer mode or with your friends on Game Center.
Are you an English expert who wants to show off your skills? Are you an English student who wants to improve your skills? Preposition Master will help you use prepositions in sentences correctly.
Preposition Master is the first game of its kind designed and developed completely by educators to help students improve one of the biggest problems language learners all face, correct use of prepositions. With four levels from beginner to expert, Preposition Master is a challenge for everyone from the Beginner to the most seasoned English language communicators. The Proverbs and Sayings level is a great way to learn and remember popular English idioms and expressions.
These are the levels:
Beginner: Ideal for children. This level contains the easiest sentences with the fewest prepositions to work with.
Competent: This is where things start to get harder. This level is great for learners who are a bit farther along in their English language learning adventure.
Professional: Great for users with a solid base in English who want to keep their skills up to date.
Expert: Only for those with the most proficient English skills. Are you one of them?
Do you have what it takes to become the next Preposition Master? Try your luck in single player mode or against friends and other players worldwide.
Learn English with a smile on your face.

bluejetty:00178122:ios.name: Gluten Free Scanner
bluejetty:00178122:ios.summary:
Scan any barcode to find out if the product is gluten free - get a result in seconds. If the product contains gluten, the result tells you why.
Built for people with coeliac disease and gluten intolerance, whether you're shopping for yours
bluejetty:00178122:ios.description:
Scan any barcode to find out if the product is gluten free - get a result in seconds. If the product contains gluten, the result tells you why.
Built for people with coeliac disease and gluten intolerance, whether you're shopping for yourself or for someone else.
- INSTANT: point the camera at a barcode and get your answer before you put the box down
- MILLIONS OF PRODUCTS: more added every day
- FREE TO DOWNLOAD AND SCAN: no account needed, no sign-up and no limits
- SIX LANGUAGES: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish
- WORKS OFFLINE: the whole database, downloaded to your phone
- SCAN HISTORY: everything you scan, saved for next time
IT NAMES THE INGREDIENT
A red light is only half an answer. When a product contains gluten, the result also names the ingredient responsible, wherever the database has that detail, so you start spotting the usual suspects on labels yourself.
JUST DIAGNOSED?
The first weeks of a gluten free diet are a crash course. What has gluten in it? Is soy sauce gluten free? Which beer can you still drink? The app answers those questions while you find your feet, so the supermarket stops feeling like an exam.
MISSING PRODUCT? GET AN ANSWER ANYWAY
Sooner or later you'll scan something the app hasn't seen before. Photograph the barcode, the name, and the ingredients list, and in most cases you'll have a verdict while you're still in the aisle. If it needs a human eye, we review it, and your addition is there for the next person who picks up that product.
"I just got diagnosed with celiac disease and I had no clue what was gluten-free and what contains gluten. I am loving this app so far." — App Store review
OFFLINE MODE (PREMIUM)
Supermarket dead spots, basement aisles, flights. Download the database once over Wi-Fi and scanning carries on with no signal at all; it refreshes itself the next time you open the app online. It packs well, too: scan your way round a supermarket abroad with mobile data switched off.
SCAN HISTORY (PREMIUM)
Everything you scan is saved, so you look a product up once and the answer is waiting next week. No more trying to remember which brand it was that passed.
SHARE WHAT YOU FIND
Scanning for a child, a partner, or a friend? Share a product's result in one tap, so everyone doing the shopping sees the same answer.
FOR EVERY GLUTEN FREE SHOPPER
Coeliac disease, non-coeliac gluten sensitivity, a gluten intolerance, or a coeliac friend coming to dinner: the question in the aisle is the same. Is it gluten free? Scan snacks, cereals, bread, pasta, sauces, chocolate, and drinks on the weekly shop, and get a straight answer on each one.
A NOTE ON GLUTEN
Gluten comes from wheat, barley, rye, spelt, and triticale. On a label it hides behind names like barley malt, malt extract, wheat starch, and hydrolysed wheat protein, and it turns up where you least expect it: soy sauce, stock cubes, soups, sweets, and beer. The app reads the ingredients recorded for a product and flags the ones that mean gluten, so you're not decoding every label on your own. It can't detect cross-contamination or "may contain" traces, so always check the packaging, and talk to your doctor about managing coeliac disease.
Install it before your next shop and try it on whatever's in the cupboard.
Scanning is free. Premium unlocks Offline Mode and Scan History, monthly or yearly, with the price shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase; subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Terms and Privacy Policy:
- https://glutenfreescanner.app/terms-and-conditions
- https://glutenfreescanner.app/privacy-policy

Coeliac disease, non-coeliac gluten sensitivity, a gluten intolerance, or a coeliac friend coming to dinner: the question in the aisle is the same. Is it gluten free? Scan snacks, cereals, bread, pasta, sauces, chocolate, and drinks on the weekly shop, and get a straight answer on each one.

A NOTE ON GLUTEN
Gluten comes from wheat, barley, rye, spelt, and triticale. On a label it hides behind names like barley malt, malt extract, wheat starch, and hydrolysed wheat protein, and it turns up where you least expect it: soy sauce, stock cubes, soups, sweets, and beer. The app reads the ingredients recorded for a product and flags the ones that mean gluten, so you're not decoding every label on your own. It can't detect cross-contamination or "may contain" traces, so always check the packaging, and talk to your doctor about managing coeliac disease.

Install it before your next shop and try it on whatever's in the cupboard.

Scanning is free. Premium unlocks Offline Mode and Scan History, monthly or yearly, with the price shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase; subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. bluejetty:00079691:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00079691:ios.description:
Birda is birdwatching, reimagined.
Birda is more than a birdwatching app, it’s your companion for getting outside, noticing more, and reconnecting with nature. Whether you’re spotting your first bird or chasing your next life tick, Birda helps you identify birds, track your progress, and share the experience with a friendly global community.
Modern life pulls us indoors. Birda helps you push back.
From gardens and local patches to national parks and far-flung adventures, Birda makes birding more fun, more rewarding, and easier to stick with.
IDENTIFY BIRDS - Identify birds your way. Use powerful AI to identify birds from photos (even blurry ones), describe a bird in your own words with AI text identification, or explore Birda’s beautifully detailed species guide with photos, bird calls, maps, and key ID tips. Not quite sure yet? Post your sighting and let the Birda community help confirm the ID so you learn faster and grow your confidence with every bird you see.
RECORD YOUR SIGHTINGS - Log birds in seconds, whether it’s a single sighting or a full birding session. Birda keeps everything in one place, so your birding memories don’t fade, they grow.
STAY ORGANISED - Birda automatically records dates and locations, manages your sessions, and creates elegant life lists for you, from garden and patch lists to country and global totals. Spend less time logging and sorting, and more time out in the field discovering new species.
DISCOVER MORE BIRDS - Find birdwatching hotspots near you, see what others are spotting, and explore birds from around the world. Planning a trip or just curious? Discover what’s being seen and where right now.
A FRIENDLY BIRDING COMMUNITY - Birding is better together. Share sightings, swap tips, celebrate wins, and help each other learn. Whether you’re asking for ID help or offering it, Birda is a welcoming place for birders of all levels.
MAKE A REAL DIFFERENCE - Every sighting you log helps more than just you. Birda shares data with the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF), supporting real-world research and conservation efforts, turning everyday birding into meaningful impact.
GOALS, CHALLENGES & MOTIVATION - Stay inspired with birding challenges, achievement badges, and personal milestones. Birda helps you build healthy habits, spend more time outdoors, and enjoy the simple joy of noticing wildlife around you.
SYNC YOUR BIRDING HISTORY - Already use other platforms? Easily import sightings from eBird, Merlin Bird ID, BirdTrack, BirdLasser, iNaturalist, and more. You’re always free to export your data, your birding history stays yours.
LIFE LISTS THAT GROW WITH YOU - Birda automatically builds life lists organised by time, place, and region, so you can see your progress unfold, from your first bird to your biggest year yet.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST - You’re in control. Set privacy zones around your home, hide sensitive locations, and decide exactly what you share, birding safely and responsibly.
BUILT FOR SERIOUS & CURIOUS BIRDERS - Birda brings together curious beginners and seasoned birders in one welcoming community. Learn from others, share what you know, and grow your birding skills at your own pace, whether you’re identifying your first bird or helping others confirm theirs.
Whether you’re brand new to birding or have years of experience, Birda is for you.
Download Birda today, head outside, and start noticing more of the natural world, one bird at a time.
Reconnect with nature. Learn as you go. Make every sighting count.
Community Standards: https://birda.org/community-standards/
Terms of Service: https://birda.org/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://birda.org/privacy/

bluejetty:00074125:ios.description:
In this 3D visual novel, follow failed screenwriter Junon as she attempts to make it through the most pivotal day in her life. Relive the past, alter the present, and embrace the future, or without your help, Junon’s story might end in a wreck.
At 36, Junon’s life is in pieces: her career has stalled, she’s emotionally numb, and her personal life is falling apart. Things come to a head when she’s called to the ER to find her estranged mother in a critical condition. This is the most important day of Junon’s life, and unless something changes, it might be her last.
Relive the Past. 
Experience Junon’s memories and piece together the story of her past, including the tragic secret that lies at its centre.
Alter the Present. 
Use your understanding of Junon’s trauma to change how she navigates the day, unlocking new dialogue options and healing broken relationships.
Embrace the Future. 
When you’re at rock bottom, there’s nowhere to go but up. Help Junon find peace with herself and discover the humor, beauty and hope that lie even on life’s bleakest days.
• A deep, intimate narrative
• Dialogs that feel real and nuanced
• 10 memories to explore
• Elegant art style
• Game fully dubbed in English

bluejetty:00027363:ios.description:
Train Effective is the #1 digital soccer academy.
We are democratising access to pro soccer training, making it available on-demand and right from your pocket. This soccer training app delivers one of the most comprehensive learning platforms for aspiring soccer players of every level. Train Effective enables its members to experience professional academy-like soccer training at home. You will improve your 1. technique, 2. tactical knowledge, 3. fitness and 4. mentality.
PRO SOCCER TRAINING CREATED BY UEFA LICENSED COACHES & PREMIER LEAGUE EXPERTS
Our soccer training app is compiled of over 150 soccer drills, soccer training sessions, workouts and soccer programs from perfecting your passing & dribbling skills to reaching your peak fitness level.
Regardless if you're just starting to learn how to play soccer or if you’re already a soccer academy player, the wide variety of skills and drills will help you progress further into your soccer career. With new content added monthly, you get access to the latest and best soccer training drills and never run out of ways to improve.
BECOME A SMARTER SOCCER PLAYER THROUGH TACTICAL SESSIONS DELIVERED BY PREMIER LEAGUE ANALYSTS
Game Brain is our performance analysis training tool, created to give soccer players a step-by-step understanding of professional soccer players’ decisions, tactics and strategies. Using the knowledge and expertise of our English Premier League analysts we allow to not only train like a pro but also think like a pro. 
INCREASE YOUR MENTAL STRENGTH THROUGH OUR MENTALITY TRAINING SESSIONS TAUGHT BY PROFESSIONAL ATHLETES & EXPERTS
Imagine soccer stars like Rio Ferdinand and other world-class athletes giving you insights from their vast experience and training you on the mental skills needed to get that edge over your competition. Our classroom training sessions deliver exactly this. Episode after episode on topics such as what it takes to become the best soccer player in the world, self-belief, motivation, managing a soccer injury, discipline… to name just a few. Get prepared to make your next step towards the best version of yourself and your soccer goals!
PLAN & SCHEDULE YOUR SOCCER TRAINING, 365 DAYS OF THE YEAR
Our simple and easy to use tracker allows you to plan and schedule your soccer training with ease. Simply find your preferred soccer training session, workout or programme and add it to your chosen day. The tracker is designed to keep you accountable, track your progress and help you improve your soccer skills faster!
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Download Train Effective for free now! Get access to all features and soccer training sessions with our Pro plans, which are available in the app through different subscriptions. The subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.

bluejetty:00041163:ios.name: Phone
bluejetty:00041163:ios.summary:
Make and receive calls with the Phone app.
• Phone calls, FaceTime audio calls and FaceTime video calls all in one place.
• Choose a new unified layout that brings together your Favorites, Recents, and Voicemails
• Favorites offers one-tap
bluejetty:00041163:ios.description:
Make and receive calls with the Phone app.
• Phone calls, FaceTime audio calls and FaceTime video calls all in one place.
• Choose a new unified layout that brings together your Favorites, Recents, and Voicemails
• Favorites offers one-tap shortcuts for calls and messages to your most important contacts.
• Recents displays recent conversations and missed calls. Search for previous calls, transcribed voicemails, and contacts using a broad range of search criteria.
• Voicemail Summaries powered by Apple Intelligence appear in-line with missed calls and help surface the most important information.
• Keypad search lets you quickly find and call existing contacts by typing in their name or number with the alphanumeric keypad.
• Contact Posters let you customize exactly how you appear when you give someone a call. Choose from various treatments for photos, Memoji and your name.
• Record live calls or FaceTime audio calls from the Phone app and review the transcripts in the Notes app. When you start a recording, the Phone app automatically announces that the call is being recorded.
• Visual Voicemail offers a written transcript of your voicemails. Save Visual Voicemail messages as notes, voice memos, or share them using Messages, Mail or AirDrop.*
• Live Voicemail lets you see a real-time transcription as someone is leaving you a message, and you can pick up the call if it’s something you want to address in the moment.
• Automatic Mic Mode picks the right Mic Mode for you. Voice Isolation blocks out ambient noise and spotlights your voice. Wide Spectrum will leave ambient noises unfiltered, allowing your voice and all the sounds around you to be heard.
• Text responses make it easy to send a response in a single tap when you can’t pick up a call. Use suggested replies, or create your own custom text responses.
• Remind Me Later helps you remember to return calls that you can’t pick up in the moment.
• Hold Assist lets the Phone app wait on hold for you and alerts you once a live agent is available.
• Call Screening lets you screen incoming calls from unknown numbers. Your phone will pick up the call for you and ask for a name and reason for the call before the phone even rings.
• Call Context uses Apple Intelligence to help surface relevant information — like a confirmation code — when you call a business.
• Silence Unknown Callers gives you the option to automatically send unknown numbers to voicemail. Your phone will only ring for people in your contacts, recent outgoing calls, and Siri Suggestions.
• Blocked Contacts allows you to identify unwanted callers and blocks phone and FaceTime calls from those numbers.
• A range of ringtones and vibrations allow you to choose distinct alerts for certain people.
• Wi-Fi Calling lets you make or receive a phone call on a Wi-Fi connection, so you can stay connected in areas with little or no cellular coverage.*
• Dial Assist automatically determines the correct international or local prefix when dialing.
• Call Waiting allows someone to call you while you’re already on another call.*
• Call Forwarding relays calls made to your number to another number that you specify.*
Apple Watch Features:
• Make and answer phone calls right from your wrist.
• When you hear or feel the call, send the call to voicemail, answer using your iPhone or send a message.
• While you’re on a call, adjust the call volume, use the keypad or even switch the call to your iPhone.
• Listen to voicemails.
• Ask Siri to call someone in your contacts.
*Requires carrier support

bluejetty:00151949:ios.description:
Discover Movies Differently with Onstream
Whether you’re searching for the perfect movie for tonight or rediscovering a timeless classic, Onstream transforms how you explore entertainment. With powerful AI that understands your personality, smart recommendations, deep content insights, and intuitive viewing-management tools, your movie and TV experience becomes more personal, intelligent, and inspiring.
Onstream isn’t just another movie app—it’s your personal entertainment companion. Discover hidden gems, track your habits, and dive into stories that truly match your vibe.
Why You’ll Love Onstream
– AI Movie Matcher
Let our intelligent AI analyze your taste and personality to suggest the perfect movie or series—especially when you don’t know what to watch next.
– Custom Watchlists
Save favorites, organize your must-watch list, and keep all your movie nights perfectly planned.
– Curated Collections
Explore themed selections by mood, genre, personality, or trending topics—meticulously tailored just for you.
– Nearby Cinemas
Find cinemas near your location instantly and check showtimes in a single tap.
– Fun Movie Quiz
Challenge your movie knowledge with engaging trivia and unlock new discoveries along the way.
– Smart Movie Planner
Plan what to watch and when. Perfect for scheduling movie nights, binge weekends, or personal watch goals.
– Detailed Movie & Series Info
Access cast details, ratings, reviews, summaries, trailers, and everything you need before choosing the next title.
Elevate Your Movie Nights
Download Onstream today and unlock a world of stories crafted around your personality, mood, and unique taste—all in one beautifully designed app.

bluejetty:00064080:ios.description:
Design Award 2013 Winner!
Launched as Editor's choice on the AppStore!
Slide To Play - 4 out of 4 
AppSpy - 5 out of 5 
PocketGamer - Gold Award 
Digitally Downloaded - 4.5 out of 5 
iReviewT - 10 out of 10
PocketGamer - "Gorgeous to look at and with a control system to suit every taste"
Digitally Downloaded - "a true home console experience to iOS"
Slide To Play - "hits the sweet spot between arcade and sim"
AppSpy - "pairing gorgeous visuals and rock-solid controls"
THIS IS THE ULTIMATE WWII AIR COMBAT GAME! You’ll participate in visceral dogfights, protect
cities and fleets, bomb enemy structures and even fly through tunnels. Everything is set up in accurately
recreated real life locations like Pearl Harbor, Coast of Dover, Midway, Germany and France.
AMAZING QUALITY AND IT’S ONLY ON iOS!
Unparalleled visuals, special effects and audio including: specular masks, bump mapping, atmospheric
scattering, volumetric clouds with realistic lighting, sun glare, day & night transitions, God rays, high
definition textures, 4x anisotropic filtering, High Dynamic Range (HDR) rendering, radial blur, heat haze,
refractive raindrops and more!
IMMERSIVE GAMEPLAY
Take off and land on landing strips and carriers. You will fly in fully recreated cities with realistic
weather, accurate atmospheric scattering with aerial perspective and highly detailed planes with
interactive cockpits.
HUGE HISTORIC FLEET
Fly highly detailed WWII top aces planes. Watch the progressive damage affecting planes and finally
being shredded into pieces.
HUGE COLLECTION OF ONLINE MODES 
Invite your friends to play online! Choose between cooperative and competitive modes: Survival, Last
Man Standing, Free Flight, Free for All, Team Match, Capture the Flag and the new Assault. Use Game
Center head to head with Voice Chat for the ultimate duel experience.
GAME CENTER, AirPlay and iCloud
Since this all takes place on Apple devices, iCloud support has been integrated so players can save
and share progress across devices while AirPlay allows them to use an Apple TV to play the game on a
large display. Climb the Game Center leaderboards, challenge friends and unlock all achievements.
UNIVERSAL APP
Play Sky Gamblers: Storm Raiders on iPhone 3GS, iPhone 4, iPhone 4S, iPhone 5, iPad, iPad 2, 3 rd
gen iPad and the new iPad, iPod touch 3, iPod touch 4 and iPod touch 5 for one low price.
Online play requires a Wi-Fi or 3G/4G internet connection.
Please send us your impressions and suggestions, help us identify bugs. We want to make your gaming
experience the best you’ve ever had. Please visit our support site at www.atypicalgames.com/support.
Like us on Facebook: www.facebook.com/atypicalgames
Follow us on Twitter @atypicalgames

bluejetty:00140973:ios.description:
Welcome to the enchanting world of Blush Blush, where romance meets whimsy in a captivating anime-style idle dating sim designed exclusively for you, the chosen one!
Get ready to embark on a unique journey as you laugh, cry, and fall in love with the charming boys of Blush Blush. This extraordinary game, a delightful blend of a dating sim and idle clicker, is brought to you by the creators of Crush Crush. Immerse yourself in an addictive mix of idle mechanics and heartwarming dating experiences that will keep you coming back for more!
Features:
Cursed Boys:
In the whimsical world of Blush Blush, a peculiar curse has turned a group of unlucky men into adorable animals. They're cute, cuddly, and a tad concerned. Fear not! You, with your magical powers of friendship and love, are here to break the curse.
Diverse Cast:
With a diverse and ever-growing cast of characters, Blush Blush offers a guy for everyone. From shy, bookish introverts to daring adventurers and literal princes, you'll find a range of unique personalities to chat, date, and gift your way into their hearts.
Time Management:
Balance your time wisely by working jobs to make money and spending time on hobbies to level up your stats. Patience, dedication, and a touch of strategy are key to your progress. Unlock extra time blocks and speed boosts to enhance your dating experience and discover new guys.
Memory Album:

CalDiet: Your Personal Health Intelligence Platform
Meet Food Analysis Pal, your AI-powered partner from CalDiet, designed to transform how you understand food and own your diet journey. We combine precise analysis with intuitive planning to make healthy living insightful and achievable.
Deep Food Intelligence: Know What You Eat
Transform any food item into strategic insight. Our proprietary engine evaluates foods against a multi-dimensional matrix—yielding not just macros, but a Health Impact Score, nutrient synergy insights, and a clear assessment of long-term alignment with your personal health objectives. Make every choice an informed one.
Personalized Plates: Where Health Meets Taste
Discover your Healthy & Tasty Meal Plan, crafted just for you. CalDiet doesn’t just list meals—it orchestrates your weekly nourishment blueprint. Synthesizing your physiological data, circadian tendencies, taste preferences, and goals, it builds a living plan that adapts to your schedule, enhances your energy, and satisfies your palate without compromise.
Body Rhythm Mapping: See Your Unique Patterns
Visualize Your Health Data on your personal CalDiet Dashboard. Track how nutrition, energy, and your body's natural cycles interact through intuitive charts and forecasts, helping you plan your activities and meals in sync with yourself.
Share Your Wins: One-Tap Motivation
Easily Share Your Progress & Meals to your favorite platforms. With a single tap, export your achievements, meal photos, or data insights as beautiful cards to Instagram, Stories, or with friends. Celebrate your journey and inspire others.
Your Adaptive Roadmap: Predict & Achieve
Get a Custom Plan & Predicted Goal Timeline. Tell us your target, and your Pal creates a tailored action plan. It learns from your progress, adjusts your path, and even predicts your “goal date” to keep you motivated with a clear, realistic finish line in sight.
CalDiet believes in precision, support, and simplicity. Food Analysis Pal is more than an app; it's your trusted ally, turning complex data into clear steps for a healthier, more energized you.

bluejetty:00086896:ios.description:
Super fast search of over 400,000 words, people, places and phrases. 
FEATURES
• Crossword Solver & Thesaurus
• Multi-word anagrams
• Blank letters for board games
• Powerful filters to refine your results
• Built-in dictionary, look up over 100,000 definitions
ANAGRAMS
Try moonstarer to find astronomer, also finds smaller words such as resonator and tearooms.
CR.SSW.RDS
Use . (or ?) to represent an unknown letter, try c....w... to find clockwork and crossword
CROSSWORD PHRASES
Search over 100K built-in phrases, try m.... ... ...... to find motte and bailey, miles per gallon and milky way galaxy
WORDLE
Green letters use the crossword search, eg ..e.t
Grey letters, add them to the Excludes Letters filter
Yellow letters, add them to the Contains Letters filter
SPELLING BEE
Spelling Bee puzzles are where you only use the letters provided but as many times as you like. Try $qntuaei to find: quinquina, aquanaut and queenie
BLANK LETTERS
Use + to represent blank letters, enter scrabb++ to find crabbers and scrabble.
DEFINITIONS
Press the info icon next to a word to view its definition, example usages and synonyms. You can click on the synonyms for further info and hear the word by pressing the speak button. 
Note, if no definition is found the app will search the web for a definition.
THESAURUS
Enter a word to look up related words, ideal for solving crossword clues
CODEWORDS & CRYPTOGRAMS
Try ?1221? to find bottom and hippie. Use the filters to exclude letters you already have found.
WORD LISTS
Español, Français, Português, Deutsch and Italiano word lists can be selected in the app's settings. Try out the Game Acceptable word list that only returns common words suitable for most games.

bluejetty:00091115:ios.description:
We’re recruiting monster hunters to join the action, help us fight back the invasion, and harvest.. eerr.. gather Chaos Energy from parallel worlds to fuel our weapons tech and some other experiments that you don’t need to worry about!
Disclaimer: mo.co is free to download and play, and never has in-game ads. However, some game items can also be purchased for real money (including random items). If you don't want to purchase game items for real money, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.
Perks of the job: 
● Super-powerful, Chaos Energy-infused weapons for you to fight with!
● Flexible working hours… it’s a ‘start hunting whenever you want’ situation
● Cool merch that lets you embody the monster hunting lifestyle. 
● Unlimited Portal jumps to parallel worlds. 
● Fun team environment with plenty of co-op action. 
● Fun leave-me-alone environment where you can hunt solo if that’s your thing. 
● No experience necessary. 
Start your monster hunting career at mo.co to enjoy a working environment that lets you… 
ENJOY BITE-SIZED ADVENTURES
Every day we launch new expeditions, whether you want a quick hunt or a longer session with friends, our portal technology lets you jump in and out of adventures whenever you want. 
EARN, MASTER, AND UPGRADE POWERFUL WEAPONS
Unlock a variety of Chaos Energy infused weapons. Each one comes with special abilities that let you unleash epic combinations. Make your weapons even stronger and enable other power-ups like health regeneration or dodging using Upgrade Cores. 
EXPLORE PARALLEL WORLDS 
Dragonling world has peaceful spirits being tormented by these chaotic lizards. Royal Bug world is a hierarchical society that will not tolerate mo.co’s free-spirited adventures. There’s no telling what worlds the portal will take us to next… 
PROVE YOUR SKILLS 
Elite Contracts put hunters right in the action, against the strongest bosses & tricky situations you’ll need to fight your way out of. If you succeed, you’ll earn Elite Merits, Elite Merch Credits, and climb the leaderboards. 
TAKE DOWN BOSSES WITH FRIENDS
We are a company but we hate bosses. When you join mo.co you’ll be put up against challenging monsters and you'll need to learn their attacks to find the best way to take them down. 
FIND MERCH TO FIT YOUR MOOD
From epic outfits that’d make any action hero feel powerful to stylish streetwear that matches your weapon, we’re always dropping merch to push the monster hunting lifestyle forward. 
SPRAY, EMOTE, AND DANCE YOUR HEART OUT.
Leave your mark with sprays, let friends know your mood with emotes, or start dancing in the face of monsters with gestures.

Perks of the job: 

● Super-powerful, Chaos Energy-infused weapons for you to fight with!
● Flexible working hours…  it’s a ‘start hunting whenever you want’ situation
● Cool merch that lets you embody the monster hunting lifestyle. 
● Unlimited Portal jumps to parallel worlds. 
● Fun team environment with plenty of co-op action. 
● Fun leave-me-alone environment where you can hunt solo if that’s your thing. 
● No experience necessary. 

Start your monster hunting career at mo.co to enjoy a working environment that lets you… 

ENJOY BITE-SIZED ADVENTURES

Every day we launch new expeditions, whether you want a quick hunt or a longer session with friends, our portal technology lets you jump in and out of adventures whenever you want. 

EARN, MASTER, AND UPGRADE POWERFUL WEAPONS

Unlock a variety of Chaos Energy infused weapons. Each one comes with special abilities that let you unleash epic combinations. Make your weapons even stronger and enable other power-ups like health regeneration or dodging using Upgrade Cores. 

EXPLORE PARALLEL WORLDS 

Dragonling world has peaceful spirits being tormented by these chaotic lizards. Royal Bug world is a hierarchical society that will not tolerate mo.co’s free-spirited adventures. There’s no telling what worlds the portal will take us to next… 

PROVE YOUR SKILLS 

Elite Contracts put hunters right in the action, against the strongest bosses & tricky situations you’ll need to fight your way out of. If you succeed, you’ll earn Elite Merits, Elite Merch Credits, and climb the leaderboards. 

TAKE DOWN BOSSES WITH FRIENDS

We are a company but we hate bosses. When you join mo.co you’ll be put up against challenging monsters and you'll need to learn their attacks to find the best way to take them down. 

FIND MERCH TO FIT YOUR MOOD

From epic outfits that’d make any action hero feel powerful to stylish streetwear that matches your weapon, we’re always dropping merch to push the monster hunting lifestyle forward. 

SPRAY, EMOTE, AND DANCE YOUR HEART OUT.

Leave your mark with sprays, let friends know your mood with emotes, or start dancing in the face of monsters with gestures.

Hunt together to defeat the biggest bosses and most chaotic monster hordes. Whether it’s with real life friends, or other random mo.co hunters, we’re a team out there. By planning weapon choices together you’ll be able to take down the most intimidating of Chaos Monsters.

bluejetty:00185548:ios.description:
RotoBaller.com’s fantasy sports player news updates for NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, PGA and NASCAR, all combined into one app. Turn on push notifications to receive our breaking news alerts, timely injury updates, the latest player news updates, and in-depth fantasy analysis articles for six sports - Fantasy Football, Fantasy Baseball, Fantasy Basketball, Fantasy Golf, Fantasy NASCAR, and Fantasy Hockey.
BREAKING NEWS THE MOMENT IT MATTERS
Injuries, depth chart moves, and start/sit calls, published minutes after they happen. Turn on alerts so you're never the last to know.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR FEED
Follow the players and sports you care about and My Feed brings you their news and analysis — NFL, MLB, NBA, NHL, college football, golf and more — while leaving out everything else.
EXPERT RANKINGS ALL SEASON LONG
Weekly and season-long rankings from RotoBaller's experts, with tiers, projections, strength of schedule and ADP. 
DRAFT AND LINEUP TOOLS
Who Should I Draft and Who Should I Start put up to four players head-to-head with current data. Injury tools show status, body part, risk level and how recently things changed.
DFS AND BETTING
Daily fantasy picks, value plays and betting analysis for the slate in front of you.
ROTOBALLER PREMIUM
Sign in to see premium articles, premium rankings and projections, and subscriber-only tools. Premium is managed through your RotoBaller account and unlocks across the app once you sign in.
RotoBaller writers has had over 80 nominations and 15 awards from the Fantasy Sports Writers Association, including best player news and notes. Stay on top of the latest news and information in the sports world. Let’s win some leagues!

Exchange information instantly and collaborate easily across care teams. Share texts, images, and medication information with your colleagues.

athenaText is also built into athenaOne mobile app as well as athenahealth's desktop services athenaClinicals (EHR) and athenaCoordinator (order transmission & care collaboration). At your clinic or on the go, secure communication is just a tap away.

bluejetty:00118822:ios.summary: Booksy is the booking app and business tool for beauty pros doing it on their own. Side-hustlers turned full-timers. Commissioned turned independent. Solo pros building a name behind the chair. And the salon owners building something bigger
bluejetty:00118822:ios.description:
Booksy is the booking app and business tool for beauty pros doing it on their own. Side-hustlers turned full-timers. Commissioned turned independent. Solo pros building a name behind the chair. And the salon owners building something bigger. Every feature built with you in mind. Every feature included.
Booksy is the top online scheduling and client management platform for appointment-based businesses.
Easy for you to run. Easy for your clients to love.
WHAT YOU GET WITH BOOKSY BIZ
GET BOOKED 24/7, EVEN WHEN YOU SLEEP
Clients book themselves through your booking site, Instagram, Google, and Facebook. They love how easy it is to book, reschedule, and rebook. You set the rules, the hours, and the prices. We handle the rest. 
STOP GETTING GHOSTED
Set your cancellation policy and we’ll enforce it for you. Charge deposits, charge cancellation fees, fill empty slots automatically from the waitlist. No more chasing payments. No more awkward texts. Pros using Booksy recovered over $15.6 million from no-shows last year.
GET PAID FAST, SECURE, AND YOUR WAY
Take card, tap, mobile wallet, or in-app payments. Powered by Stripe. Free next-business-day payouts, or cash out in under 30 minutes with Fast Payouts. Every transaction is tracked and reported in one place - no more juggling multiple payment apps disconnected from your business.
BUILD THE CLIENT BASE THAT KEEPS YOU BUSY 
Free text and email marketing. Promotions to fill slow days. Loyalty cards to reward your regulars. Automated rebooking reminders so they never lapse. 
LOOK LIKE THE PROFESSIONAL YOU ARE 
Your booking site, portfolio, and verified reviews build trust before clients even book. Show off your work, display your prices, and let your reviews do the talking.
GET FOUND BY CLIENTS SEARCHING NEARBY
Your business gets listed on the Booksy marketplace. Show up in Google Search, Google Maps, and Google AI Mode. Add a Book Now button to Instagram, Facebook, and Google. The clients are already searching — you just need to show up and make it easy to book. That’s where we come in.
RUN THE WHOLE THING FROM YOUR PHONE 
Calendar, client cards, payments, marketing, reports — all in one app. Log in on the web or tablet for a complete front desk experience.
GROW YOUR TEAM. STAY IN CONTROL.
Add staff, manage shifts, set commissions, track performance. Build a system that runs without you in the room — while you stay in complete control of how it operates. Booksy grows with you, from solo to salon and beyond.
ONE PRICE, EVERY FEATURE INCLUDED
No plan tiers. No paywalls. No "upgrade for that feature." Every Booksy subscription includes scheduling, marketing, payments, reports, and 24/7 support. You only pay more if you add staff. 
ABOUT BOOST 
Boost is the optional marketing tool to get you in front of more clients on the Booksy marketplace. We charge 30% of the FIRST visit from a Boost client only. Every appointment after that is 100% yours. We do not charge for appointments from existing clients, or for any client bookings when Boost is off.
REAL HUMAN SUPPORT, 24/7
Live chat in under 30 seconds. Phone and email support during business hours. We also offer 1:1 personal onboarding and transfer your data over for FREE. 
THE NUMBERS
• 330,000+ pros trust Booksy worldwide
• 9.52 appointments created every second
• $15.6 million protected from no-shows last year
• 4.9 stars from 740,000+ reviews on the consumer app
Try free for 14-days, no credit card required. Cancel anytime.
Try Booksy Biz today

bluejetty:00026811:ios.description:
Digital Planner is designed first and foremost for iPad, combining the familiar experience of a classic paper planner with the flexibility of digital planning. Plan your days, weeks, and months, write naturally with Apple Pencil, organize your schedule, and keep your tasks, events, goals, and notes in one place.
Digital Planner is also available on iPhone and Mac, so you can keep your planning accessible across your Apple devices. Use iPhone for quick access to your planner, calendar, tasks, and events on the go, or open Digital Planner on your Mac when you're working at your computer. Keep your planning synchronized across devices and easily check or update your schedule wherever you are.
PLAN YOUR WAY
Stay organized with flexible planning views for everything from detailed daily schedules to long-term goals:
• Hourly Planner
• Daily Planner
• Weekly Planner
• Monthly Planner
• Yearly Planner
• Daily goals, notes, and summaries
• Checklists and tasks
• Birthday calendar
• Customizable planning templates
WRITE NATURALLY WITH APPLE PENCIL
Turn your iPad into a digital notebook and planner. Write, draw, highlight, add typed text, and organize content naturally. Convert handwriting to text or use speech-to-text when typing isn't convenient.
CALENDARS & REMINDERS
Bring planning and scheduling together:
• Sync with Apple Calendar
• Sync with Google Calendar
• Create and edit Google Calendar events directly in the app
• Connect and work with Outlook Calendar
• Work with Apple Reminders
• Add and manage events
• Share your calendar with others
NOTES, PDFs & MORE
Use Digital Planner for planning, writing, studying, and organizing:
• Create notes
• Add stickers and images
• Select and move content with the Lasso tool
• Import and annotate PDF files
• Track books with a reading list
• Back up and restore your data
MADE FOR EVERYDAY PLANNING
Whether you're a student, teacher, professional, or simply enjoy the feeling of a traditional paper planner, Digital Planner gives you the freedom to organize your life your way.
Enjoy the space and flexibility of planning on iPad with Apple Pencil, quickly check your schedule from iPhone when you're on the go, and access your planning from Mac while working at your computer.
Have an idea or suggestion? Contact our support team and let us know what you'd like to see next.

bluejetty:00062684:ios.name: Skritter: Write Japanese
bluejetty:00062684:ios.summary:
SKRITTER - THE WRITE WAY TO LEARN JAPANESE AND CHINESE
Remember every character you learn. Most Japanese apps ask you to recognize kanji. Skritter asks you to write them, because writing is one of the fastest ways to make a character stick
bluejetty:00062684:ios.description:
SKRITTER - THE WRITE WAY TO LEARN JAPANESE AND CHINESE
Remember every character you learn. Most Japanese apps ask you to recognize kanji. Skritter asks you to write them, because writing is one of the fastest ways to make a character stick in your long-term memory.
When you write a character, you recall every part of it, so the next time you see it, you really know it.
Self-studying or taking classes? Learn Japanese with JLPT and textbook word lists, from your first hiragana and katakana to thousands of kanji.
WHY WRITING MAKES CHARACTERS STICK
In Skritter you recall each kanji and kana in full, stroke by stroke, with instant feedback on your stroke order. This active recall is why our learners remember what they study.
REMEMBER EVERY CHARACTER YOU LEARN
Our brains are actively trying to forget what we learn each day, so we combat that with our spaced repetition system (SRS). Your Japanese flashcards are scheduled for review just before you forget them, so you practice what is slipping. Study smarter, not harder.
Daily reminders keep the habit going and stop reviews piling up. A few minutes a day keeps you on track, and over months that adds up to thousands of kanji.
START WITH HIRAGANA AND KATAKANA
Japanese is written in three scripts: hiragana, katakana and kanji. Start with our Learn Hiragana and Learn Katakana decks, with mnemonics that link each kana's shape to its sound. Then move on to kanji with a solid foundation.
TEST PREP: JLPT
- JLPT vocabulary decks by level, from N5 to N1
- Study the kanji and words for your target level, then review them with SRS until test day
STUDY YOUR OWN TEXTBOOK
We cover popular Japanese textbook series, chapter by chapter. Find your textbook, jump to your chapter, study this week's kanji tonight.
HUNDREDS OF DECKS AND GUIDED COURSES
Start a course or a ready-made deck today:
- Japanese Stroke Order: a guided course on the principles of stroke order. Correct stroke order is what makes handwriting balanced, so your writing gets faster and your characters easier to read.
- Japanese 101: the essential first words and phrases
- Travel decks for hotels, flights, taxis and shopping
- Friends and Family, Holidays and Celebrations, and many more
New decks are added regularly. You can also build your own list in seconds.
SKRITTER FEATURES TO POWER UP YOUR LEARNING
- Example sentences showing each word in real context
- Mnemonics for hiragana and katakana
- Kanji readings, definitions and audio
- Learning tips and character breakdowns from expert teachers
THREE WRITING MODES AS YOU IMPROVE
Your handwriting practice should get harder as you improve, and you can turn writing off entirely if you would rather drill readings and meanings.
- Default: strokes snap into place as you write, with hints when you are stuck. Ideal for your first characters.
- Raw squigs: no stroke snapping, so writing feels like pen and paper, with stroke recognition still on.
- Rawest squigs: no hints, no automatic grading. Write the whole character from memory, then grade yourself. The closest thing to a classroom quiz.
SKRITTER PREMIUM
- Personalized SRS reviews
- Instant handwriting and stroke order feedback
- Master writing, readings and definitions
- JLPT, popular textbooks and hundreds of official decks
- Create custom study decks
- Web, mobile and offline support
- One Premium subscription covers both Skritter Japanese and Skritter Chinese
Privacy Policy: https://skritter.com/legal
Terms of Use: https://docs.skritter.com/article/133-terms-of-use

bluejetty:00023191:ios.description:
My Tide Times is the only tide times application you'll ever need. Whether you're surfing, fishing or just going to the beach you'll be able to use it to get quick and easy access to the times. We think it's the most beautiful tide times application on the market to date.

- Supports over 9,000 tidal stations across over 40 countries (including the US, Canada, UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, Australia and New Zealand)!

- View sunrise & sunset times for all locations alongside the tides in the application!
- Moonrise, moonset and moon phase information!

- Never have to worry about ensuring the data is up-to-date because the app takes care of that for you!
- Most locations outside of the UK have up to 30 day charts!
- When information has been downloaded it is stored on the phone so you can view it without an internet connection! 
- It offers a clean interface that you just won't get from other apps! 
- Optimized for the latest iPhone and iPad models.
If you're in need of tide tables, charts, forecasts or times, don't go elsewhere - install My Tide Times today. It's similar to apps like Tides Near Me Free, Hi Tide and Windy. This version is ad-supported.

- Scan paper documents using your camera
- Upload files from Photos or iCloud/Files app
- Attach images, PDFs, or documents from other apps
- Add a cover page with logo, sender and recipient info
- Simply type in the number of the recipient, or use your address book contacts for an even faster process
- Send faxes to those local or international numbers

Store and organize received documents
Get notifications the moment a fax is received

Stay organized and avoid costly mistakes.

bluejetty:00023031:ios.description:
UBCab нь түргэн шуурхай, найдвартай, 24 цагаар ажилладаг бүх төрлийн такси дуудлага, унаа түрээс, шуурхай хүргэлтийн аппликейшн юм.
Замын хажууд гар өргөж зогсох, төлбөртэй тусгай дугаар луу залгаж нэмэлт төлбөр төлөх шаардлагагүй. Та апп-аа ашиглан өөрт хамгийн ойр байгаа такситай холбогдож тав тухтай үйлчлүүлээрэй.
Бид үйлчилгээгээ Улаанбаатар хот болон 16 аймагт нэвтрүүлж, удалгүй 21 аймагт нэвтрэхээр ажиллаж байна.
UBCab ашиглаж такси дуудсанаар:
 - Зөвхөн албан ёсны бүртгэлтэй такси болон жолооч танд үйлчилнэ
 - Тариф удирдлагын нэгдсэн систем (Жолооч өөрчлөх боломжгүй найдвартай)
 - Та өөрийн байршлыг хаанаас ч сонгож нэмэлтээр тайлбар бичиж болно
 - Таныг авахаар ирж байгаа жолоочийн байршлыг газрын зураг дээр шууд харна
 - Та бэлэн болон бэлэн бус төлбөрийн бүх хэрэгсэл ашиглан төлбөрөө төлөх боломжтой
 - Цахим хэлбэрээр ( Бүртгүүлсэн и-Мэйл рүү ) баримт илгээх автомат системтэй
 - Аппликэйшний үйлчилгээ бүртгэл хүлээн авах замаар санал гомдлоо илэрхийлэх боломжтой зэрэг олон давуу талыг бид санал болгож байна.
Зөвлөмж:
UBCab системийг ашиглахын тулд та интернэт холболттой байх шаардлагатай ба утсан дээрээ Location service-ийг асааснаар таны байршлыг улам нарийн тодорхойлох боломжтой болохыг анхаарна уу. UBCab багийнхан үйлчилгээний стандартаа байнга, сайжруулж, шударга, соёлтой үйлчилгээг хэвшил болгохыг зорин ажилладаг.
Шинэчлэл бүр таны амьдралыг улам хялбар болгож аюулгүй тайван зорчих нөхцөлийг бүрдүүлнэ гэдэгт итгэлтэй байна.
Үйлчилгээний дараа Жолоочоос хамааралтай үнэлгээ өгөх боломжтой. Таны санал бидэнд маш үнэтэй бөгөөд үйлчилгээний чанар сайжруулалтуудад тусгагдах болно.
Та UBCab-ааар тав тухтай үйлчлүүлж үнэт цагаа хэмнээрэй!

bluejetty:00083091:ios.name: Liar's Cards - Ship of Deceit
bluejetty:00083091:ios.summary: Welcome aboard Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit, a thrilling mobile card game where bluffing, strategy, and pure luck decide your fate on a cursed pirate ship. In this high-stakes adventure, every word is a weapon, every glance a clue, and ever
bluejetty:00083091:ios.description:
Welcome aboard Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit, a thrilling mobile card game where bluffing, strategy, and pure luck decide your fate on a cursed pirate ship. In this high-stakes adventure, every word is a weapon, every glance a clue, and every lie could lead to your demise. Are you ready to outwit, outplay, and outbluff your pirate rivals? 
The game of deception begins 
In Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit, you’ll engage in intense rounds of the classic bluffing game, but with a deadly pirate twist. The deck holds 20 unique cards, and each player starts with 5 cards. Every round begins with a declared rank, such as a king or a joker, and players must play cards matching the rank — or at least pretend they are. 
- Play 1 to 3 cards per turn and try to convince your opponents of their value. 
- Call out another player's bluff if you sense deception, but beware — accusing wrongly could backfire. 
- Victory belongs to the smartest liar and the keenest observer. 
The poisoned gamble 
Getting caught in a lie in Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit is no laughing matter. You’ll face the infamous "poisoned mug challenge." Six mugs of rum will appear before you, but one contains poison. With each failure, one mug is removed, and the odds of drinking the fatal poison increase. By the final round, survival is pure luck — or perhaps fate. 
- Every lie comes with a risk. 
- The number of mugs decreases after each failed bluff. 
- Will you survive long enough to outlast your opponents? 
Key features of Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit 
- Bluff and strategy: outsmart your rivals with clever tactics and confident deception. 
- Dynamic gameplay: each round brings new challenges, requiring quick thinking and adaptability. 
- Poisoned mug mechanic: a unique risk-reward system that keeps every round intense. 
- Immersive pirate atmosphere: detailed visuals and a dark, moody setting bring the cursed ship to life. 
- Multiplayer action: challenge friends or foes in real-time matches and prove who the ultimate liar is. 
- Replayability: every match in Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit is unpredictable and full of surprises. 
Why play Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit? 
Whether you’re a master strategist, a natural-born liar, or simply love pirate-themed games, Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit offers a fresh, addictive twist on classic bluffing mechanics. Test your wits, face impossible odds, and claim your place as the most cunning pirate on the ship. 
Do you have what it takes to survive the Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit and walk away victorious? Or will your lies catch up to you in the end? 
Step aboard, captain! The game begins now — in Liar's Cards: Ship of Deceit, trust is a myth, and every card could be your last.

bluejetty:00128096:ios.description:
Image Resizer & Compressor is a powerful and user-friendly mobile application designed to simplify the process of resizing and compressing images on the go. Whether you're a professional photographer, social media enthusiast, or simply someone who wants to optimize their image files for various purposes, this app is your go-to solution.
Features:
Image Resizing: Easily resize your images to specific dimensions or choose from various preset sizes suitable for social media platforms like Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, and more. Maintain the aspect ratio while resizing to ensure your images look perfect.
Image Compression: Reduce the file size of your images without compromising on quality. The app employs advanced algorithms to compress images while preserving essential details, so you can save storage space on your device or share images faster online.
Video Resizing: Resize videos to specific dimensions and share on different social media platforms.
Video Compressor: Compress videos in bulk and save device space.
Image converter: Change image format easily using this app.
Batch Processing: Save time and effort by resizing and compressing multiple images at once. The app's batch processing feature allows you to apply the same settings to a group of images, making it perfect for handling large photo collections.
Customizable Settings: Tailor the compression level and image size according to your needs. The app offers various compression options, allowing you to strike the right balance between image quality and file size.
Intuitive Interface: The app boasts a user-friendly interface, making it easy for both beginners and professionals to navigate and utilise its powerful features effectively.
Share and Save: After resizing and compressing your images, conveniently save them to your device or share them directly to your favourite social media platforms or messaging apps.
Image Format Support: Image Resizer & Compressor supports various popular image formats, including JPG, PNG, GIF, and more, ensuring compatibility with a wide range of devices and platforms.
Secure and Private: Your images are processed locally on your device, ensuring your privacy and data security. The app does not store or transmit your images to any external servers.
Whether you want to optimize images for online sharing, create stunning social media posts, or manage your photo gallery more efficiently, Image Resizer & Compressor provides a comprehensive solution with its quick and easy image resizing and compression capabilities. Download the app now and take control of your image files with ease!
Our App can be used for free with Ads and limited features, however, you can purchase a Image Resizer Premium subscription for the additional advanced features, and remove Ads.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
When you download our App you can opt in to a 3 days free trial for monthly and 7 days free trial for yearly subscription. Our App offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your Image Resizer Premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
