bluejetty:00179893:ios.name: Learn Python Coding Offline
bluejetty:00179893:ios.summary: Become a Python 3 Programmer and start your python career. This app will make you a confident professional python programmer with excellent code examples and by building real python projects. This app will start from the basics of python la
bluejetty:00179893:ios.description:
Become a Python 3 Programmer and start your python career. This app will make you a confident professional python programmer with excellent code examples and by building real python projects. This app will start from the basics of python language and go all the way to the advanced python concepts. This app have a robust python compiler where you can write real python code and compile it. So you can practice while learning python. Take a bit size of python 3 lesson from the app and then practice what you have learned in the compiler. And not just that, this app also have python quizzes, and not just python but also it's frameworks like Django, flask. These quizzes will help you in your learning journey and you can test your python knowledge. 
Start with beginner-friendly lessons covering:
- Python syntax and indentation
- Variables, data types, strings, numbers, and booleans
- Operators, conditions, match-case, and loops
- Functions, classes, object-oriented programming, and modules
- Lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets, and file operations
- Exceptions, debugging, and practical programming patterns
- Virtual environments, pip, packages, and command-line tools.
Write and run Python code directly inside the app. Experiment with examples, test ideas, and reinforce every lesson through hands-on coding. Compiler support includes Python, Python 2, and PyPy environments.
 This app will teach you not just about Basic to Advanced Python Programming but you will also:
- Learn Web Development with Python [HTML, CSS, Django, Flask, Pyramid, cherryPy, TurboGears],
- Learn Artificial Intelligence with Python,
- Learn Machine Learning,
- Learn Web Scraping [Beautiful Soup, Web Scraping]
- Learn Git,
- Practice with Python Programs in Python Compiler,and much much more. By the end, you’ll be a job-ready python programmer.
What is Python Exactly?
Python 3 is a general-purpose language, which means it can be used to build just about anything, which will be made easy with the right tools/libraries.
Professionally, Python is great for backend web development, data analysis, artificial intelligence, and scientific computing. Many developers have also used Python to build productivity tools, games, and desktop apps, so there are plenty of resources to help you learn how to do those as well.
Learn Django Framework:
You will also learn Django and how to develop websites. Django is the most popular web development framework that assists in building and maintaining quality web applications. Django helps eliminate repetitive tasks making the development process an easy and time-saving experience. This tutorial gives a complete understanding of Django.
Learn Flask Framework:
You will also learn Flask and how to develop webistes using it. Flask is a web application framework written in Python. Armin Ronacher, who leads an international group of Python enthusiasts named Pocco, develops it. Flask is based on the Werkzeug WSGI toolkit and the Jinja2 template engine. Both are Pocco projects.
Learn CherryPy:
CherryPy allows developers to build web applications in much the same way they would build any other object-oriented Python program. This results in smaller source code developed in less time. It is being used in many production websites.
Learn Python Web Scraping:
Web scraping, also called web data mining or web harvesting, is the process of constructing an agent that can extract, parse, download, and organize useful information from the web automatically.
So what are you waiting for! Download now and Start your Python Journey.

CherryPy allows developers to build web applications in much the same way they would build any other object-oriented Python program. This results in smaller source code developed in less time. It is being used in many production websites.

Learn Python Web Scraping:
Web scraping, also called web data mining or web harvesting, is the process of constructing an agent that can extract, parse, download, and organize useful information from the web automatically.

So what are you waiting for! Download now and Start your Python Journey.

bluejetty:00073361:ios.description:
Pizza Ready! – Build a Restaurant Empire!
Welcome to Pizza Ready, a pizza game where you cook, serve, manage, and build a growing restaurant business. Start with one shop, take every customer order, and turn a small kitchen into a busy business empire. If you love food, idle, simulator, and tycoon gameplay, this game is for you.
Cook, Serve, and Grow
Prepare fresh pizza for every customer and keep the restaurant moving fast. Take each order, complete each order, cook food in the kitchen, add tasty topping, and serve a delicious meal before the line gets too long. Every order gives you money, profit, and a chance to upgrade your shop.
As owner and manager, you control the restaurant from counter to kitchen. Manage each station, improve every recipe, master the flow, and serve more customers. The better you manage your business, the faster your restaurant can expand.
Upgrade Kitchen, Equipment, and Staff
Build a stronger kitchen with better equipment, ovens, appliances, and stations. Each upgrade helps you prepare more meals, complete more orders, and make your restaurant more efficient. Upgrade equipment, unlock fresh ingredients, upgrade each dish, and create delicious food that every customer will enjoy.
Hire chef and cashier staff to keep the shop running. Train your staff, increase order speed, and help every customer faster. Great staff, better equipment, and smart management help your business earn income, even while you are offline.
Become a Pizza Tycoon
Pizza Ready combines idle simulator gameplay with restaurant management and business growth. Collect money, boost profit, and unlock each level as your restaurant becomes bigger. Expand your store, design a better shop layout, and build an empire across new locations.
Every level brings a new challenge. Open another restaurant, upgrade every station, serve more customers, and become the ultimate pizza tycoon. Whether you enjoy a relaxing idle game, restaurant simulator game, clicker progress, or tapping game fun, Pizza Ready gives you a satisfying business journey.
Features
Build and manage your pizza restaurant, cook food, serve every customer, complete each order, earn money, upgrade kitchen equipment, grow business profit, hire staff, expand your shop, and enjoy idle progress online or offline.
Download Pizza Ready. Cook delicious pizza, manage every order, upgrade your kitchen, expand your business, and become the greatest pizza tycoon!
Support: help.pizza@supercent.io

bluejetty:00024320:ios.description:
Yandex Games is a one stop launcher featuring an extensive catalog of video games. Feel free to take your pick from any of the available options.
Smart feed.
The Smart Feed algorithm suggests options based on your interests.
Cross-device synchronization.
With cross-device synchronization, you'll always be able to continue where you've left off, no matter where you are and what device you're using.
You will find categories like:
Word Games.
Word search and crossword puzzles are the perfect way to put your vocabulary to the test. Delve into the word hunt with your friends, and see if your brain can take the advanced word play! Can you guess the answer?
Board Games.
Up for some multiplayer chess online? Alternatively, you can just play some casual dominos, bingo, or classic checkers with friends. If that is not something you'd like, you can always choose to play bingo at home, ludo, or even backgammon. Try out some mancala, connect four in a row, and do puzzles.
Cards.
There's nothing more satisfying than shuffling a deck of cards while sipping on a glass of your favorite beverage at home, an old-school formula. Treat yourself to a round of classic solitaire if you're home alone, play klondike solitaire with friends online, or enjoy some classic spider solitaire. Plus, you can also create a collection of your favorite card games and play spades with friends on your cell phone.
Arcade.
Plenty of fun games await in a classic arcade style. Test your reflexes in brick and ball games, amaze your friends in a bubble shooter match, and rise up to the competition in the retro snake game space online.
Action.
Strike fear in the hearts of your opponents in ninja combat, fight your way through war games, or become a legendary street fighter! Modern shooting and army games will test your reflexes in a battle. Show everybody your fighting skills and destroy the whole army with just one sword. Immerse yourself in a fantasy online world, try on the role of an assassin, a superhero, or even a samurai. Bring justice and master the art of warfare. Battlefield awaits!
Music.
Dance to the rhythm of music maker beats, tap the piano tiles to create wonderful melodies, or form a garageband with your friends and make your first song together. Grab some virtual drums, tune a guitar, and let the musical magic begin! Or participate in a beat battle and show everybody what you've got! You don't need a real studio to make music. Our apps will help you learn how to perfect your sound and become a maestro. Whether you like pop, hip hop, or rock, you'll definitely find something for your taste.
Puzzles.
How big is your brain? Test your wits by solving intricate riddles and playing some classic jigsaw puzzle games. Puzzles are also a great way to pass the time if you're waiting for someone.
Tower Defense.
Protect your civilization against the enemy onslaught! Battle strategy is all about prioritizing and resource management. Crush with your enemies, command the vikings and conquer new territories. Build up your empire, create a league of heroes, or participate in a crazy defense. This is a quest, an ultimate clash of legends, and legions rely on your bravery. Discover new worlds just with the help of your cell phone. Defend the castle and the royal kingdom will forever be in your debt!
Family.
Playing games is a perfect way to spend some quality time with your loved ones. You can draw a cartoon dog, a cat, or any other animal in drawing and coloring games. Create your own zoo or grow a virtual puppy with your friends. Or maybe you want to color by number to create a beautiful painting? You can even learn a language or adopt a talking pet. The possibilities are endless and we can make learning fun! And you don't need to download various apps to find something you like, we have already compiled a huge selection of options for you.

Discover new worlds just with the help of your cell phone. Defend the castle and the royal kingdom will forever be in your debt!

Family.
Playing games is a perfect way to spend some quality time with your loved ones. You can draw a cartoon dog, a cat, or any other animal in drawing and coloring games. Create your own zoo or grow a virtual puppy with your friends. Or maybe you want to color by number to create a beautiful painting? You can even learn a language or adopt a talking pet. The possibilities are endless and we can make learning fun! And you don't need to download various apps to find something you like, we have already compiled a huge selection of options for you.

bluejetty:00017653:ios.description:
If you are looking for a smart, full-featured and easy to use App to manage your bills, Bills Monitor is the one.

Bills Monitor - Bill Manager & Reminder is designed to manage all kinds of your bills. Log your bills in this app, you can track or check them from time to time visually and conveniently, also it will remind you to pay your bill after setting its reminding days. Bills Monitor will help to make your schedule easier and every bill in control.
The design and UI face is clear and tidy, which makes you manage the bills very easy and comfortable.
Features:
⁃ Calendar view of bills.
⁃ Indentify the state of bills by individual icon on them.
⁃ Add bills with their categories, amount, due date, pay account, recurring or not, recurring end date if available, paid amount, and note.
⁃ Remind when bill due date approaches or bills are over-due. 
⁃ Mark payment to bills in full or in part.
⁃ Add recurring bills with frequency and end date conveniently.
⁃ Show number of unpaid overdue bills on icon.
⁃ Twenty system own categories and you can customize your own.
⁃ Report function to show categories (allocation) of bills by pie chart.
⁃ Customize period to email bills to your Financial Consultant or others in format of CSV, HTML or PDF.
⁃ Search your bills by key words of name, note, category, and account.
⁃ Passcode function to protect your info.
⁃ Supports Face ID as passcode.
⁃ Add account’s name, phone No., website, and note.
⁃ History to show all your bills.
⁃ Supports Wifi backup and restore. 
⁃ Supports iCloud backup and restore. 
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore. 
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports Today Widget.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports both iPhone and iPad version.
If you have any question or suggestion, please send email to userfeed@vip.tom.com.

앱스토어 라이프스타일 카테고리 3위! 전체무료앱 38위!

군돌이는 이쁘고 심플한 디자인을 가진 전역일계산기입니다.

전역일계산기 군돌이 특징
- 디데이, 계급을 한 눈에 볼 수 있어요!
- 실시간으로 변하는 퍼센트를 볼 수 있어요!

- 진급일, 전역일 조정이 가능해요!
- 자신 혹은 남자친구, 아들의 사진을 전역일계산기에 추가할 수 있어요!
- 병사뿐만 아니라 부사관 및 장교까지 설정할 수 있어요!
- 바탕화면에서 편리하게 위젯으로 디데이를 확인할 수 있어요!
- 최대 12명까지 군인을 추가할 수 있어요!
- 테마를 변경할 수 있어요!
- 식단표를 확인할 수 있어요!
- 휴가를 관리할 수 있어요!
- 군복무를 하고 있는 연예인을 응원할 수 있어요!
- 커뮤니티에서 소통할 수 있어요!
- 군인에게 편지를 보낼 수 있어요!

- Jokers beat everything.
*** A COMPLETE APPLICATION ***
- Great graphics, card animations for a more realistic gameplay.
- Competitive artificial intelligence opponents.
- Retina display support.
- Statistics on played games.
- Rules included inside the application.
- Game Center supports : Multiplayer, Leaderboards and Achievements
Any question about the game ? support.president@eryodsoft.com
Have fun playing President !

bluejetty:00173211:ios.name: My Town : Grandparents Fun
bluejetty:00173211:ios.summary: My Town: Grandparents includes safe and fun educational games for kids about daily life and housekeeping. My Town: Grandparents is a digital version of a classical toy doll house. Laugh with your virtual family, plant plants, clean up, dres
bluejetty:00173211:ios.description:
My Town: Grandparents includes safe and fun educational games for kids about daily life and housekeeping. My Town: Grandparents is a digital version of a classical toy doll house. Laugh with your virtual family, plant plants, clean up, dress up, and discover the My Town: Grandparents doll house.
It’s always a fun day when you get to visit your My Town Granny and Grandpa! How fun to check out where your dad grew up and explore his old room! Do it yourself wood-carving with Grandpa and we know it’s always fun to cook something homemade with Granny. 
There are so many stories for your children to make up in My Town: Grandparents. Let them show you all the souvenirs their Granny and Grandpa brought back from their Africa vacation, or let them learn about gardening by spending time outside with Granny. Spend quality time with your virtual family.
FEATURES
- 9 exciting places to explore, including a garden where you and your Granny will enjoy gardening with more than 20 different flowers and vegetables, Do it yourself wood-carving with Grandpa and discover dad’s childhood bedroom!
- You can play with 14 new characters and new clothes are also available - how fun to meet Dad’s best friend and chat with Grandpa’s neighbors!
- You can go into the kitchen and eat something delicious homemade and you will learn how to make an omelet.
- If you can imagine it, you can make it. Everything is possible with Granny and Grandpa.
- Digital version of a classical toy doll house.
- Safe and fun educational games for kids about daily life and housekeeping.
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
Kids 4-12: My Town games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room.
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital doll house games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania, and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get Privacy-related information at: https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/.

bluejetty:00178361:ios.name: Tower War - Tactical Conquest
bluejetty:00178361:ios.summary:
► BEAUTIFULLY SYMMETRICAL WARFARE!
Turn the tide and win the war in this elegantly simple casual tactics game that’s guaranteed to appeal to all armchair commanders and pocket Napoleons. Head into battle with a single swipe and watch your
bluejetty:00178361:ios.description:
► BEAUTIFULLY SYMMETRICAL WARFARE!
Turn the tide and win the war in this elegantly simple casual tactics game that’s guaranteed to appeal to all armchair commanders and pocket Napoleons. Head into battle with a single swipe and watch your little warriors celiminate the enemy, allocating your cute little forces with skill and precision to maintain your position and overcome the opposing armies. 
Tap into your military genius and tap onto the next tower to continue your campaign of conquest and come out on top in this fast, fun, and occasionally infuriating strategy game that towers above the competition.
► COLORFUL WARFARE!
• Aww, war! Don’t be fooled by cute appearances, in this compact and colorful wargame it still takes nerves of steel, a will of iron, and ice-cold calculation to beat the enemy and conquer all before you. Real strategy and tactical thinking are required to win each battle, and every level can turn on a single lightning decision. Keep your wits about you, keep an eye on the enemy, and keep swiping fast to ensure victory.
• Don’t let defeat get you down – you can relive past battles again and again, and you’ll want to keep on trying in this deceptively simple but fiendishly challenging game of military strategy and conquest that brings you fierce warfare and tactical intrigue in satisfying bite-size pieces.
• Hours of towers! Use your tactical cunning to progress through the levels of tower-defense and unlock new types of towers, including artillery posts and tank factories. Other game mechanisms including multiple enemies, barriers, blockades, and mines mean the war is never over and there’s always a new challenge to spice up the already massively addictive gameplay.
• Towering achievements – keep finding the elegant tactical solutions to win each battle so that you can unlock new areas and continue your reign of conquest in new climes, with beautiful backdrops adding to the game’s already supremely elegant (and cute) design.
► ALL YOUR TOWERS ARE OURS!
Looking for a mobile strategy game that’s both serious fun and offers a genuinely sophisticated tactical challenge? 
Tower War takes tower-defense to a new level of entertainment and ingenuity, with intuitive gameplay and exceptionally smart game design that will keep you coming back to the battlefield for more and more wildly entertaining wargames. Raise your colors, stiffen your swiping finger and summon the fun of war by downloading Tower War now and charging head-first into battle!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00071787:ios.description:
Your intelligent, powerful, and customizable AI assistant!
Chat AI leverages the most advanced technologies, such as GPT-5, Claude 3, Gemini 1.5, Perplexity, and more, to provide unique and tailored interactions to suit your needs. Whether you’re looking to write, learn, solve a problem, or simply chat, Chat AI is the ultimate solution to maximize your productivity and creativity.
EXCLUSIVE FEATURE: CHOOSE YOUR PREFERRED AI MODEL
With Chat AI, you have total control over your experience. Select the AI model that best suits your needs from a diverse range:
- GPT-5: Perfect for quick and lightweight responses.
- Claude 3.5 Sonnet: Specialized in poetry, creativity, and complex texts.
- Gemini Pro 1.5: Designed for a deep understanding of contexts and advanced topics.
- LlaMa 3.1: An efficient model for detailed and technical responses.
- Command R+: Ideal for queries requiring in-depth research.
- Mistral Nemo: Delivers fast and accurate results in a compact format.
PERSONALIZED WRITING ASSISTANT
- Write impactful emails, articles, poems, resumes, cover letters, or even tweets.
- Choose the tone, style, and complexity of your texts.
- Quickly correct your writing in just seconds.
INTEGRATED SEARCH ENGINE
- Get precise and up-to-date information using AI models.
- Find answers to your questions or explore the latest trends.
EDUCATIONAL TOOLS AND HOMEWORK HELP
- Solve mathematical equations and complex problems.
- Write structured essays or create study plans.
- Check grammar and spelling in your texts.
- Receive detailed explanations to understand complex concepts.
SOCIAL MEDIA BOOSTER
- Generate captivating captions for Instagram, TikTok, or LinkedIn.
- Write optimized posts to engage your followers.
- Add unique descriptions to your reels or videos.
ROLEPLAY AND CONVERSATIONS
- Chat with AI in various roles to make your interactions more engaging.
- Receive emotional support or enjoy a fun and humorous conversation.
CREATIVITY AND ENTERTAINMENT
- Create song lyrics, poems, or even recipes.
- Transform your ideas into stunning visuals with our AI generator.
- Plan fun activities with your friends or organize unique gatherings.
PRODUCTIVITY AND WORK
- Write job descriptions, resumes, or impactful emails.
- Get a list of key points from a text or compile a comprehensive FAQ.
- Define your company’s core values.
BUSINESS IDEAS
- Receive ideas for startups and innovative products.
- Combine concepts to create new business opportunities.
- Design ad campaigns or promotional video concepts.
PERSONALIZATION AND LIFESTYLE
- Discover music tailored to your preferences.
- Interpret tarot card readings or create personalized playlists.
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account upon confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew, and you will be charged unless you disable automatic renewal or cancel the subscription at least 24 hours before the end of the current trial or subscription period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a premium subscription during that free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the subscription package you choose. Subscriptions and auto-renewal can be managed by going to account settings after purchase.

• Check your Equifax cr
bluejetty:00116636:ios.description:
Get your Equifax credit report & credit score* updates at no cost with a free myEquifax™ account. It’s quick and easy to get started for free today and begin your credit journey.
No credit card required to sign up.
• Check your Equifax credit report for daily updates, anywhere you want. 
• Checking your credit doesn’t hurt your credit score. 
• Get daily one-bureau credit score updates and track your score progress over time.
• Set a score goal and gain valuable insights on your credit journey.
• Optimal Path™ — Opt in to use a free AI-powered tool that analyzes your credit profile and provides a personalized action plan with simple steps you can take to improve your credit over time.
Upgrade to a paid plan to add Credit Monitoring and Identity Protection Features:
Equifax Complete™ Premier — Get annual access to your report & credit score from Equifax, Transunion, and Experian*, along with credit monitoring and identity theft protection features including:
• Dark WebScan: Receive alerts if we find your Social Security, credit card, debit card, banking, medical ID, and passport numbers on suspected fraudulent websites on the dark web**
• Identity theft protection services: Get support from our dedicated ID specialists to help you recover from identity theft
• Credit monitoring alerts: Receive notifications of key changes to your Equifax credit report through our monitoring alerts
Equifax Complete™ Family Plan — Get all Equifax Complete Premier features plus help look after your family by adding a second adult plus lock and monitor the Equifax credit file for up to 4 children.
WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW
*The credit scores provided are based on the VantageScore® 3.0 model. For three-bureau VantageScore credit scores, data from Equifax®, Experian®, and TransUnion® are used respectively. Any one-bureau VantageScore uses Equifax data. Third parties use many different types of credit scores and are likely to use a different type of credit score to assess your creditworthiness.
**WebScan searches for your Social Security number, up to 5 passport numbers, up to 6 bank account numbers, up to 6 credit/debit card numbers, up to 6 email addresses, and up to 10 medical ID numbers. WebScan searches thousands of Internet sites where consumers' personal information is suspected of being bought and sold, and regularly adds new sites to the list of those it searches. However, the Internet addresses of these suspected Internet trading sites are not published and frequently change, so there is no guarantee that we are able to locate and search every possible Internet site where consumers' personal information is at risk of being traded.

bluejetty:00173608:ios.name: GPS Odometer
bluejetty:00173608:ios.summary: A simple and easy to use odometer. GPS Odometer only does one thing, and does it well: measure distance traveled. Ideal for almost anything that requires measuring outdoor distance traveled such as walking, running, driving, boating, hiking
bluejetty:00173608:ios.description:
A simple and easy to use odometer. GPS Odometer only does one thing, and does it well: measure distance traveled. Ideal for almost anything that requires measuring outdoor distance traveled such as walking, running, driving, boating, hiking, etc. Note that GPS does not work well under a roof. For best results, use outdoors.
Displays:
- Distance
- Time elapsed
- Speed (average or current)
- Displacement (straight line distance from your starting point). This can be hidden.
Distance units include:
- Kilometers
- Miles
- Nautical miles
- Meters
- Feet
Speed units include:
- Kilometers per hour
- Miles per hour
- Nautical miles per hour
- Meters per second
- Feet per second
Other features:
- Home screen Widgets.
- Large font adjustable display.
- Accurate to within 1 percent when compared to most car odometers under normal driving conditions.
- Approximates distance traveled in some GPS dead spots (such as driving through a tunnel) by adding the as-a-bird flies distance to your trip.
Please also note:
- GPS Odometer does run in the background if you leave it running. Be sure to pause the trip when you are finished or battery life will be negatively affected. The timer stops when the trip is paused.
Please visit the web page for more details.

bluejetty:00129059:ios.description:
Islamic World is a comprehensive Athan app designed to assist Muslims in their daily spiritual practices and rituals. Packed with useful features like accurate Islamic Prayer Times, Qibla Finder, Islamic Calendar, Zakat Calculator, Duas, Kalimas, and the Holy Quran, it’s the perfect app to support your faith. With additional features like Ramadan timings, Monthly Prayer Schedules, Nearby Mosques Finder, and Tasbih Counter, this app is a must-have for every Muslim.
Key Features
ISLAMIC PRAYER TIMES:
 - Accurate prayer times for Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha.
 - Azan notifications for each prayer time.
 - Highlighted upcoming prayer times with countdowns.
 - Monthly prayer schedules.
 - Apple Watch support for prayer notifications.
 - Today Widget support for quick access.
PRAYER TIME SETTINGS:
- Adjust prayer times manually.
- Customize sound notifications for each prayer.
- Choose from multiple prayer calculations and Juristic methods.
- Enable/Disable Daylight Saving Time and prayer notifications.
QIBLA FINDER:
 - Accurate Qibla direction with a compass pointing towards Makkah.
 - Qibla with mutliple themes option 
MOSQUES FINDER:
- Locate nearby mosques with distance and address details.
- View mosques on maps or in list format.
DUAS:
- Comprehensive collection of Duas in Arabic with English translations.
- Categories for all occasions: Morning, Evening, Ramadan, Hajj, and more.
QURAN:
 - Full Quran available in Arabic with English translation.
 - Offline Quran reading.
 - Highlighted audio playback makes it easier to follow Quran verses.
ISLAMIC CALENDAR:
 - Clean Islamic calendar with accurate Hijri dates.
 - Upcoming Muslim holidays and Islamic events.
TASBIH COUNTER:
 - Count your Dhikr or recite Allah’s names with a Tasbih counter.
 - Track Tasbih history.
ZAKAT CALCULATOR:
- Calculate your Zakat with ease.
- Keep a history of your Zakat calculations.
99 NAMES OF ALLAH (Asma Ul Husna):
- Read all 99 names in Arabic and English with meanings.
- Listen to audio recitations.
ADDITIONAL NOTES:
- Ensure your GPS and location settings are enabled for accurate Prayer Times and Qibla direction.
- Free to download and use.
- Share this app with friends and family to enrich their spiritual journey!
- Interactive content features, such as games, quizzes, and trending news
Download now and experience a complete Islamic app tailored for you!

bluejetty:00063483:ios.description:
Your letter has finally arrived! What kind of witch or wizard will you be? A heroic Gryffindor? A cunning Slytherin? A clever Ravenclaw? A loyal Hufflepuff? YOU decide! With countless choices, you’ll be able to carve out your own unique path in Harry Potter: Hogwarts Mystery.
This is YOUR Hogwarts journey. Whether you’re mastering powerful spells with Dumbledore, brewing potions with Snape, discovering never-before-seen rooms at Hogwarts, forging alliances with new friends, or duelling your rivals, there’s always something new to explore! As part of WBIE’s Portkey Games label, this groundbreaking mobile game puts you at the centre of an all-new story in the Wizarding World.
WITCHCRAFT & WIZARDRY:
• Learn magical spells and brew powerful potions!
• Unlock spells, potions, and locations as you advance through the years of Hogwarts!
• Immerse yourself in the world of Harry Potter!
• Take your place among witches and wizards!
MYSTERY & ADVENTURE:
• Use your skills to investigate mysteries at Hogwarts!
• Discover the puzzling truth behind the Cursed Vaults and your brother's disappearance in an all-new story!
• Choose carefully—your choices matter!
ENTER THE WIZARDING WORLD:
• Engage in immersive events, play Quidditch, and more!
• Win the House Cup with your classmates!
• Conjure your very own Patronus to defeat Dementors!
• Befriend Magical Creatures like the Niffler!
FRIENDSHIPS THAT MATTER:
• Embark on quests with fellow witches and wizards!
• Find romance and fall in love!
• Form unique relationships with each friend and rival!
EXPRESS YOUR CREATIVITY:
• Customise your avatar! Select from tons of exciting hair and clothing choices!
• Design your dream dorm! Show off your house pride and decorate your ideal space!
• New character customisation and dorm design choices are always being added!

Follow us on Twitter: www.twitter.com/HogwartsMystery 
Follow us on Instagram: www.instagram.com/HPHogwartsMystery

รับ-จ่าย :
• บันทึกรายได้และค่าใช้จ่าย เพื่อติดตามพฤติกรรมการใช้เงินได้แบบรายวัน รายเดือน แล
bluejetty:00065309:ios.description:
SET Happy Money Application ตัวช่วยบริหารจัดการเงิน เพื่อสร้างเงินออมสำหรับทุกเป้าหมายในชีวิต โดดเด่นด้วยฟังก์ชันที่จะทำให้ชีวิตการเงินคุณง่ายขึ้น
รับ-จ่าย :
• บันทึกรายได้และค่าใช้จ่าย เพื่อติดตามพฤติกรรมการใช้เงินได้แบบรายวัน รายเดือน และรายปี
• ตั้งงบประมาณ เพื่อควบคุมการใช้จ่ายในแต่ละวัน
• แยกหมวดหมู่รายได้ เพื่อวิเคราะห์แหล่งที่มาและความสม่ำเสมอของรายได้  
• แยกหมวดหมู่ค่าใช้จ่าย เพื่อวิเคราะห์ว่าควรปรับเพิ่มหรือลดสัดส่วนค่าใช้จ่ายประเภทใดในแต่ละเดือน
• สรุปยอดเงินคงเหลือ เพื่อดูฝีมือการบริหารรายได้ค่าใช้จ่ายในแต่ละเดือน 
สินทรัพย์-หนี้สิน : 
• บันทึกรายการสินทรัพย์และหนี้สินปัจจุบัน เพื่อให้รู้ฐานะการเงินว่าเป็นบวกหรือลบ สามารถอัปเดตข้อมูลทั้งแบบรายเดือน และรายปี
• แยกหมวดหมู่สินทรัพย์ เพื่อวิเคราะห์และวางแผนบริหารสินทรัพย์เพื่อนำไปสร้างรายได้เพิ่มหรือลดภาระหนี้สิน
• แยกหมวดหมู่หนี้สิน เพื่อวิเคราะห์และจัดลำดับในการจัดการหนี้
• เปรียบเทียบฐานะการเงินในอดีตและปัจจุบัน เพื่อดูความเปลี่ยนแปลงว่าเพิ่มขึ้นหรือลดลง ทั้งแบบรายเดือน และรายปี
วิเคราะห์ผล : 
•   วิเคราะห์สุขภาพการเงิน เพื่อหาจุดแข็งและจุดอ่อนทางการเงินในปัจจุบัน 
•   สรุปคำแนะนำ เพื่อวางแผนการเงินด้านต่างๆ อาทิ การบริหารสภาพคล่อง การชำระหนี้สิน การออมและการลงทุน เป็นต้น
ภาพรวม :
• สรุปข้อมูลทางการเงินที่สำคัญไว้ในหน้าเดียว อาทิ ค่าใช้จ่ายย้อนหลัง 7 วัน สัดส่วนค่าใช้จ่ายรายเดือน สินทรัพย์และหนี้สินล่าสุด เป็นต้น   
นอกจากนี้ ยังมีฟังก์ชั่นที่น่าสนใจ อาทิ การกำหนดเป้าหมายการออมและติดตามความคืบหน้า การตั้งงบประมาณเพื่อควบคุมค่าใช้จ่ายในแต่ละเดือน การตั้งเตือนบิลค่าใช้จ่าย การเชื่อมโยงไปยังแหล่งความรู้การเงินการลงทุน เป็นต้น

bluejetty:00119223:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00119223:ios.description:
CALL AND TEXT ON A SECOND PHONE NUMBER WITH A 3-DAY TRIAL SUBSCRIPTION
Hushed gives you a second phone number you can use for online dating, travel, shopping, moving, selling items, and more.
Choose from phone numbers in 300+ area codes and start calling and texting immediately on your very own Hushed number.
More than 25 million people have downloaded Hushed, making more than 450 million phone calls and sending more than 1 billion texts.
Why everyone loves Hushed:
INTERNET CALLING: Make phone calls over the internet (data or Wi-Fi) from anywhere in the world.
TEXT MESSAGES: Send and receive text messages, including photos and videos.
SECOND PHONE NUMBER: Get as many phone numbers as you want. Hushed makes it easy to manage different contacts and situations.
300+ AREA CODES: Pick a phone number with a United States area code, Canada area code, or United Kingdom area code — even if you’re travelling halfway across the world.
VOICEMAIL INCLUDED: Every Hushed number includes features like voicemail, call forwarding, call routing, and auto-reply texts.
VoIP TECHNOLOGY: Since Hushed calls and texts run over the internet using VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol), you can communicate worldwide without traditional long-distance charges.
NO SIM CARD NEEDED: Your Hushed numbers are stored in the app, so there’s no need to swap SIM cards.
NO CONTRACTS: Hushed keeps things flexible, and you can cancel anytime.
FLEXIBLE USE: Use your second phone number for short-term or long-term needs. Keep it as long as you’d like.
Popular reasons for getting a second phone number:
ONLINE DATING: Use a second phone number when connecting with new people.
SELLING ITEMS ONLINE: Add a second phone number to online listings and remove it later if you no longer need it.
MOVING: Get a second phone number in your new area code before you relocate. Perfect for setting up utilities and services.
TRAVEL: Add a second phone number in the area code you’ll be visiting to help manage calling costs.
FAMILY & FRIENDS: Choose a second phone number with a local area code for easier communication.
SHOPPING: Provide your Hushed number when signing up for store programs or offers.
ACCOUNT VERIFICATION: Some services allow Hushed numbers to receive verification codes by text or call, depending on their policies.
FORMS & SIGN-UPS: Use a second phone number when registering for websites, forms, or subscriptions.
Ready for a second phone number?
FLEXIBLE PLANS: Choose from 1- and 3-line subscriptions with U.S., Canada, or U.K. numbers. Enjoy unlimited calls and texts, with savings available on annual plans.
CONVENIENT BILLING: Subscriptions renew automatically unless deactivated at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle. Manage or cancel your subscription in your device settings under Settings / Subscriptions.
KEEP IN MIND: Hushed is not suitable for 911 or emergency services. Please use your primary phone number for emergency calls.
Download Hushed and get your own second phone number today. Need help? Our team is available 24/7 via live chat (hushed.com) or email (support@hushed.com).

bluejetty:00043142:ios.description:
Descubre la superapp que te da la experiencia más completa en movilidad. En Gopass sabemos que tu tiempo vale oro: olvídate del efectivo y de las filas, paga sin contacto desde la comodidad de tu vehículo y lleva todo en un solo lugar. Dale GO a tu vida con una superapp hecha para moverte sin interrupciones. 
Empieza a disfrutar de nuestro ecosistema de servicios: paga peajes, gasolina, parqueaderos (incluye Zonas de Parqueo Pago), SOAT, multas, autolavados, y lo mejor de todo, con un simple tag o desde tu celular. Lleva trazabilidad de tus movimientos y administra tus recargas en segundos. 
Usar la app es muy sencillo: primero, asocia tu tag a la placa del vehículo que quieras registrar; después, completa tus datos personales para guardar el medio de pago a debitar; y listo. Recibirás una notificación en tu celular cada vez que utilices un servicio, podrás identificar los puntos afiliados a Gopass para usar tu tag y revisar todas tus transacciones desde la superapp. 
No esperes más: dale GO a tu vida. 
IMPORTANTE: Para usar esta aplicación es necesario realizar el proceso de registro y crear una cuenta de acceso. Algunas funciones dependen de la disponibilidad por ciudad y aliados.

Descubre la superapp que te da la experiencia más completa en movilidad. En Gopass sabemos que tu tiempo vale oro: olvídate del efectivo y de las filas, paga sin contacto desde la comodidad de tu vehículo y lleva todo en un solo lugar. Dale GO a tu vida con una superapp hecha para moverte sin interrupciones. 

Empieza a disfrutar de nuestro ecosistema de servicios: paga peajes, gasolina, parqueaderos (incluye Zonas de Parqueo Pago), SOAT, multas, autolavados, y lo mejor de todo, con un simple tag o desde tu celular. Lleva trazabilidad de tus movimientos y administra tus recargas en segundos. 

Usar la app es muy sencillo: primero, asocia tu tag a la placa del vehículo que quieras registrar; después, completa tus datos personales para guardar el medio de pago a debitar; y listo. Recibirás una notificación en tu celular cada vez que utilices un servicio, podrás identificar los puntos afiliados a Gopass para usar tu tag y revisar todas tus transacciones desde la superapp. 

No esperes más: dale GO a tu vida. 

IMPORTANTE: Para usar esta aplicación es necesario realizar el proceso de registro y crear una cuenta de acceso. Algunas funciones dependen de la disponibilidad por ciudad y aliados.

bluejetty:00126999:ios.description:
La app Mi Sanitas cuida de nuestros clientes ofreciéndoles una forma más independiente para gestionar de manera autónoma todos los aspectos relacionados con su salud, en cualquier momento y desde cualquier lugar de manera rápida, fácil y sencilla.
Las gestiones que nuestros clientes pueden hacer a través de Mi Sanitas son:
Pedir citar con su médico, reprogramarlas y cancelarlas.
Consultar su cuadro médico para buscar médicos, hospitales y otros centros asistenciales así como clínicas dentales.
Consultar centros médicos con servicios de urgencias más cercanos.
Consultar los informes médicos así como las recetas de farmacia.
Solicitar reembolsos y autorizaciones.
Consultar recibos y copagos.
Actualizar los datos personales.
Acceder a la tarjeta digital.
Ceder permisos a otros beneficiarios de la póliza para que realice las gestiones en su nombre.
También incorporamos, según producto contratado, innovación en servicios de medicina digital como Monitoriza tu Salud, Cuida tu Mente, Medición de Constantes Vitales, Evaluador de Síntomas, Consulta digital (videoconsulta y consulta telefónica), …
Para hacer un correcto uso de Mi Sanitas solicitamos los siguientes permisos:
Calendario: para guardar las citas en la agenda.
Ubicación: para mostrar los médicos y centros más próximos.
Fotos/multimedia/archivos: para que puedas subir documentos en distintas secciones de Mi Sanitas.
Cámara: para que puedas hacer una foto de los documentos y los puedas adjuntar desde tu dispositivo.
Micrófono: para que puedas realizar videocosultas
Nuestra aplicación usa HealtKit para poder actualizar tu información Salud de forma automática.
Y otros datos requeridos que permiten que puedas disfrutar de un correcto uso de Mi Sanitas.
En Sanitas estamos comprometidos con proporcionar el mejor servicio a nuestros clientes, por eso les escuchamos y seguimos trabajando para satisfacer sus necesidades y ofrecerles cada vez un mejor servicio. Si tienes un seguro de Sanitas y tienes alguna sugerencia o incidencia al usar Mi Sanitas, no dudes en escribirnos a usuariosmovil@sanitas.es. Recuerda que también puedes acceder a Mi Sanitas a través de tu navegador en sanitas.es/misanitas

bluejetty:00065251:ios.name: Rainbow - Ethereum Wallet
bluejetty:00065251:ios.summary:
Rainbow is a fun, simple, and secure way to get started with crypto and explore the new world of Ethereum. You can use Rainbow to manage and display Ethereum-based assets on mainnet, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, and Zora.
Rainbow is
bluejetty:00065251:ios.description:
Rainbow is a fun, simple, and secure way to get started with crypto and explore the new world of Ethereum. You can use Rainbow to manage and display Ethereum-based assets on mainnet, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, Base, and Zora.
Rainbow is open source and an active member of the Ethereum community, making us one of the ecosystem's most well-loved and trusted wallets.
With Rainbow, you can...
- Watch wallets and follow any public Ethereum address
- Customizable real-time notifications for wallet activity
- Find helpful articles, trending tokens, and new assets in the Discover section
- Use WalletConnect to connect to decentralized apps and websites like Uniswap, OpenSea, Mirror, Aave and more
- A beautiful interface and design that makes Web3 and crypto a joy
- Send/receive assets to ENS usernames instead of long addresses
- Full transaction history and token discovery
- Multiple wallet support and a way to quickly switch between them
- Built-in Flashbots Protect safety on your Ethereum transactions
- Bring your own wallet by importing your seed phrase from MetaMask and other wallets
- Optional iCloud Backup to help avoid losing assets if your device or recovery phrase goes missing
- Additional new features added every single month!
For support or assistance, email us at support@rainbow.me
For feedback or feature requests, email us at hello@rainbow.me or find us on Twitter @rainbowdotme

bluejetty:00094118:ios.name: Ocean Clash
bluejetty:00094118:ios.summary:
Protect the Coast in Ocean Clash– Helicopter Shooting Game!
Welcome to Ocean Clash, the ultimate FPS shooting game where you fly a powerful helicopter and guard your coast from invading enemy forces. 
In this fast-paced arcade-style shoote
bluejetty:00094118:ios.description:
Protect the Coast in Ocean Clash– Helicopter Shooting Game!
Welcome to Ocean Clash, the ultimate FPS shooting game where you fly a powerful helicopter and guard your coast from invading enemy forces. 
In this fast-paced arcade-style shooter, your mission is clear: defend your team, shoot down ships, and protect your territory from waves of army and navy attackers. 
Take control of advanced military helicopters, launch attacks on incoming enemies, and become the hero your coast desperately needs.
Shoot Enemies and Defend Your Base
It’s time to gear up! 
As the enemy closes in from sea and land, you’ll be the first—and last—line of defense. 
From massive navy ships to surprise army ambushes, your coast is under siege. Y
our job is to shoot enemies, take out threats from the sky, and rescue your team from danger. 
Guard your coast with accuracy and power. Each mission becomes more intense, demanding quick decisions and fast reflexes. 
Love FPS games? 
You’ll enjoy the thrill of aiming from a moving chopper as explosions light up the battlefield. Love simulation and strategy? 
Manage your upgrades, track performance, and improve your setup to survive harder stages.
Easy Controls, Real FPS Action
You don’t need to be a pro to dominate. With auto-fire, you just aim—and your weapons handle the rest. 
Fly, shoot, rescue, and survive with smooth controls that make playing easy and fun. 
Perfect for fans of hypercasual, FPS, or sniper games, Ocean Clash balances intuitive controls with intense action. 
No complicated menus or training required—just get in the air and start shooting!
Unlock & Upgrade Your Helicopter Arsenal
Every mission earns you rewards—and with them, you can upgrade your helicopter, improve your weapons, and expand your power. 
Choose from a range of weapons, each with different attack styles and stats. 
Whether you want to build a fast strike chopper or a heavy-duty gunship, you’re in control. 
You’ll also unlock and enhance: Machine guns for fast-paced battles, Armor and flight upgrades to last longer in combat. 
Your chopper is your kingdom—manage it like a true navy general.
Conquer Missions Around the World
From tropical islands to urban coastlines, battle across multiple locations with stunning 3D visuals and rich environments. 
Each level is handcrafted to offer variety, challenge, and excitement. Boss fights, time-limited missions, and wave-based attacks will keep you on edge. 
Save survivors, hold your ground, and destroy everything that threatens your team.
Play Anywhere, Anytime – No WiFi Required
Whether you’re commuting, traveling, or just bored at work, Ocean Clash is your go-to shooter. 
No internet? No problem. This offline FPS game is designed for maximum fun anytime you want it. 
Just open the app and dive into battle.
Download Now and Guard Your Coast!
The enemy is coming. Your coast is vulnerable. The skies are yours—fly, shoot, defend.
Join Ocean Clash today and become the commander of your own helicopter shooting force. 
With thrilling missions, easy controls, powerful upgrades, and non-stop action, your next adventure is waiting.
Download Ocean Clash – Helicopter FPS Shooting Game now and protect your world from the skies!

bluejetty:00170809:ios.summary:
Taking you back to your childhood, playing ludo game with your friends online!

bluejetty:00170809:ios.description:
Taking you back to your childhood, playing ludo game with your friends online!
Golden Ludo, an incredible app with group voice chatting and exciting games.
Voice chatting while playing ludo, which makes the game experience more exciting!
Free Group Voice Chat 
You can create your group voice chat room by anytime and anywhere, invite your friends to have fun together or wait for new friends to join. Start a wonderful relationship!
You can chat with your friends by voice or text, enjoy the fun of group chatting.
Various Game Modes
3 Modes of Ludo available:
Duel Mode, 4 Players Mode, and 2 VS 2 Mode.
Besides the classic Ludo and quick mode, there are more exciting and joyful game modes for you.
Different modes with different rules.
Classic Mode: This mode supports 2-4 players to play with each other.
Quick Mode: In this mode, you have to kick back one star of other players before you reach the destination.
Special Mode
The special mode includes exciting items to make the game more interesting.
LUDO online-chatting feature
Chatting with other players: You can send messages, voice and emojis while playing Ludo online, you can also add new friends, inviting them to play together or challenging them.
You can also check their game information of Ludo, for example, victories and winning rate etc.
Tags in Voice Chatting
You can add any tag to your voice room, such as singing ,chatting, dancing, etc. Adding tags will make your room distinctive from other rooms, which helps you to find more friends with common interests.
Cool & Fabulous gifts 
In Golden Ludo, you have many interesting and fantastic 3D gifts to send to your friends for showing respect of each other and strengthening the friendship, and believe that your friends will send back to you more amazing gifts.
With Golden Ludo, you can meet new people to play Ludo together anytime and anywhere, you can also chat with them freely without restrictions. More interesting things here waiting for you to discover.
In Golden Ludo, interesting and warm-hearted peoples are always here waiting for you!

bluejetty:00092183:ios.description:
At DROP, we make a complete line of water treatment and management products that improves your water quality, monitors your water usage and notifies you of potential problems, and can even automatically shut off the water supply if a leak is detected. Using DROP Connect, you can configure and monitor your DROP water management system -- even when you are away from home.
With DROP Connect you can:
- Receive notifications for anomalous water usage or problems with your DROP system.
- Conveniently view the valve and system status.
- Easily change valve and system settings.
- View current water flow and water usage information for the past three months.
- View a history of events.
- Start and monitor a regeneration or backwash cycle from your phone or tablet.
- Add or remove devices (such as valves or leak detectors) on your DROP network.
- Configure your DROP water management system so you can access it when you are away from home.
Note that you must have a DROP hub to use DROP Connect, and you must have a Wi-Fi network with a working internet connection to access your DROP system remotely. You can learn about DROP products at https://dropconnect.com

bluejetty:00184997:ios.description:
PicStash is a blur photo editor. You can blur your images with multiple features.
-- Cover photo with blur
You can make a photo totally blurred.
1. Select the photo you want to blur.
2. Select blur type (Blur / Dot / Mosaic).
3. Select blur level.
4. Press the "Save" button.
-- Blur by finger
You can make a photo blur with your finger.
1. Select the photo you want to blur.
2. Select blur type (Blur / Dot / Mosaic).
3. Select blur level.
4. Select brush width.
5. Swipe a port of the photo that you want to blur.
6. Press the "Save" button.
— Apply a tilt-shift blur effect
You can add tilt-shift blur to your photo.
1. Select the photo you want to blur.
2. Select blur type (Blur / Dot / Mosaic).
3. Select blur level.
4. Press the "Save" button.
— Blur photo with multi-masks
You can blur a photo with some shapes.
1. Select the photo you want to blur.
2. Add a shape mask for blur.
3. Select blur type (Blur / Dot / Mosaic).
4. Select blur level.
5. Press the "Save" button.
— Face tracking mode.
You can blur faces that are detected.
1. Select the photo you want to blur.
2. Tern on/off blur switches for faces.
2. Select blur type (Blur / Dot / Mosaic).
3. Select blur level.
4. Press the "Save" button.
* Face detection is only run on your device. Therefore this app doesn't send any images to servers for detection.
- Blur background mode.
This mode requires iOS15 or later. 
1. Select the image you want to blur.
2. The background will automatically be blurred.
3. You can adjust the blurred area with your finger(blur/eraser).
2. Select blur type (Blur / Dot / Mosaic).
3. Select blur level.
4. Press the "Save" button.

bluejetty:00073196:ios.name: Rub Adventure: Mystery Island
bluejetty:00073196:ios.summary: If you come looking for a game in the platform genre, give it a try for Rub Adventure as it is definitely a funny challenge for you. Jump and Run, Jump and Run through 200 awesomely spectacular places in every level to find the chest of gol
bluejetty:00073196:ios.description:
If you come looking for a game in the platform genre, give it a try for Rub Adventure as it is definitely a funny challenge for you. Jump and Run, Jump and Run through 200 awesomely spectacular places in every level to find the chest of gold. Try not to bump into the beastly enemies and easily kill them by making high jumps over their heads . Use your smooth, easy moves to guide Meno on his adventure and nothing can stop him from collecting all the coins 
The controls are fluid, the level design is fun, and gameplay all together takes a fun spin on classic 2D games. Every level is different and they get harder as you go. They are just hard enough to be entertaining. Like any other games in the family, this game has so much to do with quickness and also intelligence.
Also, check out the skins to see what your most favorite character is! 
Tips for you to get stronger against the evil enemies. Seek out 3 types of power ups that are intentionally hidden in some places that are not easily visible, or you can buy all of them in store with the coins you collected:
+ Get "Size x4" to become super giant and undefeatable
+ Get "Fire Bullet" to shoot the enemies
+ Get "Shield" to protect in a limited amount of time from any rivals attack
What makes Super Meno have its own thing and stand out:
- Make double jumps to higher places where possible
- Dive into the marine with many lively creatures
- Super bigger Meno can kick away any enemies on the way like a roller coaster..
- Some hidden places with lots of bonus coins are covered! Try to discover every corner of the level maps otherwise you will miss out on the huge treasure you deserve.
- Various world themes symbolize the diverse adventure you needs to get through: marine, jungle, galaxy,...
- In some levels designed, the pets follow Meno and sometimes hurt him. Why? Let’s check it out in the Rub Adventure game yourself and we're sure there are many surprise are waiting for you!

Dive deep into NBA data, track NFL and NHL trends, or get a read on college football props. Compare projections, filter by odds or matchups, and visualize every key stat and performance trends.
PLAYER PROPS FOR YOUR FAVORITE SPORTS
RotoWire Picks has player props data, sports stats and outlier picks for all your favorite sports and betting markets.

- NBA
- NFL
- NHL
- MLB
- WNBA
- Soccer
- UFC / MMA
- PGA
- College Football

- CS2

Plus we’re always adding more!
SYNCED WITH THE BIGGEST DFS OPERATORS & SPORTSBOOKS

However, RotoWire Picks is automatically synced with the biggest:
- PrizePicks
- Underdog Fantasy
- FanDuel
- DraftKings
- DraftKings Pick 6
- Sleeper
- BetMGM
- BetRivers
- RTSports
And we’ll continue adding new partners.
PLAYER PROP PROMOS
Keep notifications on as you’ll get sportsbook and DFS promotions as they hit the market.
PrizePicks offering a discounted line? You’ll get notified.
So you never miss a chance at finding a player props edge.
You’ll notice a clear projection table that’s easy to consume with 4 variables:
- DFS Pick’Em Sites - 35% of the score
- Sportsbooks - 35% of the score
- RotoWire’s Projections - 15% of the score
- Hit Rate - 15% of the score 
ROTOWIRE EXCELLENCE
With 25+ years in fantasy expertise, we know the importance of injury news and lineup changes, so you can have confidence that our projections include up-to-the-minute information.
ABOUT US
RotoWire is your premium fantasy sports resource. We pioneered real-time fantasy sports news and Player Notes back in 1997 when the Internet was just taking flight.
We've stayed ahead of imitators with the most in-depth analysis, the fastest real-time news and the largest scope of coverage of any fantasy sports site or app.

bluejetty:00030350:ios.description:
Take control of your car buying. 84% of car purchases contain tricks and traps that pad profits at your expense. CoPilot protects you from dealership tricks and traps by handling the back-and-forth, spotting red flags, and arming you to buy with confidence. Search new and used cars, trucks, SUVs, minivans, EVs & hybrids across virtually every dealership near you, every day.
EXPERT AGENTS, 100% ON YOUR SIDE
Your CoPilot AI agents work on your behalf through the entire car buying process:
 • Communication Agent: Handles all dealership back-and-forth so you don't have to. No more spam calls, texts, or emails. No pressure, no wasted time.
 • Scam Protection Agent: Analyzes every line of your purchase to spot tricks and traps before you're stuck at the dealership. See a complete final price breakdown that separates legitimate costs from overcharges, unnecessary add-ons, and illegitimate fees.
 • Negotiation Agent: Prepares you to negotiate with confidence, armed with data-backed insights and CoPilot best practices. Walk into any dealership prepared, not vulnerable.
FREE CAR SHOPPING. NO DEALERSHIP BIAS.
 • Search virtually every dealership near you, including cars other apps miss
 • Personalized rankings based on what matters to you, not what benefits the dealership
 • Price history, market value analysis, and vehicle history, all in one place
 • Instant alerts when prices drop or new inventory matches your preferences
 • Every car rated so you can spot the "A+" buys at a glance
HOW COPILOT WORKS
 • Tell us the type of car you want and your must-have features.
 • Your CoPilot searches and ranks new and pre-owned cars across virtually every US dealership, 24/7, to find the best matches for you.
 • Get alerted first when new inventory hits the lot. Discover feature-loaded, low-mileage cars at highly rated dealerships you never knew existed.
 • When you're ready to buy, activate CoPilot Buying. Your expert agent handles dealership communications, identifies red flags in your purchase, and arms you with everything you need to buy with confidence.
WHAT MAKES COPILOT DIFFERENT
 • We never take money from dealerships, so they can't influence our results
 • Your information stays private. We never share it with dealerships.
 • No spam, no pressure. Your AI agent handles all communication.
 • AI-powered analysis spots tricks other buyers miss
As featured in Bloomberg, CNN, CNBC, MarketWatch, NPR, New York Times, Forbes, TechCrunch, Newsweek, and more.
Don't panic, you have an expert on your side. Download CoPilot and never buy solo again.

bluejetty:00120375:ios.summary: My City Newborn baby is a game where you can create your own adventure and play out any story you want. Newborn Baby brings to My City real life locations such as the doctor office where mom goes for checkups, Baby store so the baby has eve
bluejetty:00120375:ios.description:
My City Newborn baby is a game where you can create your own adventure and play out any story you want. Newborn Baby brings to My City real life locations such as the doctor office where mom goes for checkups, Baby store so the baby has everything it needs, Delivery room and even a place to celebrate the new family members. My City games are connected together, this means you can bring the babies home for an even bigger adventure! 
Create your own newborn story 
Perhaps you have a new brother or sister on the way, perhaps you just like babies because they are cute. With My City : Newborn baby you have all you need to create you next role play story adventure. Delivery room, Dr. Checkup office, baby store, hundreds of accessories and clothing. We have even added new strollers! 
RECOMMENDED AGE GROUP
My City games are great for Kids aged 4-12 and even higher. Our games promote imagination and exploration.My City games are safe to play even when parents are out of the room. 
Play Together
We support multi-touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
GAME FEATURES:
- Roleplay storytelling game for kids with real life locations such as Baby Hospital, Baby Store, Baby Dr. office, Celebration Hut.
- New Characters you can use in other My City games and NEW clothing for pregnant moms!
Take pregnant mom to the hospital and in to the delivery room. Now close the curtain and see what happens!
- New baby strollers added, visit the baby store to find them.
- Surprises and gifts are hiding everywhere. Can you find the secret room?
- Use the new subway to travel between My City streets
- Check up Dr. office, customize your party and bring the baby home, super real roll playing game for kids!
- A variety of characters to play with. Which one would you like to have?
- Night Day option.
- The game connects to other My City games, move characters, clothing and items between games as if they are one large game!
To Connect the game to other My City games you should:
1. Have your apps downloaded on the device
2. Update your My City games
ABOUT MY TOWN
The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open ended play for your children all over the world. Loved by children and parents alike, My Town games introduce environments and experiences for hours of imaginative play. The company has offices in Israel, Spain, Romania and the Philippines. For more information, please visit www.my-town.com
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com
Get privacy-related information at https://www.my-town.com/privacy-policy/

O app "gov.br" (antes Meu gov.br) está renovado para que você tenha uma experiência mais simplificada: 
- Para começar, você pode acessar o app sem fazer o reconhecimento facial e se precisar criar sua conta gov.br, já faremos pelo app.

- E para deixar sua conta mais segura, pode aumentar o nível dela para prata ou ouro! 
Tudo isso disponível no novo app, mantendo o que já era útil: prova de vida digital, recebimento de notificações para assinar documentos eletrônicos e muito mais!

bluejetty:00024267:ios.name: Secure Vault: Hide Photos
bluejetty:00024267:ios.summary:
Secure Vault keeps your private photos, videos, files, notes, passwords and contacts behind an app passcode on your iPhone. They are encrypted right on your device. No ads, no tracking, no account.
ENCRYPTED ON YOUR DEVICE
• Photos, videos
bluejetty:00024267:ios.description:
Secure Vault keeps your private photos, videos, files, notes, passwords and contacts behind an app passcode on your iPhone. They are encrypted right on your device. No ads, no tracking, no account.
ENCRYPTED ON YOUR DEVICE
• Photos, videos, files, notes, passwords and contacts are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The key is created on your iPhone and kept in the iOS Keychain.
• Items added with an earlier version are encrypted automatically after the update.
• What you keep in the vault is never sent to Nikmesoft.
• Privacy Check, in Settings, shows what is protected and how.
LOCK IT YOUR WAY
• App passcode, separate from your device passcode.
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Repeated wrong passcodes add a waiting time before the next try.
HIDE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
• Pick many photos and videos at once from your library, then choose whether to delete the originals from Photos.
• Take photos and record videos with the camera straight into the vault.
• Add photos and videos from the Files app.
• Organize them in albums, mark favorites and find recent items.
• Export your photos, videos and files to a ZIP file whenever you need it.
NOTES, PASSWORDS AND CONTACTS
• Keep private notes, website logins and contacts in their own tabs, with search.
PREMIUM
• Unlimited items. The free version keeps up to 20 photos, videos and files, with every security feature; albums are unlimited.
• Private browser: cookies, cache and history are kept in memory only and erased when the app closes. Photos and videos you download go straight into your encrypted vault.
• Wi-Fi transfer: move files between a computer and an album over your Wi-Fi network, protected by a one-time 6-digit PIN. The connection is plain HTTP, so the app reminds you before each start to use it only on a Wi-Fi network you trust. It stops when you leave the screen, after 5 minutes without activity, and after 30 minutes at most.
• Panic switch: shake your iPhone or turn it face down to jump to Safari, Messages, Maps or Music.
• Choose a different home screen icon.
GOOD TO KNOW
• Your passcode cannot be recovered. If you forget it, the vault cannot be opened, and deleting the app deletes the vault.
• To move to a new iPhone, use iCloud Backup or an encrypted computer backup. An unencrypted computer backup does not carry the encryption key.
• File and album names are not encrypted.
PRIVACY
No ads, no tracking, no data sold. The only data the app sends are anonymous crash and performance reports (Firebase Crashlytics) that are not linked to you.
SUBSCRIPTIONS AND PURCHASES
Premium is available as a yearly auto-renewing subscription, which may start with a free trial, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices and any trial are shown in the app before you buy.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends.
• A subscription renews automatically at the same price unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
• Manage or cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Deleting the app does not cancel a subscription.
• Already bought Premium? Open Premium and tap Restore Purchases.
Terms of Use: https://nikmesoft.com/apps/calculatorz/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://nikmesoft.com/apps/calculatorz/privacy/

bluejetty:00179599:ios.summary: GRAN FONDO is a magazine for both mavericks and professionals. For traditionalists and visionaries, creative minds and explorers. For enthusiasts and athletes, adventurers and tech lovers. GRAN FONDO is a magazine for open-minded individual
bluejetty:00179599:ios.description:
GRAN FONDO is a magazine for both mavericks and professionals. For traditionalists and visionaries, creative minds and explorers. For enthusiasts and athletes, adventurers and tech lovers. GRAN FONDO is a magazine for open-minded individuals that share the same passion for the sport. 
** KEY FEATURES **
Early Access
Read our latest tests and reviews before everyone else: most of our articles are first available exclusively on the app.
Read Offline
Download once, always carry it with you and read everywhere. You can even read offline.
Completely Free
Hard to believe: not only the app itself but also all of the content is completely free. No hidden costs. We promise.
Interactive Reading Experience
We'll leave half-heartedly digitalized print media to other apps. Our issues are designed exclusively for the digital format and are packed with interactive features and videos.
Tons of Content
Never get bored again: our app gives you access to all back issues of GRAN FONDO – completely free.
News Feed
Besides our digital publications, the app also includes the latest news from our website – direct and easy.
English and German
Experience GRAN FONDO in the language of your choice: we publish all issues in German and in English.
** WHAT'S INSIDE? **
Quality Reviews
Our experienced team reviews the most exciting bikes and products for each issue, writing honest and accurate reviews to help you make informed purchasing decisions.
Inspiring Essays
Cycling is so much more than riding your bicycle. We want to show you the sides of it that inspire you to head off into new adventures and perhaps get you to think.
The Best Bike Destinations
Longing to ride on new roads? Our travel stories include lots of tips for your next bike holiday and show you the most beautiful bike destinations.
Full of Surprises
We love variety as much as you do. That's why you want to continue surprising and inspiring you. Issue after issue, year after year. Are you ready?
For any feedback, feature suggestions or if you need help, feel free to reach out to us at hello@granfondo-cycling.com.

bluejetty:00023120:ios.description:
According to researchers at the Harvard Medical School, “Gratitude helps people feel more positive emotions, relish good experiences, improve their health, deal with adversity, and build strong relationships.” Grateful was created to make expressing gratitude in your life both easy and fun, as well as to remind you, during those down moments, of the many blessings in your life (that you've documented in Grateful). 
*Daily Prompts to Start You Off*
With its simple interface and daily prompts, Grateful is designed to make reflection and giving thanks both a joyful and easy process. Daunted by a blank page? Not quite sure where to start? Grateful will greet you with one question, such as. 'What made you smile today'? or 'What made today a good day?'. All you have to do is answer. It can be a simple word. Or a simple paragraph. Grateful allows for both. You can also add a photo to support your thoughts.
*Easy to Browse your Past Entries*
Grateful's simple journal feed lets you browse your entries by TIME or by PROMPT. Want to see all the things that made you smile this year? Jump to those entries in your timeline. Want to see what your state of mind was last January? Jump to that month in your timeline.
*Our Prompts or Yours*
Grateful gives you the flexibility to make the journal truly yours. When sit down to write an entry, Grateful will start you off with a prompt. You have the option of:
1.) Answering the prompt
2.) Choosing a different prompt
3.) Writing your own prompt
*Totally Private*
No sign ups. No logins. No Facebook integration. All you data resides only on your device.
FREE Features:
• 15 journal entries
• Unlimited reminders
• No login of any kind required. This journal is for you only.
• Each session starts with a prompt, making writing easy.
• Grateful lets you answer the prompt and also save any additional thoughts for later reading.
• Ability to edit past entries
• Customize your timeline - show entries by time, prompt, tag, or randomly
Additional PREMIUM Features 
(available with one-time upgrade or with a Growth Bundle subscription):
• Unlimited entries (Free version allows 15 entries)
• Data backup with Dropbox and iCloud
• Passcode with Face ID for added privacy security 
• Ability to create your own prompts to answer
• Export your entries to file (PDF or CSV format)
Grateful‘s GROWTH BUNDLE is an optional monthly or annual subscription. If you choose to upgrade, payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, for the chosen plan's price.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your iTunes/App Store Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. 
Read more about our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy here:
• Terms of Service: https://growthbundle.com/terms-of-service/
• Privacy Policy: https://growthbundle.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00123942:ios.description:
# Hit Home Runs With Simple and Easy Controls!
Hold and release to hit some hard-hitting home runs!
Hit more powerful home runs to dominate the competition!
# Match in Real Time With Batters From Around the World
Compete in real-time matches with sluggers from all around the world, anytime anywhere!!
Play short yet sweet memorable matches!
# Train Your Very Own Heavy-hitting Slugger
A spy, a cheerleader, a wrestler...?
Train various characters with unique characteristics and gear them up!
# Various Playable Content
- 1vs1 Match: The fundamental 1-on-1 competitive game mode!
- Battle Royale: An intense 4-person online survival game mode!
- Challenge Mode: A single-player experience where you compete for a high score.
- Adventure Mode: A single-player experience where you can test your limits.
- Story Mode: A single-player story mode experience where you can learn more about the players.
# More Intense Competitive Content
- Tournaments: A regularly held event for sluggers only. Epic rewards are given!
- World Championship: A special 1vs1 Match that takes place in locations around the world.
- Battle Royale World Series: A special battle royale that takes place in locations around the world.
- World Challenge: A game of survival where 100 heavy hitters participate at the same time.
- Clan Battle: A competitive game mode for the clans. Join one and get in on the fun!
※ Use of illegal programs, modified apps, and other unauthorized methods to access the game may result in service restrictions, removal of game accounts and data, claims for compensation of damages, and other remedies deemed necessary under the Terms of Service.

bluejetty:00062866:ios.description:
Experience Worship Online Like Never Before!
We’ve added exciting new features to help make learning your set a breeze:
• Improved Chord Charts – Customizable, transposable, clearer, and more user-friendly.
• Fully Customizable Audio Mixer – Change the key of any song and adjust levels which means you can learn the songs exactly how you're playing it on Sunday.
• Manage Your Team and Setlists – Easily organize and prepare your worship team for success!
Stop stressing about learning your parts for Sunday—We got you!
Worship Online is used by over 20,000 worship musicians and vocalists to prepare for their worship sets each week! Cut your preparation time in half. Guaranteed!
Get instant access to the highest quality worship tutorials taught exactly how it's played/sung on the album! Including:
• Electric Guitar
• Acoustic Guitar
• Keyboard
• Drums

Whether you’re an individual musician or a worship leader seeking to equip your team, we have the tools to excellently prepare you for worship while giving you back hours of your time.
With tutorials, lessons, chord/number charts, and transposable guitar/bass tabs, you can master your setlist with ease!
Our instructors currently play for, and have previously played for, some of the most popular worship artists in the world, including: Kari Jobe, Lauren Daigle, Elevation Worship, Bethel, Chris Tomlin, Matt Redman, Vertical Worship Band, Passion Band, and many more!

bluejetty:00139579:ios.summary:
Discover the World of Coins, Banknotes, and Exonumia with our Coin Scanner: Collector App ! 
Your all-in-one app for identifying, valuing, and managing your coin, banknote, and exonumia collection. 
Whether you're an experienced numismatist
bluejetty:00139579:ios.description:
Discover the World of Coins, Banknotes, and Exonumia with our Coin Scanner: Collector App ! 
Your all-in-one app for identifying, valuing, and managing your coin, banknote, and exonumia collection. 
Whether you're an experienced numismatist or just starting out, Coin Scanner: Banknote & Exonumia helps you explore and understand the fascinating world of money with ease and precision.
Identify Any Coin Instantly
Just snap a picture or upload an image—Coin Scanner uses powerful AI to identify any coin in seconds. Whether it’s an ancient artifact, modern currency, or a rare minting, the app provides detailed insights, including denomination, year, country, metal composition, and more.
Explore CoinFacts & Coin Guide
Dive deep into our growing CoinFacts library—an educational resource packed with historical information, interesting facts, and expert insights. Our Coin Guide helps you learn about the evolution, rarity, and significance of coins, banknotes, and exonumia from around the world. Perfect for both curious learners and serious collectors.
Check Coin Price & Market Value
Get real-time updates on Coin Price and market value. Whether you're buying, selling, or just curious, the Check Value feature gives you access to up-to-date pricing trends, based on global collector market data. Make smart decisions with confidence.
Manage Various Coin Collections
Effortlessly manage your collection using intuitive tools. Add photos, notes, and personal details to keep track of your various coin collections. Whether it's ancient Roman coins, American cents, commemorative banknotes, or tokens and medals (exonumia), everything stays organized in one place.
Covers Coins, Banknotes, and Exonumia
From classic coins and rare banknotes, to tokens, medallions, and other exonumia, this app is designed to support every area of numismatics. Coin Scanner: Banknote & Exonumia covers both mainstream and obscure items to help you identify and appreciate them all.
Key Features
- Instant Identification via camera or gallery
- Comprehensive Database with global coverage
- Accurate Market Values for collectibles

bluejetty:00161599:ios.description:
WikiWord (ВикиСлово) is the most comprehensive Russian dictionary available today (more than 450,000 articles). 
Here you can find everything about any word: 
 • spelling, pronunciation and word forms,
 • definition and origin, 
 • translations into English, French, German, Spanish, Chinese and Ukrainian, 
 • synonyms and antonyms, 
 • examples of use,
 • cognate words, 
 • idioms, collocations and proverbs,
and much more.
The dictionary is being improved and updated every day. And no ads!
ATTENTION! Without a subscription for 'Offline mode', the app requires internet access.
Our app helps to make the use of the Wiktionary easy and handy:
RICH ARTICLES
 • Compact and full view, semantic coloring. The structure of articles is improved.
 • Selection of vocabulary zones to view (word forms, synonyms, examples, phrases, etc.).
 • Popup mini-articles for any word or phrase from the article. Tap on the popup to open a full page.
 • 15,000 images (are downloaded from the Internet).
 • Brief encyclopedic information from Wikipedia.
 • Voice pronunciations made by native Russian speakers (for 14,000 high-frequency words). In other cases, speech synthesis is used.
SMART SEARCH
 • Phrases search, correction of typos and spelling errors. Obscene and foreign-language articles are filtered.
 • Voice input (works without the Internet on iOS 13+). 
 • Search History: articles previously viewed are available offline. 
LEARN RUSSIAN 
 • Complete Russian GRAMMAR RULES: spelling and punctuation.
 • THE WORD OF THE DAY is a great opportunity to learn something new about Russian every day.
 • Random interesting articles.
 • Favorites with custom collections.
OFFLINE MODE (when subscribe or make a one-time purchase). 
 The offline dictionary is very compact and fast.
 Additionally, the following features are available for Offline mode only:
 • Improved search (Russian morphology support, word-by-word search for complex phrases, etc.).
 • Obscene language - for users 16+.
 • Full-fledged translations into English (83,000 words), Chinese (38,000 words), and Ukrainian (123,000 words) languages.
 • Regular updates of the offline dictionary.
 • Sync your History and Favorites via iCloud with all your iOS devices.
EXTRA FEATURES
 • Simple navigation using one hand.
 • Use from any applications: the word from the clipboard.
 • Slide Over и Split View mode for iPad.
 • Saves internet traffic compared to the web Wiktionary.
SUBSCRIPTION TO OFFLINE MODE
To work with the Dictionary in the absence of an internet connection, you can subscribe to OFFLINE MODE. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Please note: the subscription is automatically renewed at the end of the current period unless you choose to cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription from your Account Settings after purchase. You cannot cancel the subscription on the current active period.
