Privacy Policy: https://rifmovnik.ru/ios/privacy
Also, there is a one-time in-app purchase - 'Offline Unlimited'.
We would appreciate your positive reviews on the App Store.

bluejetty:00127234:ios.description:
Bidding and predicting wins are what make playing Bid Whist fun and exciting, whether you win or lose.
The objective of Bid Whist is to score 7 or more points or force the other team to go negative 7 or more points.
Bid Whist is played with 4 players consisting of two teams. Each player sits opposite their partner. It is played with a standard 52 card deck plus 2 jokers. The 2 jokers must be distinct, big joker and the other is the little joker. Each player receives 12 cards. During the deal, 6 cards are to be placed face down in the center of the table to form a kitty.
Bidding starts with the player to the left of the dealer. Each bid consists of a number from 3 to 7, and a suffix “Uptown”, “Downtown”, or “No trump”. The highest bidder chooses the trump suit, or in the case of a no-trump bid specifies whether it will be played uptown or downtown. The bidder then picks up the 6 kitty cards and discards away 6 cards.
If the bid is no trump, all the suits are non-trump suits. If there is a trump suit in the upcoming hand, and if jokers are being used, the jokers become the best cards of the trump suit (better than the ace) regardless of whether high-ranking cards or low-ranking cards are the winners.
In Bid Whist each team begins with a score of zero. At the end of the round, the books are counted. There are 13 altogether, corresponding to the 12 cards played by each player plus the kitty, which counts as a book won by the bidder’s team. Each book won above 6 counts as a point.
If the winning bid was a no-trump bid, the score for the hand is doubled. The game ends when a team scores 7 or more points or forces the other team to go negative 7 or more points.
Bid Whist offers you a great experience against many Bid Whist players from all around the world! You can play in different game modes. 
Bid Whist is a classic quick-fire card game for four players playing in two teams.
Bid Whist can be a fun game for family or friends. It's challenging enough for adults, but enjoyable for kids too. 
Download Bid Whist game for free now with endless hours of fun.
Bid Whist Features 
Create a Private Room and Invite Friends and Family.
1. Play with players across the world in Online mode.
2. You can follow online players and invite them to play matches in Private mode
3. Get Free coins by Spin wheel.
4. Fast-paced, competitive, and fun - for free!
5. Achievements and Leaderboard.
6. Claim Daily Rewards.
7. Watch videos to earn coins.
Rules of the game are explained in great detail in the ‘Settings’ section.
Please take your time to rate your experience with this wonderful Bid Whist game and write a short review.
Any suggestions? We always love to hear from you to make this game better.
Share the Bid Whist game with your friends!
Enjoy playing the Bid Whist game!

Bid Whist is played with 4 players consisting of two teams. Each player sits opposite their partner. It is played with a standard 52 card deck plus 2 jokers. The 2 jokers must be distinct, big joker and the other is the little joker. Each player receives 12 cards. During the deal, 6 cards are to be placed face down in the center of the table to form a kitty.

Bidding starts with the player to the left of the dealer. Each bid consists of a number from 3 to 7, and a suffix “Uptown”, “Downtown”, or “No trump”. The highest bidder chooses the trump suit, or in the case of a no-trump bid specifies whether it will be played uptown or downtown. The bidder then picks up the 6 kitty cards and discards away 6 cards.

If the bid is no trump, all the suits are non-trump suits. If there is a trump suit in the upcoming hand, and if jokers are being used, the jokers become the best cards of the trump suit (better than the ace) regardless of whether high-ranking cards or low-ranking cards are the winners.

In Bid Whist each team begins with a score of zero. At the end of the round, the books are counted. There are 13 altogether, corresponding to the 12 cards played by each player plus the kitty, which counts as a book won by the bidder’s team. Each book won above 6 counts as a point.

If the winning bid was a no-trump bid, the score for the hand is doubled. The game ends when a team scores 7 or more points or forces the other team to go negative 7 or more points.

Bid Whist offers you a great experience against many Bid Whist players from all around the world! You can play in different game modes. 

Bid Whist is a classic quick-fire card game for four players playing in two teams.

Bid Whist can be a fun game for family or friends. It's challenging enough for adults, but enjoyable for kids too.

bluejetty:00115434:android.description:
Stay close to the people who matter - privately and on your terms.
GPS Location & Phone Tracker lets you share your live GPS with trusted contacts only after mutual approval via QR or join code. Create geofence zones for places you care about, get real-time alerts, and quickly find nearby places when plans change.
📍Live location sharing
• Share your live position or view friends’ current locations after mutual consent.
• You’re in control - start, pause, or stop sharing at any time.
• An ongoing notification is shown while sharing is active. No hidden or stealth tracking.
🛡️ Custom safety zones (geofences)
• Save places like Home, Office, or School.
• Receive real-time enter/exit alerts you can enable or disable whenever you like.
• Background location may be used to keep zones and live updates working even when the app is closed; you can turn this off in Settings.
👉 Easy contact management
• Approve or remove contacts in a tap.
• Clear online/offline indicators for quick context.
🏙️ Street-level preview (Mapillary)
• Preview surroundings of a selected place with street-level imagery using Mapillary in a secure WebView - great for choosing the right entrance or planning meet-ups. (Mapillary is a third-party service; attribution is shown. We are not affiliated with Mapillary.)
👨👩👧 Explore nearby
• Find nearby cafés, restaurants, ATMs, hotels, cinemas, gas stations, and more.
• Open any result in your preferred maps app for directions.
🔒 Privacy & transparency
• Consent required for everyone who shares or is visible in a group.
• Persistent notice while sharing is active.
• Background location supports live updates and geofence alerts; you can disable it anytime.
• We process precise location and basic account info only to deliver core features and protect data with industry-standard encryption (in transit and at rest). Learn more in our in-app Privacy Policy.
🌟 Great for
• Families & friends who want simple, consent-based check-ins and arrival updates.
• Meet-ups and events with live GPS so everyone finds the right spot faster.
• Peace of mind when loved ones are out and about - without giving up privacy.
Download now to build your private, real-time location network - simple, secure, and in your control.

bluejetty:00026561:ios.summary: Are you a big fan of classic block puzzle games? Do you like sliding block games? Have you ever been attracted by beautiful jewel jigsaw puzzle games? If you are experiencing an embarrassing moment when you want to play all the games, but a
bluejetty:00026561:ios.description:
Are you a big fan of classic block puzzle games? Do you like sliding block games? Have you ever been attracted by beautiful jewel jigsaw puzzle games? If you are experiencing an embarrassing moment when you want to play all the games, but are having trouble with the limited device storage. Block Puzzle Diamond Star is your great choice! You don't have to pick your favorite, and will have fun with everything in one game!
The Block Puzzle Diamond Star is a collection of innovative gameplay that allows any puzzle fan to find their favorite game here. A new gaming experience brings you unprecedented satisfaction. As a great help to relieve stress and brain exercise, you can play it anytime, anywhere.
The classic block puzzle will create unlimited fun.
- Three modes for you: Endless Mode, Daily Challenge, and various exclusive Events.
- Drag and place blocks in an area, then create horizontal or vertical lines to make them blast. The more blocks removed, the higher the score you'll get.
- Daily challenges are ideal for masters. They require strategic thinking on how to use obstacles to remove gem blocks and reach level goals.
- Different Events will bring you into an abound world. Collect gems, plant beautiful flowers, and so on.
Unlock the secrets hidden within each diamond Jigsaw block puzzle. 
- Embark on a brilliant journey through over 1200 uniquely designed levels.
- Drag different cube block pieces into appropriate positions to match the incomplete patterns. 
- You can't rotate the block patterns, and the difficulty increases step by step.
- Various beautiful unknown patterns are waiting for you to reveal. Fill in the fun of deciphering and the sense of accomplishment of completing.
Slide the gem blocks and develop your brain power.
- A challenging sliding block puzzle will give you an immediate intelligence blast with the gem blast. 
- With each step you take, the entire gem block will move up one line. If the jewels reach the top, the game is over.
- You will get a higher score by eliminating multiple lines at once. So think, and only after that, put the variable block in the best position. 
In addition to the innovation in gameplay, Block Puzzle Diamond Star has many advantages.
- The simple and visually pleasing interface allows you to immerse yourself and kill boring time.
- All modes with specific helpful Props. Use power-ups if you get stuck.
- No time limit! Think carefully ahead of taking action. Everyone can relieve stress and train the brain with no pressure.
- It's a stand-alone puzzle game. You can play offline and have puzzle joy anytime, anywhere!
The Block Puzzle Diamond Star includes several challenges and gameplay, there is always a suitable option for you. Download it and compare with your friends whose scores are higher! Relieve your stress and take your IQ score to new heights with Block Puzzle Diamond Star right now!

bluejetty:00074377:ios.description:
Qualitätsjournalismus der Süddeutschen Zeitung für unterwegs.
News, Hintergründe und mehr: Die App bietet Ihnen die Nachrichtenseite der SZ in einer praktischen App.
Mit Berichten in gewohnter SZ-Qualität, Analysen, Kommentaren, Videos, Bildergalerien und einer großen Sport-Liveticker-Welt.
Täglich ab 19 Uhr erhalten Sie als Abonnent auch Zugriff auf alle Texte der gedruckten Süddeutschen Zeitung.
— — — 
Funktionen:
STARTSEITE
Über die Startseite erhalten Sie einen Überblick zu den wichtigsten und aktuellen Nachrichten. Dieser Bereich wird für Sie rund um die Uhr redaktionell zusammengestellt und überarbeitet. 
NACHRICHTENTICKER
Die App zeigt Ihnen auf der Seite Ticker die neusten Artikel im Ticker-Format chronologisch sortiert an.
EILMELDUNGEN UND WEITERE PUSH-NACHRICHTEN
Eilmeldungen können Sie sich jederzeit als Push-Nachrichten auf Ihrem Gerät anzeigen lassen. Daneben informieren wir Sie über Exklusive-Texte, dem Neuesten aus den Bereichen Sport, Bayern und München sowie zwei Mal täglich mit den SZ Nachrichten des Tages. Diese Funktion können Sie bei Bedarf aber auch ganz einfach wieder deaktivieren.
ARTIKEL ANHÖREN / VORLESEFUNKTION
Die meisten Artikel können Sie auch bequem anhören, indem Sie auf das Play-Icon oder Artikel anhören tippen. 
SZ-PLUS
Auf der Seite sind alle aktuellen Artikel aus der Rubrik SZ-Plus gesammelt. Als SZ-Plus-Abonnent können Sie sich in der App anmelden und dann unbegrenzt auf alle Artikel zugreifen.
MEINE SZ / ARTIKEL MERKEN
Unter Meine SZ finden Sie individuell für Sie zusammengestellte Artikel sowie Ihre gelesenen und gemerkten Artikel. Mit dem Lesezeichen-Icon können Sie Artikel in der Liste unter Meine SZ für später vormerken.
INHALTSMENÜ
Über Inhalt haben Sie Zugang zu allen Ressorts und Themenseiten der SZ. Nutzen Sie die Pfeile zum Aufklappen der Ressorts und Formate, um detaillierteren Zugang zu Ihren Inhalten zu erhalten oder nutzen Sie bequem die Textsuche.
ARTIKEL TEILEN UND VERSENDEN
Empfehlen Sie unsere Texte mit einem Klick auf WhatsApp, Facebook, Twitter, per SMS oder mailen Sie unsere Artikel weiter.
INDIVIDUELLE SCHRIFTGRÖSSE
Die Schriftgröße in den Artikeln können Sie in acht verschiedenen Stufen ganz individuell für sich anpassen. Die Funktion finden Sie auf jeder Seite unter dem Einstellungs-Icon und direkt im Artikel.
— — — 
Vermissen Sie eine Funktion? Was würden Sie sich an Weiterentwicklungen wünschen? Schreiben Sie an app@sz.de. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Meinung!
Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

– Продавайте и покупайте валюту по выгодному курсу.

- Снятие в любых банкоматах – без комиссии

bluejetty:00075183:ios.description:
Take control of your hearing experience with My Starkey. Create custom settings. Get personalized tips. Track health goals. Control volume and more. My Starkey puts you in charge of your hearing journey and overall wellness. All at your fingertips. 
Created with the help of hearing aid wearers, this easy-to-use app allows you to:
HEAR BETTER ANYWHERE
Make instant adjustments for clearer speech and reduced noise—even in the toughest listening environments. Plus, customize sound settings for your favorite places. Equalizer and volume? You control them. With My Starkey, your hearing aids are just the way you need them. At all times.
GET TIPS, TOOLS AND RESOURCES
Adapt to hearing aids faster with quick how-to's, tips, and videos. All tailored for where you are on your hearing journey. Access remote hearing aid adjustments from your hearing care professional—right from your armchair. Lose a hearing aid? Use My Starkey to track the location and simplify your life.
MONITOR HEALTH AND WELLNESS
Monitor daily hearing and physical activity to help you stay healthy. Set and achieve goals for hearing, steps, exercise, and beyond. Get personal and detailed insights into your activity levels. My Starkey can even detect your falls and notify the people you choose—keeping you safe while active.
And much more.
It’s never been easier to take control of your hearing journey. And live your best life—with My Starkey.
Visit www.starkey.com/hearing-aids/apps for device compatibility information, usage instructions, how-to videos, and more details on features. 
For any questions about app feature availability for your specific hearing aids, please contact your hearing care professional.

bluejetty:00164051:ios.description:
Transcrivez rapidement et facilement vos fichiers audio en texte grâce à la technologie de transcription de pointe Whisper. Transcrivez des fichiers depuis d'autres applications via l'extension de partage et obtenez des transcriptions de haute qualité en quelques secondes.
■ Fonctionnalités
- Partagez des fichiers audio et des mémos vocaux depuis des applications telles qu'iMessage, WhatsApp et Dictaphone pour les transcrire
- Enregistrez directement dans l'application et lancez la transcription ensuite
- Transcrivez avec une qualité optimale et une vitesse maximale grâce à la transcription cloud Assistant
- Transcrivez localement sur votre appareil grâce à un modèle embarqué téléchargeable pour une utilisation hors ligne et pour vos fichiers audio confidentiels (iPhone 13 ou plus récent, ou iPad avec puce série M requis)
- Obtenez des résumés IA de haute qualité
- Discutez avec vos transcriptions pour extraire rapidement les informations utiles d'un long enregistrement
- Sélectionnez la langue de transcription (ou utilisez la détection automatique)
- Formats pris en charge : mp3, wav, m4a, mp4, mov
■ Langues prises en charge
Whisper Transcription peut transcrire l'audio dans 100 langues différentes :
anglais, chinois, allemand, espagnol, russe, coréen, français, japonais, ... (liste complète de 100 langues)
Les abonnements se renouvellent automatiquement, sauf si le renouvellement automatique est désactivé au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours, et le montant sera débité de votre compte iTunes. Vous pouvez désactiver le renouvellement automatique et gérer vos abonnements dans les réglages de votre compte iTunes après l'achat. Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.macwhisper.com/legal/terms | Politique de confidentialité : https://www.macwhisper.com/legal/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00174926:ios.name: FINAL FANTASY II
bluejetty:00174926:ios.summary:
A remodeled 2D take on the second game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play. 
Our epic tale begins with four yo
bluejetty:00174926:ios.description:
A remodeled 2D take on the second game in the world-renowned FINAL FANTASY series! Enjoy the timeless story told through charming retro graphics. All the magic of the original, with improved ease of play. 
Our epic tale begins with four young souls orphaned during the struggle between the Palamecian Empire and the rebel army. On their journey, the youths join forces with the white wizard Minwu, Prince Gordon of Kashuan, Leila the pirate, and many others. Behold the beautiful and sometimes tragic twists of fate that await you on your adventure.
FFII introduced a unique skill level system that strengthens different attributes of the characters depending on their fighting style instead of leveling up. Use the key terms you learn in conversation to unlock new information and progress in the story. 
This innovative game series takes an ambitious turn in this second installment in the FINAL FANTASY series!
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
■ Beautifully revived with new graphics and sound!
・Universally updated 2D pixel graphics, including the iconic FINAL FANTASY character pixel designs created by Kazuko Shibuya, the original artist and current collaborator.
・Beautifully rearranged soundtrack in a faithful FINAL FANTASY style, overseen by original composer Nobuo Uematsu.
■Improved gameplay!
・Including modernized UI, auto-battle options, and more.
・Also supports game pad controls, making it possible to play using a dedicated gamepad UI when connecting a gamepad to your device.
・Switch the soundtrack between the rearranged version, created for the pixel remaster, or the original version, capturing the sound of the original game.
・Now possible to switch between different fonts, including the default font and a pixel-based font based on the atmosphere of the original game.
・Additional boost features to expand gameplay options, including switching off random encounters and adjusting experience gained multipliers between 0 and 4.
・Dive into the world of the game with supplemental extras like the bestiary, illustration gallery, and music player.
*One-time purchase. The app will not require any additional payments to play through the game after the initial purchase and subsequent download.
*This remaster is based on the original "FINAL FANTASY II" game released in 1988. Features and/or content may differ from previously rereleased versions of the game.
[OS Compatibility]
iOS 13.0 or higher
[Applicable Devices]
iPhone 6s, iPod touch (7th generation), iPad (5th generation), iPad Air 2, iPad mini 4 and higher

bluejetty:00080549:ios.description:
Looking for the ultimate insect guide? Search no more, as Bug ID has everything you may need to become an entomology guru! Whether you want to keep pests at bay in your garden or explore butterflies in the local park—our insect identifier has you covered.
What can you do with Bug ID at your side?
● Identify insects instantly
Ever spotted an unknown bug in your garden and wondered if it’s a pest or a beneficial insect? You don’t have to know all the distinctive features of every species, as our bug finder does! Just snap a bug, butterfly, spider, or slug, and our cutting-edge AI technology will do the rest. 
Each insect profile has exhaustive information about it:
• Clear photos of the bug at all stages of its development
• In-depth descriptions
• Impact on other people, animals, plants, and other insects
• Distribution
• Active seasons
• Tips on pest control and prevention
● Track your finds
Never lose the insects you’ve recognized! You don’t need to keep records of every pest spotted in the garden or a beautiful butterfly seen in the park, as all your finds are automatically saved in Snap History.
● Build and manage custom collections
Arrange your custom collections of insects and spiders and navigate them with ease thanks to the smooth interface of our bug identifier. Build up your insect collections, access them instantly, and keep essential information at hand anytime, anywhere.
Download Bug ID and start your journey of exploring insects right now! 
Subscribe to Bug ID Premium to get unlimited access to all the app’s features:
● Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually at the rate depending on the subscription plan.
● Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
All personal data is protected in accordance with the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy:
https://aiby.mobi/insectid_ios/terms/
https://aiby.mobi/insectid_ios/privacy/
For any questions or inquiries, please use our customer support form at 
https://aiby.mobi/insectid_ios/support/

bluejetty:00164581:ios.description:
The Beltone Tinnitus Calmer™ app uses a combination of sounds and relaxing exercises that aim to distract your brain from focusing on tinnitus. Over time the brain learns to focus less on the tinnitus. 
The app lets you manage your personal library of sound therapy files and allows you to create your own soundscapes from environmental sounds and small pieces of music. It will also track your usage, so you can see which sounds work best for you, and it contains some secondary stimuli like colors and exercises to help keep your mind occupied. 
Just download it and listen to it as you normally listen to music from your smart phone. If you wear Beltone® wireless hearing aids, you can stream directly through them; the sound you stream will be adjusted to compensate for your hearing loss.
The app is a tool for anyone who has tinnitus. It should be used in combination with a tinnitus management programme or plan set up by a hearing care professional.

bluejetty:00126221:ios.description:
This app serves as a straightforward voice clock. It utilizes local notifications to announce the time, even when music is playing or when the app is running in the background. This feature is especially handy when you can’t readily view your iPhone screen.
The voice is accessible in three languages: English, Italian, and Japanese. For further details, please refer to the “App Information” section within the app.
■ About URL Scheme
(Format)
voclockjp://aa/bb/cccc/dddd
vocjp://aa/bb/cccc/dddd
Parameters:
aa: Can be “on,” “off,” or “time” (to announce the current time).
bb: Time Interval.
cccc: Start Time (24-hour format, 4 digits - hhmm).
dddd: Stop Time (24-hour format, 4 digits - hhmm).

bluejetty:00176764:ios.description:
RideKC offers two great shared-use mobility options to choose from: new electric-assist bikes and classic pedal bikes. Pick the one you want to roll with below to get started.
The RideKC Bike system is a new part of the RideKC family of mobility services, which operates a unique mix of technologies that extend the fixed-route transit system and gives local residents and visitors a variety of options for getting around Kansas City.
RideKC Bike features:
Smart, electric-assist bikes and classic pedal bikes operating in a hybrid docked/dockless system with lock-to technology that utilizes existing and new bike racks to ensure our devices are organized, thoughtfully deployed, and enhance public spaces.
Bike Share for All Program, ensuring all Kansas Citians have access to bikes – especially those impacted by disparities in mobility, health, and economics.

bluejetty:00089466:ios.description:
PITFIT is not your standard gym, so don’t expect your average workout. Away from bright lights and distractions, this is where you dig deep and find your inner athlete. You’ll be challenged in ways you didn’t know were possible, but you’ll leave begging to come back.
At PITFIT, our goal is to help you reach yours. Dallas’s top trainers are ready to coach and push you through class so that when you’re done, you know you’ve left it all in the PIT.
When you step into the PIT, be ready for a 60- minute, non-stop HIIT workout. The PIT is an open-air environment, where the only limitation is YOU. Each day of the week we target different and specific muscle groups. Operated by self-powered equipment, strategically designed to achieve your desired results. Each class is capped at 21 clients, allowing the trainer to give you individualized attention. Whether your goal is to torch body fat, increase strength, or promote lean muscle, the PITFIT team provides a clear roadmap for all levels of fitness and wellness goals.

bluejetty:00139225:ios.description:
Join the beloved Golden Retriever, Tucker Budzyn, in a tail-wagging adventure that’s as playful as it is puzzling! In Tucker’s Treat Chase, Steve the sneaky groundhog has swiped Tucker’s favorite treats, and it’s up to you to help Tucker and his son, Todd, get them back!
Embark on an endless journey through colorful levels filled with fun challenges and match-3 puzzles. Match the treats, solve the puzzles, and collect the stolen goodies as you chase Steve from room to room, all the way to the backyard! But watch out—Steve is always one step ahead, ready to make a quick getaway with more treats, keeping the adventure going and the fun never-ending.
Features:
ヅ Endless Levels of Fun: Thousands of levels to keep you and Tucker on the move, with new challenges at every turn.
ヅ Collect Treats: Gather all kinds of delicious treats, from bones to biscuits, as you outsmart Steve.
ヅ Explore Tucker’s World: Chase Steve through the house, into the backyard, and beyond in a playful adventure filled with surprises.
ヅ Match-3 Puzzles through original game modes: Match treats in exciting puzzles to recover Tucker’s stolen snacks.
ヅ Play amazing games from Tucker's world: the bath, the diving contest, the barn hunt...
ヅ Lots of outfits to create unique avatars!
ヅ Humor & Fun: Enjoy the signature humor and charm of Tucker Budzyn in every level!
Are you ready to help Tucker on his endless chase? Download Tucker’s Treat Chase now and start your adventure with the cutest dog on the internet!
Download Now and Start the Chase!

bluejetty:00122596:ios.description:
About this app:
Citizens Bank is your Community Owned Independent Bank. Citizens Bank has four branches located in Franklin County, Missouri.
With the Citizens Bank Mobile Banking App, you can safely and securely access your account(s) at any time.
Our Mobile Banking App allows you to:
• View account activity
• View account balance(s)
• Transfer funds
• Pay bill(s)
• Manage your Debit Card(s)
• View and redeem your Debit Card Rewards
• Deposit check(s)
• Receive alerts about your account(s)
• Locate our branches and ATM locations
*Data rates may apply
Security Tips:
• Put a password or passcode on your devices.
• Don’t share your username or password with anyone.
• Keep your device and app software up to date.
*If you think you have been a possible victim of fraud, please do not hesitate to call or come into one of our four branches located in Franklin County, Missouri. Your safety is our #1 priority.
Contact Us
For support with this application or questions about Citizens Bank products and services, please call at (573) 237 - 3051
Citizens Bank’s Main Location – 100 Circle Drive, New Haven, MO 63068
www.citizensbankmo.bank
Member FDIC

bluejetty:00022282:ios.description:
- Seu time, suas regras 
Logo ao abrir o app, escolha seu time do coração — como Flamengo, Corinthians, Palmeiras, São Paulo, Vasco, Grêmio, Cruzeiro — e tenha acesso imediato às partidas, notícias recentes, vídeos, classificação atualizada e melhores momentos. Tudo em uma única tela, fácil e intuitiva, feita para simplificar sua experiência! 
- Campeonatos brasileiros e internacionais: Emoção garantida 
Acompanhe os principais torneios: Brasileirão (séries A e B), Copa do Brasil, Libertadores e outros campeonatos em tempo real, com cobertura completa lance a lance. Veja escalações, substituições, cartões, estatísticas e comentários ao vivo. 
- Alertas personalizados
Receba notificações sobre seus times e campeonatos favoritos. Escolha se quer acompanhar jogos masculinos, femininos ou ambos — tudo do seu jeito. 
- Opinião de colunistas importantes 
Um time de craques traz opinião, análise e muita informação sobre as partidas e o mundo da bola. Escalação de colunistas do UOL: Juca Kfouri, Paulo Vinicius Coelho (PVC), Casagrande, Mauro Cezar, Milly Lacombe, Milton Neves, Renato Mauricio Prado, Alicia Klein, além dos blogs da 'casa': Mercado da Bola e Na Grade do MMA. Informação com credibilidade e profundidade. 
- Classificação atualizada 
Confira rapidamente a tabela de classificação de mais de 30 campeonatos nacionais e internacionais. Do Brasileirão às principais ligas europeias, como Champions League, Premier League, e torneios como Copa do Mundo e Copa América. 
- Lance a lance ao vivo 
Viva cada jogo em tempo real com informações precisas e completas. Escalações confirmadas, substituições imediatas, cartões e comentários de especialistas. Viva o jogo como se estivesse no estádio! 
- Vídeos dos melhores momentos 
Assista aos gols e lances decisivos com rapidez e qualidade. Fique por dentro de tudo que acontece no seu campeonato favorito. 
- Mercado da bola 
Saiba antes de todo mundo as principais transferências, rumores e negociações do mercado da bola. Informações completas e sempre atualizadas. 
- Qualidade e confiança UOL 
Acesse informações precisas e atualizadas com a credibilidade do UOL, maior referência em jornalismo esportivo no Brasil. O aplicativo garante rapidez, segurança e uma navegação intuitiva e confortável.
Termos e políticas:
Ao fazer download deste aplicativo você concorda com nossos termos de uso e políticas de privacidade, localizados em https://sobreuol.noticias.uol.com.br/normas-de-seguranca-e-privacidade/

bluejetty:00177162:ios.description:
iPeriod® – Period & Cycle Tracking Since 2008
Trusted by millions of women. Beautifully redesigned for today.
Since 2008, iPeriod has helped women track their periods, understand their cycles, and recognize patterns in their health. Now beautifully redesigned, iPeriod makes personal health tracking easier and more intuitive than ever.
“A must-have Personal Assistant” – MSN
“Top iPhone App for Busy Women” – Forbes
“Simple yet ingenious” – Popular Science
“What’s Hot” – App Store
YOUR CYCLE. YOUR HEALTH. YOUR WAY.
Whether you're tracking periods, planning for pregnancy, observing fertility signs, or navigating perimenopause, iPeriod helps you record what matters to you.
WHY WOMEN CHOOSE iPERIOD
• Trusted since 2008, with millions of downloads
• Beautifully redesigned Home screen and interactive cycle ring
• Intuitive calendar with cycle history and predictions
• Easy daily tracking of periods, symptoms, moods, and more
• Expanded symptom library, including perimenopause and menopause-related symptoms
• Personalized period and fertile-window estimates
• Customizable tracking, charts, and reports
• Discreet reminders and familiar “iP” app icon
TRACK WHAT MATTERS TO YOU
Record periods and flow, fertility signs, ovulation information, physical and emotional symptoms, moods, basal body temperature, weight, sleep, activity, and personal notes.
Find symptoms quickly with the new search feature, customize your tracking, and explore patterns in your health history over time.
A BEAUTIFULLY REDESIGNED EXPERIENCE
Explore your cycle with an interactive ring, a clearer calendar, redesigned daily details, easier navigation, and smoother performance. Everything is designed to make tracking feel effortless.
PRIVACY YOU CAN TRUST
Your health information is your business.
• We never sell your private health data
• We never share your cycle or symptom history with advertisers or data brokers
• Your backed-up health information is encrypted
• Password protection helps keep your information secure
• You control when to export or share your health reports
Your health. Your history. Your choice.
SMART, DISCREET REMINDERS
Set reminders for upcoming periods, fertile windows, medications, breast self-exams, and personal health needs. Check estimated period dates when planning travel or important events.
CHARTS, REPORTS & APPLE HEALTH
Explore cycle patterns and past entries with charts and reports. Export PDF reports to review your history or bring to a healthcare appointment.
Integrate supported Apple Health information, including menstrual data, activity, weight, and other wellness information.
MAKE iPERIOD YOUR OWN
Personalize your experience with custom symptoms and moods, flexible settings, and advanced chart options.
iPERIOD PREMIUM
Enjoy more features while supporting an independent small business.
• Ad-free experience
• Advanced, customizable charts
• Additional symptom and mood customization
• Unlimited PDF report exports
Choose a monthly or annual subscription. Eligible annual subscribers can try Premium free for 7 days. PDF export is also available as a separate one-time purchase.
Since creating iPeriod in 2008, we've remained an independent small business dedicated to thoughtful women's health tools and respecting your privacy. Your support helps us keep improving.
IMPORTANT INFORMATION
Cycle predictions and fertility estimates are informational only. iPeriod is not a contraceptive method or a substitute for professional medical advice.

https://iperiod.net/PrivacyPolicyiPeriod.html
End User License Agreement:
https://iperiod.net/iPeriodEULA.html
The iPeriod you know and trust. Beautifully reimagined.

bluejetty:00031617:ios.name: Blood Pressure App-BP Tracker
bluejetty:00031617:ios.summary: Discover our Blood Pressure App — a must-have heart health companion for tracking your blood pressure, heart rate, blood sugar and oxygen saturation. Log and analyze your health data with precision to stay informed and make smart decisions.
bluejetty:00031617:ios.description:
Discover our Blood Pressure App — a must-have heart health companion for tracking your blood pressure, heart rate, blood sugar and oxygen saturation. Log and analyze your health data with precision to stay informed and make smart decisions.
1. Track Blood Pressure: Effortlessly log your systolic, diastolic, and heart rate with one tap! Our user-friendly interface features a large "+" button on every page, allowing you to log blood pressure anytime, anywhere. Say goodbye to the hassle of paper and pen!
2. Measure Heart Rate: Just place your finger on the camera to get accurate heart rate readings in seconds. Check pulse and detect irregular heartbeat anytime with the heart rate monitor. Stay proactive about your cardiovascular health and stress level.
3. Log Blood Sugar: Easily record blood sugar and track trends over time. Managing blood sugar has never been easier.
4. Record Oxygen Saturation: Track minor changes in your oxygen saturation and see how they relate to heart rate or other health metrics.
5. Intelligent Health Analysis: Log blood pressure, heart rate, and blood sugar see if your readings are within the normal range, helping you detect early signs of health issues like hypertension, heart attack, diabetes, and more. Monitor trends and fluctuations across all your vital signs for comprehensive and effective health management.
6. Health Insights & Tips: Discover plenty of practical health tips, covering topics like effective BP control, first aid for hypotension, and advice on healthy eating and exercise routines - almost everything you need to know. Utilize our curated resources to support you on your journey toward a healthier, happier life.
7. Clear & Intuitive Charts: Visualize your blood pressure, heart rate, and blood sugar progress through interactive graphs and charts! Easily track heartbeat, blood pressure, and blood sugar trends and gain insights into your patterns.
8. Customizable Tags: Tailor your health metrics tracking by noting the position (sitting, lying, etc.) and conditions (before/after meals, post-medication, etc.) during each measurement for effective health management.
9. Export & Share Full History: All heart rate, blood pressure, and blood sugar records are saved with exact date and time. Export health data as a CSV file and share it with your loved ones or doctor via email and more to maximize every medical appointment.
Why Choose Blood Pressure App
- Measure heart rate using camera
- Log blood pressure, blood sugar, and oxygen saturation
- Keep your stress levels under control
- Analyze health trends through intuitive charts, and export as CSV
- User-friendly interface
- Science-backed health articles and insightful tips
- Tag and comment on your measurements
Disclaimer
 · Our app is not intended to serve as a medical device and should not be used to measure blood pressure or diagnose heart disease.
 · Our app is not intended for a medical emergency. If you have any health concerns, please consult your doctor.
 · Our app is designed for fitness and general wellness purposes only, NOT INTENDED FOR MEDICAL DIAGNOSIS.
 · Our app may cause the LED flash hot.
· We prioritize your privacy. Rest assured, all your data is securely protected. Check our links below:
Privacy Policy: https://akrura.ltd/privacypolicy.html?pkg=com.akrura.bloodpressure.health.monitor.app
Terms of Use: https://akrura.ltd/terms.html?pkg=com.akrura.bloodpressure.health.monitor.app
For feedback & suggestions, feel free to reach out to us at bptracker.feedback@gmail.com.
Get the Blood Pressure App now and experience the next-level blood pressure management at no cost! Take control, stay informed, and make proactive decisions for a healthier lifestyle. Your journey to optimal health begins here!

bluejetty:00158481:ios.description:
Get ready for a new stunning shooting game, the amazing run-and-gun action game.
The familiar and beloved Run-and-gun action platform game is returning after a 30-year absence!
Gun Force Arcade Shooting game with more addictive features, entertaining missions, and realistic graphics, is available for mobile platforms. It promises to recreate the original gun-and-run shooter experience.
Download and play this great time-killer metal shooting game and enjoy its smooth and easy controls. If you are a fan of not only normal metal shooters but also run-and-gun games, Gun Force: Arcade Shooting has what you need.
Gun Force is a run-and-gun metal shooter video game with classic 2D pixel art, mixed with exciting rogue-like elements. 
Guard your world in heart-stopping Gun Force metal shooting games
You will take on the role of a commander of the resistance army known as Gun Force with advanced technology, which uses the iconic weapons and perks to combat Legion, a criminal organization that threatens world peace. Shoot down any enemies in the way from bio-tech soldiers to huge mechanic weapons, plus unique bosses all waiting for you in the battle zone, let's build your Broforce
Run-and-gun Action Shooting - Daily mission
You can try to complete different missions every day. Let’s see the way you wipe out mad criminal organization - Legion with a variety of strong guns. The rewards for daily missions in this run’n’gun game are very valuable, don’t miss a chance to earn them every day. 
Extremely easy and intuitive control; super smooth and enjoyable traditional shooter gameplay mixed with rogue-like elements. A captivating world with an exciting story for you to enjoy. Along the way, you'll recruit strong and unique new heroes into the force and command them to fight powerful enemies from Legion.
Features Metal Squad
• High-Resolution Pixel Art & Exquisite Effect
Combination of dynamic 2D high-resolution pixel art in gameplay and Live 2D art characters presentation with captivating backgrounds and effects.
• Random & Unique Skills in this metal slug action game
Each hero possesses unique and powerful skills that you can utilize to gain an advantage in battle along with different perks in gameplay, creating distinct experiences each time you start a new mission.
• Real-time Battle
Exciting metal slug - run’n’gun real-time battle combined with rouge-like elements that create unique gameplay that is easy to play, and hard to master. Be ready to hone your skills and conquer challenges.
• Dynamic Heroes & Team Building
Recruit new heroes, level up your roster, and upgrade your equipment and vehicles to build up your teams. Get fully prepared before you face the powerful Legion army.
• Exploration of Different Continents through Story
Travel across the continents and explore a vast world with beautiful landscapes such as forests, snow regions, deserts, volcanic active zones, and more. Experience the story and help those heroes to save the world.
So what are you waiting for?
We need you, Commanders!!!

bluejetty:00144604:ios.description:
FlightConnections is the Swiss army knife that should not be missing in your travel toolkit. It’s one of the best tools for travel hacking, trip planning and travel inspiration.
Want to know where you can fly from your local airport? Need to know which airlines are operating? Prefer to fly with a specific alliance only? FlightConnections is here to help!
FlightConnections provides an overview of all flight routes worldwide. Flight schedules and timetables from every airline in the world for 12 months ahead are presented in a very convenient way. Within seconds, FlightConnections provides you with schedule information of any flight route, operated by any airline.
Find the most convenient flight route at the most convenient departure time. Search for flights with up to 2 stops and filter down extensively: to show flights and airports operated by a specific airline or alliance only (especially useful for business and award travelers).
Even the most seasoned travel gurus, travel professionals and travel agents, award travelers and non-revs, cabin crew and pilots are using FlightConnections daily.
Don't waste hours searching flights, use FlightConnections!
FLIGHTCONNECTIONS MAIN FEATURES
• Interactive Flight Route Map.
• Plan a trip based on your preferred local airport.
• Find new, nearby airports on the map.
• Filter by airline or alliance.
• Discover airline routes and flight schedules / timetables.
• Compare direct flights or connections flights.
• Show connecting flights with one or two stops.
• Show connecting flights with different airlines, or the same airline only.
• Find cheap flights and book flight tickets for the best price available.
• Useful for frequent travelers, travel professionals, cabin crew and pilots, backpackers and digital nomads.
Any questions or feedback? Contact us at:
contact@flightconnections.com

FlightConnections is the Swiss army knife that should not be missing in your travel toolkit. It’s one of the best tools for travel hacking, trip planning and travel inspiration.

Want to know where you can fly from your local airport? Need to know which airlines are operating? Prefer to fly with a specific alliance only? FlightConnections is here to help!

FlightConnections provides an overview of all flight routes worldwide. Flight schedules and timetables from every airline in the world for 12 months ahead are presented in a very convenient way. Within seconds, FlightConnections provides you with schedule information of any flight route, operated by any airline.

Find the most convenient flight route at the most convenient departure time. Search for flights with up to 2 stops and filter down extensively: to show flights and airports operated by a specific airline or alliance only (especially useful for business and award travelers).

Even the most seasoned travel gurus, travel professionals and travel agents, award travelers and non-revs, cabin crew and pilots are using FlightConnections daily.

Don't waste hours searching flights, use FlightConnections!


FLIGHTCONNECTIONS MAIN FEATURES

• Interactive Flight Route Map.
• Plan a trip based on your preferred local airport.
• Find new, nearby airports on the map.
• Filter by airline or alliance.
• Discover airline routes and flight schedules / timetables.
• Compare direct flights or connections flights.
• Show connecting flights with one or two stops.
• Show connecting flights with different airlines, or the same airline only.
• Find cheap flights and book flight tickets for the best price available.
• Useful for frequent travelers, travel professionals, cabin crew and pilots, backpackers and digital nomads.


Any questions or feedback? Contact us at:
contact@flightconnections.com

bluejetty:00162273:ios.summary: How can you help your children learn their letters? What’s the best way for kids to learn the alphabet? Our advice is to keep it fun! Dinosaur ABC uses happy learning activities to help kids aged 2-5 learn their ABCs with fun games and an i
bluejetty:00162273:ios.description:
How can you help your children learn their letters? What’s the best way for kids to learn the alphabet? Our advice is to keep it fun! Dinosaur ABC uses happy learning activities to help kids aged 2-5 learn their ABCs with fun games and an interactive, step-by-step learning system.
43 ABC interactive games
Kids can catch jellyfish, fix cars, open birthday presents, play basketball, collect Halloween candy, and have fun tracing letters with friendly little monsters. 26 letters combined with 43 new and interesting interactive scenes make ABC learning fun! The games strengthen pronunciation memory through continuous repetition of the letter sounds. Kids will learn through play!
Drive trains to explore the world of letters
With 10 different themed adventure maps, kids become little drivers and explore the wonderful world of letters! Drive the train, collect the letter bricks, and build homes for their little monster friends!
Learn 73 CVC words
Children will have initial exposure to 73 words made up of consonant, vowel, and consonant sounds, like bat, cat, pet, map, and man. They will learn CVC word spelling, pronunciation, and practice saying the words out loud, which will help their reading in the future.
Collect stars and exchange for 108 toys
During gameplay, kids earn instant star rewards that can be exchanged for super cool toys. Each time they unlock and collect a toy, your child will experience a sense of accomplishment. Feeling proud of what they achieve and building their toy collection in the process, will increase their motivation, interest, and enthusiasm for learning.
We want to lead kids to learn the ABCs in a fun way!
Features
• 43 fun alphabet games, including city, space, farm, snow, and other themes kids like
• Exciting train adventures through 10 different scenes: coast, forest, ice world, & more.
• 5 amazing letter tracing effects
• Learn 73 CVC words — get a head start on reading
• Super learning rewards, use stars to exchange 108 cool toys
• Works offline without internet connection
• No third-party advertisements
About Yateland
Yateland crafts apps with educational value, inspiring preschoolers across the globe to learn through play! With each app we make, we are guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Learn more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. If you would like to know more about how we deal with these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.
Terms of Use: https://yateland.com/terms

bluejetty:00155341:ios.description:
Real-Time Location Sharing 
Stay connected with your loved ones like never before by sharing your location in real-time. Whether you’re planning a meetup, coordinating travel plans, or simply keeping in touch, our app makes it easy to let friends and family know exactly where you are. Perfect for ensuring everyone stays on the same page, this feature is ideal for busy schedules, group activities, or even just peace of mind when someone is on the move.
Easy QR Code Scanning
Connecting with others has never been simpler. With our app’s QR code scanning feature, you can instantly link up with friends, family, or colleagues by scanning their unique QR code. No complicated setups, no lengthy account creations—just a quick scan and you’re connected. This seamless process is perfect for fast-paced environments, group events, or when you need to share your location on the go.
Track Multiple People at Once
Managing a group has never been easier. Our app allows you to track multiple people simultaneously on a single, easy-to-read map. Whether you’re on a family trip, organizing a group outing, or coordinating with colleagues, this feature ensures everyone stays accounted for. No more guessing where someone is or losing track of your group—stay informed and in control at all times.
Background Location Updates 
Our app keeps you connected even when you’re not actively using it. With background location updates, you’ll receive real-time information about your contacts’ locations, no matter where they are. This feature ensures you’re always in the loop, whether the app is running in the background or your phone is locked. It’s the perfect way to stay updated without constantly checking your device.
Your Ultimate Tool for Staying Connected
From real-time location sharing to effortless QR code connections, our app is designed to make staying in touch simple and stress-free. Whether you’re tracking a group, coordinating travel, or just keeping an eye on loved ones, our features provide the tools you need to stay connected and informed. Download our app today and experience the convenience of seamless location sharing and tracking. Because staying connected should always be easy.

bluejetty:00179656:ios.summary: Cleanse the streets in Don Zombie: Guns and Gore — a fast, stylized 2D action shooter with dynamic lighting and crunchy, satisfying gunplay. Master responsive dual-stick controls, mow down hordes, and unleash over-the-top abilities as you f
bluejetty:00179656:ios.description:
Cleanse the streets in Don Zombie: Guns and Gore — a fast, stylized 2D action shooter with dynamic lighting and crunchy, satisfying gunplay. Master responsive dual-stick controls, mow down hordes, and unleash over-the-top abilities as you fight through a city overrun by the undead.
Campaign
Conquer 80 handcrafted levels spread across 10 zones, including Downtown Streets, The Sewers, Ferris Wheel, Lab Factory, City Park, Metro Station, Research Facility, and the Cursed Forest. Every stage is built for quick, high-intensity fights where headshots deal extra damage and timing matters.
Enemies & Bosses
Face distinct zombie classes, hulking bosses, zombified animals, and twisted mutant creations. Learn their patterns, bait their attacks, and punish them with precision shots and heavy ordnance.
Play Your Way
7 unlockable characters, each with a unique ultimate: Missile Strike, Bullet Time, Napalm Strike, Electro Shock, and more.
14 upgradable weapons to collect and max out: Shotgun, M16, Burner, AK-47, Mortar, Minigun, Bazooka, BFG, Railgun, and others.
Equip a secondary defensive gear: Grenade, Gas Tank, Laser Mine, Molotov Cocktail, etc.—all upgradable.
Add pre-mission boosts: Rush (move faster), an automatic Battle Drone, an automated Turret, or a Vest for extra armor.
Jump into heavy metal with special levels that hand you a battle Tank or combat Mech for supreme firepower.
Extra Modes
Defend Your Home – Patrol a military base and hold against escalating waves. The longer you last, the higher you rank.
Enemy Territory – Descend into a deep cave and slay as many zombies as possible. The deeper you go, the better your position on the ranking.
Why You’ll Love It
Arcade-tight dual-stick controls
Dynamic lighting & effects that make every shot pop
Meaty upgrades and build variety
Short, intense missions perfect for on-the-go play
Leaderboard-friendly score chasing and boss fights
Lock, load, and purge the apocalypse. Upgrade your favorite guns, perfect your headshots, and become the last line of defense in Don Zombie: Guns and Gore.

bluejetty:00173592:ios.name: Quotation Maker
bluejetty:00173592:ios.summary: Quotation Maker is the perfect mobile app for small business owners, contractors and merchants who need a simple and professional solution for estimates, invoices, receipts, bills and quotations. With the help of this application, you can e
bluejetty:00173592:ios.description:
Quotation Maker is the perfect mobile app for small business owners, contractors and merchants who need a simple and professional solution for estimates, invoices, receipts, bills and quotations. With the help of this application, you can easily create and share invoices, receipts, bills and quotations on your phone. You can also manage your billing operations while on the go, enabling you to get paid faster. Send invoices, receipts, bills, estimates or quotations to your customers using this application.
Quotation Maker is a complete solution for managing estimate, invoice, receipt, bill, quotation and billing operations. It assists you in raising estimates, invoices, receipts, bills and quotations to your clients, recording payments for the quotations, and finally providing receipts to the customers.
Quotation and Invoice Maker Features
• Estimate, invoice, receipts, delivery notes, purchase order, Performa invoice and bill for any product or service
• Send quotation OR estimates to your customers, then convert them to invoices later
• Customize your invoice template and invoice fields
• Customize your company logo on your Estimate and invoice templates
• Create a PDF invoice or estimate with a built-in PDF quotation and invoice maker
• Email, use messaging apps (e.g: WhatsApp) or text your estimate, invoice or receipt
• Sign your invoice or estimate
• Attach images to your invoices and estimates
• Invoice status management like paid and unpaid invoice
Estimates & Invoice
• Quotation maker is an easily customized bill and invoice maker app
• Automatically generate invoices from estimates with one click
This app does a bunch of important things for businesses, like making estimates, invoices and managing them. It's like a tool that helps you keep track of your business money stuff.
Here's what you can do with it:
• Quotation and Invoice Creation: You can quickly make estimates and invoices using this app. It's easy and saves you time.
• Converting Estimates to Invoices: If you've sent an estimate to a contractor and they agree, you can easily turn that estimate into an invoice.
• Managing Invoices and Estimates: This app helps you keep all your invoices and estimates organised, so you know who's paid and who hasn't.
• Customisation: You can make your invoices and estimates look professional by adding your company logo, website, and other details.
• Client and Item Management: It also keeps track of your clients and the items you're billing for.
• Support for Different Things: You can customize taxes, discounts, and other details to fit your needs.
• Real-time Preview: You can see how your invoice or estimate will look as you're making it.
• Exporting and Sending: You can save your invoices and estimates as PDFs or images, or even send them directly through email.
What makes this app special is that it does everything in one place, making your invoicing and estimating tasks much simpler. It's like having a personal assistant for your business finances!
New version has following features : 
 - Unlimited Quotations
 - Cloud & Offline Sync
 - Professional quotation format with lots of options/settings 
 - Share via Email, Whatsapp, Print etc..
 - Multi currency support
 - Premium Support via WhatsApp, Call & Email.
We're excited to announce our latest app update, which includes amazing new features like cloud and offline sync, unlimited quotations, and more!
Don't worry, you won't lose any of your customer or product-related data. Your information will be securely stored in the cloud and easily accessible with just a few taps.
Why wait? Our app, Quotation Maker, has everything you need in one place. It's a simple tool that helps you make estimates, invoices, and bills easily.
We take your privacy seriously
CONNECT / SUPPORT 
Got questions? Feel free to reach out to us at support@quotationmaker.app
Terms of use : https://praxinfo.com/terms-of-use

From the makers of Bus Simulator 2024 comes the new and improved Truck Simulator USA Revolution. Want to know what driving an 18 Wheeler feels like? Truck Simulator USA offers a real trucking experience that will let you explore amazing locations. 
This American Truck Simulator features many American and European semi truck brands and all kinds of big rigs with realistic engine sounds and detailed interiors! 
Drive across America, transport cool trailers such as vehicles, gasoline, gravel, food, ship anchors, helicopters, and many more… Become a professional truck driver and enjoy the career and the online multiplayer mode! 
You can choose from over 45 unique trucks, a lot of tuning and customisation options and prove your driving skills in one of the most accurate truck games on the market.
Drive your favorite American or Euro truck across the American continent, play Truck Simulator USA Revolution!
Tired of usual car games and truck games? The ultimate truck simulator game you’ve been waiting for is here!
Features:
● Which 18 wheeler do you like most? Discover many new American and Euro truck brands.
● Drive your big rig truck across USA, Canada and Mexico
● New and improved graphics engine!
● Different climate locations: desert, snow, mountain, city
● Improved Controls (tilt steering, buttons or virtual steering wheel)
● Manual Transmission with H-Shifter and Clutch
● Realistic Engine Sounds (V8, Cummins, etc..)
● Practice your truck parking skills and learn how to park your truck like a pro. 
● Pair up with fellow truckers of America and Europe and drive together in online Multiplayer
● Lots of heavy duty and regular trailers to transport. 
● Online Multiplayer Mode and Career Mode
● Buy a warehouse and be on your way to become a truck tycoon. 
● Visual and mechanical damage on vehicles
● New weather system (snow, rain, sun...)
● Discover new truck models such as a british lorry and prototype electric trucks. 
● Request new trucks or features on our Social Pages!
The one and only universal truck simulator game you’ve been waiting for is here. Download and play Truck Simulator USA Revolution now!

bluejetty:00023639:ios.description:
Seamless VA Care—Anywhere
Mobile Engagement puts the entire Veterans Affairs experience in your pocket. From finding the nearest VA facility to refilling prescriptions, it is the single, secure place where Veterans can navigate hospitals, schedule or check in to appointments, access medical records, chat with VAly, and discover trusted VA resources—online or on the go.
VAly AI Chatbot
* Ask any question in plain language—VAly opens the right feature instantly
* Available 24/7 for navigation, benefits and support queries
Facilities
* Locate nearby VA hospitals and clinics with wait times, phone numbers and directions
* Save a default hospital for instant indoor navigation
Manage Appointments
* Book, cancel or print VA and Community Care visits
* View after-visit summaries and map each appointment
Hospital Navigation
* Real-time blue-dot indoor maps with voice guidance and high-contrast mode
* Remember where you parked and get turn-by-turn directions to any clinic or amenity
Travel Claim
* One-tap access to the BTSSS portal for mileage reimbursement
Health Tools
* My HealtheVet: refill meds, order supplies, send secure messages
* Review labs, tests, vaccines and care notes
* Add appointments to your calendar with card scanning
Quick Actions
* Text 53079 to check in (45 minutes before to 15 minutes after)
* Contact the Veterans Crisis Line by call, text or chat
VA Resources
* Health care, disability, education, housing, careers, pensions, family benefits and burials—direct phone numbers and links, all in one place
Facility Availability
Some features require the facility to be enabled inside VA systems. If your site is not yet supported, check back soon as we expand nationwide.

bluejetty:00060777:ios.summary: This Yoruba Audio Bible is provided to you by DaBible Foundation. We are a group of young Christians using our technical skills to provide the Bible in our mother tongue. After a few years since our first version, this gradual rebrand begin
bluejetty:00060777:ios.description:
This Yoruba Audio Bible is provided to you by DaBible Foundation. We are a group of young Christians using our technical skills to provide the Bible in our mother tongue. After a few years since our first version, this gradual rebrand begins here, with Hausa, Pidgin, and multiple Yoruba Audio Bible listening options.
This Yoruba Audio Bible App is the FIRST and only app that makes both the Old Testament and the New Testament available in audio format.
We spent more than a year recording and putting this bible app together and we are glad that we can make this available to you.
Our mission at DaBible Foundation is to put the Bible in digital format in every African home. We encourage you to donate to support us for the continuity of this project. We are vibrant youths empowered by God to give you great online bible experience without compulsory internet.
FEATURES OF THE YORUBA AUDIO BIBLE APP
- Read Bible text offline.
- Download audio chapters and listen without internet.
- Yoruba Audio Bible with Old and New Testament coverage.
- Multiple Yoruba audio listening options.
- Hausa and Pidgin Bible experiences.
- Clear audio, natural pronunciation, and dramatic listening options.
- ATOKA Yoruba Bible text with headings and subheadings.
- Switch between Yoruba and English.
- Share Bible verses with friends and family.
- Navigate easily by book and chapter.
- Adjust text size for comfortable reading.
- Manage downloaded chapters to save device storage.
- Fast, simple chapter downloads.
Our mission is to help place the Bible in every African home through digital access in languages people understand. Your support helps us continue building and improving DaBible.
Send feedback or suggestions to support.dabible.com. Learn more at dabible.com.

bluejetty:00026642:ios.name: Bonjour RATP
bluejetty:00026642:ios.summary:
Bonjour RATP, the #1 app for public transport in Île‑de‑France.
Plan your trips, check live traffic, purchase your tickets, and discover all mobility alternatives around you - metro, RER, bus, tram, Transilien trains, and self-service bike
bluejetty:00026642:ios.description:
Bonjour RATP, the #1 app for public transport in Île‑de‑France.
Plan your trips, check live traffic, purchase your tickets, and discover all mobility alternatives around you - metro, RER, bus, tram, Transilien trains, and self-service bikes.
Your routes across all networks.
Metro, RER, bus, tramway, Transilien SNCF trains, Optile… Wherever you are, Bonjour RATP finds the best journey to get you around the entire region.
Journeys tailored to you. 
Customize your search according to your preferences:
- Avoid certain lines or stations,
- Prioritize your preferred modes (metro, RER, Transilien, bus…),
- Minimize transfers or favor accessible routes.
Because every resident of Île-de-France has their own way of traveling.
Real-time traffic and personalized alerts.
Check the network status at a glance and receive real-time alerts in case of disruptions on your favorite lines across the entire Île-de-France network.
All your tickets in your pocket. 
No more monthly queues! Buy the following tickets in the app and access them directly on your iPhone or Navigo pass:
- Navigo Month
- Navigo Week
- Navigo Day
- Metro-Train-RER tickets
- Bus-Tram tickets
- Paris Region-Airports tickets
- Special tickets (Music Festival, Anti-pollution pass...)
- Paris Visite pass
Always on time.
Check real-time schedules for upcoming departures on all your lines. Never miss your bus, metro, or RER again. An incident on your lines? Thanks to alerts, you’ll be immediately informed and the app will suggest an alternative.
Speak and go (Beta)
Just say where you want to go, and Bonjour RATP takes care of the rest!
Voice search makes your journeys even easier.
Bike sharing
Want to ride? Find a bike in seconds. Bonjour RATP shows availability of Vélib’, Lime, Dott and Voi.
Why choose Bonjour RATP?
- Complete coverage across all Île-de-France
- Customizable routes based on your preferences and habits
- Real-time traffic and alerts
- All tickets and passes directly in the app
- All self-service bikes available
- Smooth, clear, and intuitive interface
For more information about our services, feel free to contact us by email at clients@bonjour-ratp.fr
Source: leading public transport app ranking — Médiamétrie // NetRatings, April 2026.

bluejetty:00046484:ios.description:
Welcome to Whiskers! A cozy, comforting place to connect with the pets you love in a whole new way. Create adorable digital twins of your best friends and build a beautiful interactive memory journal of your pets through daily chats, remembering magic moments, sharing favorite photos, doing life together, embracing the everyday adventures that make your bond with your loved ones so special.
With Whiskers you can chat, style, animate, journal, create, and relax with your furry friends. 
• Chat about everyday moments, adventures, and milestones
• Share favorite memories, stories, and photos together
• Reflect on your thoughts, feelings, and anything on your mind
• Capture your pet’s unique personality, quirks, and the bond you share
Whether your buddies are curled up beside you, waiting for you at home, or forever in your heart, Whiskers gives you a warm place to remember, connect, and continue your story together.
As the weeks, months, and years go by, you'll build a beautiful interactive memory journal with the pets you hold close to your heart. 
Whiskers offers two membership options, Plus and Play, each with flexible membership lengths (weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annually) offering pet lovers a magical way to love, bond, and remember the pets close to their heart. 
Download Whiskers today! Your best friend is waiting!

Control your ragdoll stickman, move through dangerous environments, grab powerful weapons, and throw them at your enemies. Use timing, precision, and the unpredictable power of ragdoll physics to overcome obstacles and complete challenging levels.

• Simple Controls - Easily control your stickman, grab objects, aim, and throw weapons.

• Character Customization - Create your own unique stickman warrior with different customization options.
• Wide Weapon Arsenal - Discover and use swords, axes, spears, and many other throwable weapons.
• Action and Chaos - Every level offers unpredictable battles, funny moments, and new ways to defeat your opponents.
Master the ragdoll physics, improve your throwing skills, and become the ultimate stickman warrior!

The newest bubble shooter game in the popular Bubble Witch series. Stella the Witch is back and she needs your help to defeat Wilbur in this e
bluejetty:00065835:ios.description:
Bubble Witch 3 Saga – A magical bubble shooting puzzle game from the makers of Candy Crush Saga.
The newest bubble shooter game in the popular Bubble Witch series. Stella the Witch is back and she needs your help to defeat Wilbur in this exciting adventure! He may look cute, but he's full of magical mischief! Travel the realm bursting as many bubbles as you can in this bubble shooting puzzle game.
Match bubbles with the unique aiming line that allows you and Stella to blast and pop with magical precision! Solve the puzzles and rescue the Fairy Queen in this explosive bubble shooting adventure.
Take aim and shoot your way through the levels to find the magic star dust Stella needs in order to rebuild her home destroyed by Wilbur!
The only bubble shooter you will ever need! Take on this magical Saga alone or play with friends, burst their bubble by setting an all new high-score.
Bubble Witch 3 Saga features: 
• Match 3 bubbles to pop them in this magical puzzle shooting adventure 
• Spellbinding game modes and cute characters!
• Release the owls, free the ghosts and save the Fairy Queen from Wilbur!
• Rebuild Stella’s house and visit your friends' to get rewards 
• Special boosters to help you pass those tricky levels
• Easily sync the game between devices when connected to the Internet
• Leader boards to watch your friends and competitors!
• A free & easy to play bubble shooter, challenging to master! 
• Available to play on iPhone and iPad devices
Bubble Witch 3 Saga is completely free to play but some optional in-game items will require payment.
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
Bubble Witch 3 Mini, a bite sized bubble shooter experience to play within iMessage. Play with friends to match and pop as many bubbles as you can to reach the highest score. Cute stickers to liven up conversations and make them more entertaining. Available on iOS 10 and above. Internet connection is required to play Bubble Witch 3 Mini. 
By installing Bubble Witch 3 Mini, you agree to download the main game Bubble Witch 3 Saga. Bubble Witch 3 Mini is completely free to play but some optional in-game items will require payment. 
You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.

Visit https://care.king.com/ if you need help!

http://www.youtube.com/c/Bubble_Witch
https://www.instagram.com/bubblewitchsagaofficial/

IARC rating: 3+

bluejetty:00122093:ios.description:
Simple yet powerful, Splice makes it easy to create fully customized, professional-looking videos on your iPhone or iPad. Imagine the performance of a desktop editor, optimized for your mobile device. Just tap to trim clips, add slow motion effects, and overlay multiple clips to create beautiful videos you’ll love to share. It’s never been easier to edit like a pro on the go. 
POWERFUL EDITING TOOLS MADE SIMPLE 
+ Trim, cut, and crop your photos and video clips.
+ Refine your clips by adjusting exposure, contrast, saturation, and more.
+ Adjust playback speed for fast or slow motion, now also with speed ramping.
+ Overlay photos or videos and apply masks to create incredible effects.
+ Remove background with Chroma Key.
+ Animate your clips with the Ken Burns effect.
+ Apply filters and adjust background colors, orientation, and more.
+ Add amazing effects: glitch, chroma, vintage, and lots more.
+ Choose your transition style and control the speed between transitions.
+ Add title slides, text overlays, and a custom outro.
+ Bring your photos to life and create slideshows with pan and zoom effects.
CUSTOMIZE THE PERFECT SOUNDTRACK
+ Choose songs from 6,000+ royalty-free tracks from Artlist and Shutterstock libraries.
+ Trim and mix multiple audio tracks with precision.
+ Use a song from your own iTunes collection (subject to iTunes terms). 
+ Add narration or custom sound effects with the built-in voice recorder.
EASILY SHARE + SAVE YOUR VIDEO
+ Share right to YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Mail, Messages, and more. 
+ Save videos to your camera roll.
SUBSCRIPTION INFO:
Subscribe to take advantage of the features described above.
• Subscription length: weekly, monthly, yearly
• Your payment will be charged to your iTunes Account as soon as you confirm your purchase.
• You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal from your Account Settings after the purchase.
• Your subscription will renew automatically, unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
• When canceling a subscription, your subscription will stay active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but the current subscription will not be refunded.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00144772:ios.description:
The Daily Hadith is a beautifully designed collection of authentic Hadith books for Muslims and others who want to learn more about Islam and Prophet Muhammad from its original sources. 
The Hadith are the sayings or acts of prophet Muhammad (S.A.W) compiled by six Sunni Muslim scholars in the ninth century CE, approximately two centuries after the death of the Messenger of Allah. They are sometimes referred to as al-Sahih al-Sittah, which translates as "The Authentic Six". They are accepted as part of the official canon of Sunni Islam.
With The Daily Hadith app, you can:
- read the 14 Hadith books in Arabic and English on beautifully designed pages 
- ask questions about hadiths and Islam to AI
- enhance your learning with autosuggested questions & answers
- The books include Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Sunan Abu Dawood, Sunan al-Tirmidhi, Sunan al-Nasa'i, Sunan ibn Majah, and 8 other best reputed Hadith books
- receive daily Hadiths and create Hadith widget
- save and share your favorite Hadiths as text or image
- adjust font size for your reading comfort
- listen to select books in audio

bluejetty:00078407:ios.description:
Become a Viral Sensation with Lamar - Idle Vlogger!
Welcome to the wacky world of "Lamar - Idle Vlogger," where you can turn into a superstar by doing the silliest and funniest things online! Join Lamar as he starts his journey from a nobody to a famous internet sensation by making people laugh and going viral!
Start from Zero
Lamar begins with just a simple camera and a big dream. Help him make hilarious videos that catch everyone's attention. From silly pranks to funny challenges, there's no limit to the fun you can have!
Create Crazy Content
Explore all kinds of zany video ideas! Try out different styles like crazy stunts, funny skits, and goofy dances. The more creative and silly you are, the more fans you'll get!
Grow Your Fanbase
Watch your number of followers explode as you make more and more viral videos. Keep an eye on what your fans like the most and keep giving them awesome content. Collaborate with other goofy vloggers and join in on trending challenges to boost your fame even more.
Upgrade Your Gear
As Lamar becomes more popular, he can buy better equipment to make even cooler videos. Get awesome new cameras, funny props, and decorate your studio with the craziest items you can find. The better your videos look, the more people will watch!
Be Yourself
Dress up Lamar in the silliest outfits and give him the funniest hairstyles. Create a unique look that will make everyone remember you. Your personality and style will shine through every video!
Face the Fun and Challenges
Being a vlogger isn't always easy. Lamar will have to deal with haters, internet trolls, and even some embarrassing moments. But don't worry, with your help, he'll overcome everything and keep making people laugh!
Play Anytime, Anywhere
Even when you're not playing, Lamar is still working hard to become a star. Come back anytime to check on his progress, collect rewards, and see what new funny stuff you can do next.
Join Lamar in this fun-filled adventure to become the ultimate viral vlogger. With a lot of laughs, creativity, and your help, Lamar can achieve his dreams of internet stardom. Download "Lamar - Idle Vlogger" now and start your hilarious journey to the top!

bluejetty:00174909:ios.name: MapOut
bluejetty:00174909:ios.summary:
“MapOut saves the day with its intuitive interface for drawing routes and viewing elevation profiles. I’m genuinely impressed by its powerful features!” – Alee, cyclingabout.com
Offline maps covering the entire globe, optimized for iPhone
bluejetty:00174909:ios.description:
“MapOut saves the day with its intuitive interface for drawing routes and viewing elevation profiles. I’m genuinely impressed by its powerful features!” – Alee, cyclingabout.com
Offline maps covering the entire globe, optimized for iPhone and iPad. As beautiful as a traditional paper map—but far more versatile.
Perfectly tailored for:
- Hikers: Clear, detailed terrain maps accessible even in the most remote locations, without an internet connection.
- Cyclists: Extensive cycling route network with real-time speed and distance tracking.
- City Travelers: Detailed city maps complete with essential tourist information.
- Map Enthusiasts: Simply elegant maps that are a pleasure to view.
Innovative 3D Tilt View
- Tilt your device in any direction to vividly explore terrain details. Learn more at [mapout.app](https://mapout.app).
Powerful Offline Search
- Easily find places, streets, mountains, and more—no internet needed.
High-Quality Map Data
- Built upon the OpenStreetMap project, the "Wikipedia of Maps". Contribute your own corrections and additions at OpenStreetMap.org.
- Regularly updated offline maps available for your selected regions.
Effortless Tour Planning
- Draw: Easily create custom routes and waypoints directly on your map. Adjust existing tours or imported GPX files effortlessly.
- Import: Transfer routes to your device via email using a free "MapOut.me" account. Discover countless GPX and KML route files online, ideal for hiking or biking (e.g., gpsies.com).
- Record: Capture your adventures and easily share them with friends.
- Insights: Quickly see vital information for every tour—distance, elevation changes, route profile, and map details.
Superior Map Viewing Experience
- Rapid, hardware-accelerated rendering for smooth navigation.
- Continuous zoom with impeccable clarity at every level.
- Detailed topographical views featuring contour lines and shading.
- Versatile overlays include biking, hiking, skiing routes, sightseeing locations, and public transport networks.
Find comprehensive support and answers in our user manual: https://mapout.app/manual
Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright
