bluejetty:00134063:ios.description:
PDFgear Scan is a feature-rich PDF Scanner App that digitizes all your documents and simplifies your life. It can transform your iPhone or iPad into a powerful and portable scanner, extract texts and data from the document with cutting-edge OCR technology and advanced editing capabilities, and share the scanned document as PDF, Word, TXT, or images effortlessly. 
PDFgear Scan boosts productivity and saves time for anyone who works with documents: lawyers, officers, realtors, managers, students, accountants, and more. Download PDFgear Scan now to streamline your workflow and experience the most convenient way to store, manage, and share all your paper documents.
Key Features:
Smart Document Scanner
- Capture documents, remove cluttered backgrounds, and deskew in one step automatically
- Scan multiple pages into one file easily
- Scan with the device’s cameras or stored photos
- Save scans as PDF, Word, or image files
Multi-Scanning Modes for Every Need:
– Receipts & Expense Reports: Effortlessly scan receipts, automatically categorize expenses, and generate professional reports in seconds. Simplify your bookkeeping and tax prep!
– ID & Passport Scan: Securely capture and store IDs, passports, and other vital documents with a specialized, high-speed mode designed for accuracy and convenience.
– Book & Magazine Scan (with Smart Flattening): Digitize entire books and magazines with ease. Our innovative "Book Mode" automatically flattens curved pages, ensuring crystal-clear, perfectly aligned scans every time.
– QR & Barcode Reader: Instantly scan any QR code or barcode with your camera. Get quick access to websites, product information, and more.
Powerful Editing Tools
- Crop or rotate the captured images with a simple tap
- Apply filters to enhance the quality of scanned documents
- Create and insert signatures into documents, perfect for professionals dealing with contracts
Advanced OCR Capabilities
- Recognize and extract texts from documents using OCR technology
- Export the OCR result to Word or TXT and share with others
- Auto-split the OCR results for optimal layout
Page Management & Scan Organization
- Add, rotate, delete, and reorder pages with ease
- Manage and rename scans in list view for quick access
Flexible Sharing Options
- Share scanned documents in formats like PDF, Word, Images, or a long image based on your needs
- Collaborate with others by sharing files through Airdrop, Email, messaging apps, and more
AI Chat for Instant Document Insights:
– Ask AI Anything About Your Scans: Have questions about a scanned document? Our integrated AI chat allows you to instantly ask anything about your captured text – from summarizing key points to extracting specific information. It's like having a personal document assistant!
PDFgear Scan revolutionizes the way you handle paperwork, offering a seamless scanning experience. Embrace the convenience of PDFgear Scan and elevate your document management efficiency now.

SCREEN TIME MADE GOOD

bluejetty:00046171:ios.description:
SCREEN TIME MADE GOOD
Imagine a streaming platform where every world, character, and story is curated to spark wonder and shape your kids' imagination for good. A place where kids' character is not compromised and conviction is built. Enter BRAVE+, the kids’ streaming platform with the best collection of trusted and beloved content, curated by parents and handcrafted for kids – with ZERO ads, harmful messages, or overstimulating content.
Join 31,000+ families who are taking the worry out of screen time with BRAVE+.
LET KIDS EXPLORE, WORRY-FREE
BRAVE+ offers a carefully vetted collection of content, like the new BRAVE+ original, Iggy and Mr. Kirk, plus trusted classics and even children’s audiobooks. Stream content like:
- Iggy and Mr. Kirk
- Franklin
- Babar
- Madeline
- The Remarkable Mr. King
- Redwall
- Strawberry Shortcake
- The Adventures of Paddington Bear
- Liberty’s Kids
- Where on Earth is Carmen Sandiego?
- Audiobooks like Winnie the Pooh and The Secret Garden
INSTILL A SOUND MIND
BRAVE+’s unique evaluation process makes sure every show builds strong character and promotes healthy mental development.
We only allow shows that:
- Teach a moral lesson
- Are age-appropriate
- Capture kids’ imaginations
- Promote good attention & memory skills
- Support behavioral & emotional development
Meanwhile, we’ve carefully screened out shows that:
- Communicate a worldview that is antithetical to the Bible
- Exacerbate hyperactivity issues
- Cause memory, focus, and behavioral problems
- Have no clear message or takeaway
FROM SCREEN TO BOOKS
BRAVE+ comes to you from the team at BRAVE Books, where our dedication to imaginative, engaging, and value-based children’s content extends beyond the screen and into the pages of our books. And if you’re a BRAVE Books Subscriber, you can get free access to all of the content on BRAVE+. For more information, please visit our FAQ page at https://bravebooks.gorgias.help/en-US.
Download BRAVE+ today and experience the difference of screen time made good.
For help with BRAVE+, please visit https://bravebooks.gorgias.help/en-US
The content available on BRAVE+ may vary by region. Some titles shown above may not be available in your country.
©BRAVE Books and its related entities.

UNIFIED DEVICE MAP & "SYSTEM DATA" CLARITY
See your device the way the OS sees it. Break open the "System Data" black box by mapping your Photos & Videos library, "On My iPhone / On My iPad" app folders, Downloads, Recently Deleted (.Trash), and hidden cache overhead in one color-coded, zero-double-counting map.

4. Hold the microphone button and speak
5. Release — your words are typed instantly
== FOR WHO ==
• PROFESSIONALS writing emails, Slack messages, and reports hands-free
• STUDENTS taking notes in class or recording ideas
• CREATORS brainstorming scripts, captions, and posts
• CHATTERS firing off quick messages in Signal, iMessage, WhatsApp
• MULTILINGUAL USERS switching languages without changing keyboards

LifeTalk Pro: Unlimited words, Speed + Accuracy modes, premium languages
Talk-AI Pro: Everything in LifeTalk + unlimited Chat AI and smart replies
== PRIVACY FIRST ==
When you use the keyboard microphone, voice audio is sent to our server only for transcription. Nothing else you type with the keyboard is sent or stored. We never read your messages or share your data.
== FEATURES ==
- Voice-to-text in every app via custom keyboard
- On-device & cloud transcription modes
- 30+ language support with auto-detection
- Speed Mode and Accuracy Mode toggle
- AI punctuation and formatting
- Voice notes with cloud sync

- Universal Purchase — one price covers iPhone + Mac
- Haptic feedback and typing hints
- Dark Mode support
== SUBSCRIPTIONS ==
Whisper Flow offers auto-renewing subscriptions. You can start with a 3-day free trial, then:
- LifeTalk Weekly: $6.99/week

Subscriptions auto-renew at the end of each period unless cancelled at least 24 hours before. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. You can manage or cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Questions? Issues? Reach out through the Report an Issue link inside the app, and we'll respond within 24 hours.
